then pandoc \"$1\" -o \"$2\"; else python3 \"$DOCS/export_docx.py\" \"$1\" \"$2\"; fi\n}\nkonversi \"$PROMPT_V1\"                        \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) prompt-v1.docx\"\nkonversi \"$PROMPT_V2\"                        \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) prompt-v2.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/log-mentah/2026-10-05-prompt-1.md\" \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) laporan-kerja-prompt-1.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/log-mentah/2026-10-05-prompt-2.md\" \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) laporan-kerja-prompt-2.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/laporan-pengujian.md\"        \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) laporan-pengujian.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/penjelasan-fitur.md\"         \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) penjelasan-fitur.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/jurnal-prompt.md\"            \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) jurnal-prompt.docx\"\nkonversi \"$DOCS/catatan-demo.md\"             \"$ARSIP/(ARSIP) catatan-demo.docx\"\n\necho \"Selesai. docs/word/ (bonus):\"\nls -la \"$WORD\"\necho \"docs/word-arsip/ (arsip bukti revisi):\"\nls -la \"$ARSIP\"\n"}

rej(new Error(JSON.stringify(msg.error))) : res(msg.result)\n    }\n  }\n  const send = (method, params = {}, sessionId) => {\n    const myId = ++id\n    return new Promise((res, rej) => {\n      pending.set(myId, { res, rej })\n      ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: myId, method, params, sessionId }))\n    })\n  }\n\n  const { targetId } = await send('Target.createTarget', { url: 'about:blank' })\n  const { sessionId } = await send('Target.attachToTarget', { targetId, flatten: true })\n\n  const evalJs = async (expression) => {\n    const r = await send(\n      'Runtime.evaluate',\n      { expression, awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true },\n      sessionId,\n    )\n    if (r.exceptionDetails) {\n      throw new Error('eval error: ' + JSON.stringify(r.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? r.exceptionDetails))\n    }\n    return r.result.value\n  }\n\n  // 1) buka halaman app, lalu login lewat API yang sama dengan yang dipakai UI\n  await send('Page.navigate', { url: 'http://localhost:5173/masuk' }, sessionId)\n  await sleep(4000)\n\n  const login = await evalJs(`(async () => {\n    await fetch('/sanctum/csrf-cookie', { credentials: 'include' })\n    const token = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find((c) => c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).split('=')[1])\n    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/auth/masuk', {\n      method: 'POST',\n      credentials: 'include',\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': token },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'admin@sekolah.test', password: 'Passw0rd!Aman' }),\n    })\n    return { status: res.status, body: (await res.json()).user?.role ?? null }\n  })()`)\n  console.log('LOGIN:', JSON.stringify(login))\n\n  const halaman = ['/kelas', '/mapel', '/murid', '/impor-murid', '/pengaturan']\n  for (const jalur of halaman) {\n    await send('Page.navigate', { url: 'http://localhost:5173' + jalur }, sessionId)\n    await sleep(3500)\n    const info = await evalJs(\n      `({ judul: document.title, menu: [...document.querySelectorAll('nav a')].map((a) => a.textContent.trim() + '=>' + a.getAttribute('href')).join(' | '), isi: document.querySelector('main')?.innerText?.replace(/\\\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 260) ?? '(tanpa main)' })`,\n    )\n    console.log('==', jalur, '==')\n    console.log('   judul:', info.judul)\n    console.log('   menu :', info.menu)\n    console.log('   isi  :', info.isi)\n  }\n\n  ws.close()\n}\n\nmain().catch((e) => {\n  console.error('GAGAL:', e.message)\n  process.exit(1)\n})\n"}

Konten/kunci structures:

PilihanGanda:
- konten: {teks: string (required), opsi: [{id: 'A'|string, teks: string}] min 2, maximal 5? allow up to 6; matematika?: string (MathML), media?: string path}
- kunci: {jawaban: id}
Validation: jawaban must exist among opsi ids; ids unique.
nilai: jawaban === kunci['jawaban'] (normalize string cast).

BenarSalah:
- konten: {teks, pernyataan?: string}? Simplest: {teks: statement text, pembenaran? no}. kunci: {benar: bool}
Validation: kunci['benar'] must be bool.
nilai: (bool) jawaban === kunci['benar'].

Menjodohkan:
- konten: {teks, kiri:[{id,teks}] min 2, kanan:[{id,teks}] min 2}
- kunci: {pasangan: {kiriId: kananId}}
Validation: every kiri id has a mapping, mapping target exists in kanan, ids unique.
nilai: jawaban array pasangan; must match exactly (all pairs correct).

Mengurutkan:
- konten: {teks, item:[{id,teks}] min 2}
- kunci: {urutan:[ids]}
Validation: urutan is permutation of item ids.
nilai: jawaban (array ids) === kunci urutan.

Models:
- `App\Sections\Question\Models\Tag` table 'tags': Fillable school_id, nama, deskripsi. casts none. relations: sekolah, soal (hasMany).
- `App\Sections\Question\Models\Soal` table 'questions': Fillable school_id, subject_id, tag_id, tipe, konten, kunci, pembahasan?, skor, aktif, dibuat_oleh. casts: konten => array, kunci => array, tipe => TipeSoal, skor => integer, aktif => boolean.
  relations: sekolah, mapel (subject_id), tag, kuis (belongsToMany via quiz_questions withPivot urutan).
  method `terkunci(): bool` → true if attached to any quiz with status publikasi and currently running.
- `App\Sections\Quiz\Models\Kuis` table 'quizzes': Fillable school_id, subject_id, class_id, judul, deskripsi, status, mulai_at, selesai_at, durasi_menit, acak_soal, acak_opsi, publikasi_at, dibuat_oleh. casts: status => StatusKuis, mulai_at/selesai_at/publikasi_at => datetime, acak_* bool, durasi_menit int.
  relations: sekolah, mapel, kelas, soal (belongsToMany 'quiz_questions' withPivot 'urutan' orderBy urutan), pembuat (user).

''),\n            $daftar,\n        ));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Galat bila ada id yang kosong atau duplikat.\n     *\n     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $daftar\n     * @return array<int, string>\n     */\n    public static function galatId(array $daftar, string $namaKolom): array\n    {\n        $galat = [];\n        $id = self::idDaftar($daftar);\n\n        foreach ($id as $satu) {\n            if (trim($satu) === '') {\n                $galat[] = \"Setiap {$namaKolom} wajib punya id.\";\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (count($id) !== count(array_unique($id))) {\n            $galat[] = \"Id {$namaKolom} tidak boleh duplikat.\";\n        }\n\n        return $galat;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Teks soal wajib ada.\n     *\n     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $konten\n     * @return array<int, string>\n     */\n    public static function galatTeks(array $konten): array\n    {\n        $teks = $konten['teks'] ?? null;\n\n        if (! is_string($teks) || trim($teks) === '') {\n            return ['Isi soal (konten.teks) wajib diisi.'];\n        }\n\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Media (opsional) hanya boleh berupa path/URL pendek.\n     *\n     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $konten\n     * @return array<int, string>\n     */\n    public static function galatMedia(array $konten): array\n    {\n        $media = $konten['media'] ?? For the FormRequest validation with registry, use `after()` hook:

```php
public function after(): array
{
    return [
        function (Validator $validator): void {
            if ($validator->errors()->isNotEmpty()) return; // hmm, should still validate structures? if base fields invalid, konten may be missing
            $tipe = TipeSoal::tryFrom((string) $this->input('tipe'));
            if ($tipe === null) return;
            $konten = $this->input('konten');
            $kunci = $this->input('kunci');
            if (!is_array($konten) || !is_array($kunci)) return;
            foreach (RegistryTipeSoal::validasi($tipe, $konten, $kunci) as $pesan) {
                $validator->errors()->add('konten', $pesan);
            }
        },
    ];
}
```
Careful: typed closure param must be `Illuminate\Validation\Validator` for after(). Signature: `after(): array` returning callables that receive `Validator`. In Laravel, `public function after(): array { return [function (\Illuminate\Validation\Validator $validator) {...}]; }`. Good.

Also `withValidator`? after() is supported in Laravel 10+. Fine.

$tipe->objektif()) {\n                    $validator->errors()->add('tipe', 'Tipe soal ini belum didukung; tahap sekarang hanya soal objektif.');\n\n                    return;\n                }\n\n                $konten = $this->input('konten');\n                $kunci = $this->input('kunci');\n\n                if (! is_array($konten) || ! is_array($kunci)) {\n                    return;\n                }\n\n                foreach (RegistryTipeSoal::validasi($tipe, $this->asStringKeyed($konten), $this->asStringKeyed($kunci)) as $pesan) {\n                    $validator->errors()->add('konten', $pesan);\n                }\n            },\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Bersihkan teks soal/opsi dari spasi berlebih di ujung.\n     */\n    protected function prepareForValidation(): void\n    {\n        $konten = $this->input('konten');\n\n        if (is_array($konten) && isset($konten['teks']) && is_string($konten['teks'])) {\n            $konten['teks'] = trim($konten['teks']);\n            $this->merge(['konten' => $konten]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param  array<mixed>  $data\n     * @return array<string, mixed>\n     */\n    private function asStringKeyed(array $data): array\n    {\n        $hasil = [];\n\n        foreach ($data as $kunci => $nilai) {\n            $hasil[(string) $kunci] = $nilai;\n        }\n\n        return $hasil;\n    }\n}\n"}

### 1. Auto-login after register
Problem: pending accounts are rejected everywhere by `akun-aktif` middleware (alasanAkunDitolak returns "Verifikasi email dulu sebelum masuk." for Pending). So if we log them in, every protected endpoint returns 403 and the session is destroyed → the user would be bounced back to login. Not good.

Options:
(a) Auto-login AND allow unverified users to access a whitelist: `/auth/saya`, `/auth/kirim-ulang-verifikasi`, `/auth/keluar`. If `akun-aktif` logs them out, they can't even resend.
(b) Change `akun-aktif` to not reject Pending, but reject suspended/deleted; and gate unverified users at the app level (frontend shows "perlu verifikasi" page), with server-side protection: unverified users only get limited data? Risky — our security rule says unverified accounts rejected on all paths.

Hmm. The user wants UX: after registration → directly logged in. The intended UX: after register, user lands in app in "waiting verification" state (with the ability to resend email) rather than being kicked to login page with a message.

Best approach consistent with security: keep `alasanAkunDitolak` semantics but make the middleware allow unverified/pending accounts to reach only the verification-related routes. I.e., middleware returns 403 for suspended/deleted always; for pending (unverified) it returns 403 EXCEPT for a small whitelist (auth/saya, auth/kirim-ulang-verifikasi, auth/keluar).

Implement: in EnsureAccountUsable, add a check: if the reason is the verification one and the route name is in whitelist → allow. But then the user can reach `/auth/saya` → the frontend can render the "perlu verifikasi" screen (HalamanPerluVerifikasi exists!). That gives good UX: registered → logged in → app shows "verifikasi email dulu" with resend button.

### 2. SMTP fail-open ("lebih optimistis")
Wrap `sendEmailVerificationNotification()` and password reset link sending in try/catch, log a warning, and report `email_terkirim: false` in the response so UI can say "email gagal terkirim, coba lagi nanti" while still succeeding.

Implementation: a small helper service `App\Sections\Auth\Services\PengirimEmail` (mailer wrapper):
```php
class PengirimEmail {
  public function coba(callable $aksi): bool {
     try { $aksi(); return true; } catch (Throwable $e) { Log::warning('Pengiriman email gagal (fail-open): '.$e->getMessage()); return false; }
  }
}
```
Hmm, `Model::shouldBeStrict` unrelated. But careful: Laravel's `sendEmailVerificationNotification()` when queue is sync (tests) → real send attempt. In tests, mail is faked.

Better shape: methods on the mailer service:
- `kirimVerifikasi(User $user): bool`
- `kirimTautanReset(string $email): bool` — but Password::sendResetLink returns status not exception... For reset, exceptions thrown by the mailer would bubble. Wrap: try { $status = Password::sendResetLink(...) } catch (Throwable) { return false }.

Then:

- VerifyEmailService::kirimUlang returns bool
- PasswordResetService::kirimTautan returns array [message, email_terkirim]? The controller response: keep message neutral, add `email_terkirim` bool.

Alternative simpler & still optimistic: make registration not depend on SMTP success and simply tell the user "kalau email belum masuk, pakai tombol kirim ulang" — i.e., keep responses identical but never 500. Then the "optimistic" behavior = registration always succeeds; if SMTP fails, log it and the user can resend later. And expose the send failure state only on the *authenticated* resend endpoint (`/auth/kirim-ulang-verifikasi`) where the user is known — no enumeration risk. And for the public resend, keep neutral response.

### B. SMTP fail-open
Backend:
- New service `App\Sections\Auth\Services\PengirimEmail`:
```php
class PengirimEmail {
  public function kirimVerifikasi(User $user): bool {
    try { $user->sendEmailVerificationNotification(); return true; }
    catch (Throwable $galat) { Log::warning('Email verifikasi gagal dikirim (fail-open).', ['user' => $user->getKey(), 'galat' => $galat->getMessage()]); return false; }
  }
  public function kirimTautanReset(string $email): bool {
    try { return Password::sendResetLink(['email'=>$email]) === Password::RESET_LINK_SENT; }
    catch (Throwable $galat) { Log::warning(...); return false; }
  }
}
```
Careful: security rule says no secrets in logs — we log the exception message only; could contain email/host but not secrets. Acceptable; avoid logging the body/token.

- RegisterService::daftarMurid returns user; add method `kirimVerifikasi` using PengirimEmail; return array [user, email_terkirim].
- VerifyEmailService::kirimUlang returns bool via PengirimEmail.
- PasswordResetService::kirimTautan returns array ['pesan'=>..., 'email_terkirim'=>bool]. Careful about anti-enumeration: don't leak whether email exists. `Password::sendResetLink` returns INVALID_USER when not found. If I return email_terkirim=false for unknown emails, that leaks. So: return `email_terkirim: true` unless a *transport error* occurred. Hmm, distinguishing is complex.

Simplest honest approach: return a boolean `email_terkirim` meaning "server managed to hand the message to the mailer", determined by status: RESET_LINK_SENT → true; INVALID_USER → true (neutral: pretend fine, nothing to send); exception/caught failure → false. That way unknown email → true (no leak). 

Also for register: if the user was created, email send failure → false (no leak since it's their own account, return value only to them).
For public resend (`kirim-ulang-verifikasi-publik`): keep the response neutral — do NOT expose email_terkirim (would leak existence). Return message only.
For authenticated resend: return email_terkirim (their own account).

Frontend: on the "perlu verifikasi" page and resend component, show "Email gagal terkirim. Coba lagi beberapa saat." when `email_terkirim === false`.

class PengirimEmail
{
    public function kirimVerifikasi(User $user): bool
    {
        if ($user->hasVerifiedEmail()) return true;
        try { $user->sendEmailVerificationNotification(); return true; }
        catch (Throwable $galat) { Log::warning('Verifikasi email gagal dikirim (fail-open).', ['user_id'=>$user->getKey(), 'pesan'=>$galat->getMessage()]); return false; }
    }

    public function kirimTautanReset(string $email): bool
    {
        try {
            $status = Password::sendResetLink(['email' => $email]);
            // INVALID_USER ≠ kegagalan kirim: tetap netral (anti-enumerasi).
            return $status !== Password::RESET_THROTTLED;
        } catch (Throwable $galat) { Log::warning(...); return false; }
    }
}
```
Hmm RESET_THROTTLED means throttled (not sent due to rate) → still not a transport failure. Simplify: return true unless exception. `return true;` after the call. So:

```
Good and neutral.

Cleaner approach avoiding innerHTML: build MathML via React elements! MathML elements are valid React elements (`<math>`, `<mi>`, `<mo>`, `<mn>`, `<msup>`, `<mfrac>` ...). React supports them as custom elements in JSX. So a MathML preview can be rendered by parsing a *structured template* (our own mini-syntax) into React elements. That's the "template terstruktur" idea: e.g. `\frac{a}{b}`, `x^2`, `\sqrt{x}` → React MathML. That's a genuinely nice, safe solution.

```js
/**
 * Registry tipe soal sisi klien (cermin App\Sections\Question\Enums\TipeSoal
 * dan RegistryTipeSoal di backend). Empat tipe objektif sudah bisa disimpan;
 * empat tipe esai ditampilkan sebagai pilihan belum tersedia.
 */

/** Nilai tipe soal — harus sama persis dengan enum backend. */
export const TIPE = {
  pilihanGanda: 'pilihan_ganda',
  benarSalah: 'benar_salah',
  isianSingkat: 'isian_singkat',
  uraian: 'uraian',
  menjodohkan: 'menjodohkan',
  mengurutkan: 'mengurutkan',
  letakKata: 'letak_kata',
  hubungKata: 'hubung_kata',
}

/** @type {Record<string, string>} */
export const LABEL_TIPE = {
  [TIPE.pilihanGanda]: 'Pilihan ganda',
  [TIPE.benarSalah]: 'Benar / salah',
  [TIPE.isianSingkat]: 'Isian singkat',
  [TIPE.uraian]: 'Uraian',
  [TIPE.menjodohkan]: 'Menjodohkan',
  [TIPE.mengurutkan]: 'Mengurutkan',
  [TIPE.letakKata]: 'Letak kata',
  [TIPE.hubungKata]: 'Hubung kata',
}

/** Tipe objektif (didukung registry backend). */
export const TIPE_OBJEKTIF = [TIPE.pilihanGanda, TIPE.benarSalah, TIPE.menjodohkan, TIPE.mengurutkan]

/** Opsi <select> editor: tipe esai ikut tampil tapi ditandai belum tersedia. */
export const DAFTAR_TIPE = Object.keys(LABEL_TIPE).map((nilai) => ({
  nilai,
  label: LABEL_TIPE[nilai],
  objektif: TIPE_OBJEKTIF.includes(nilai),
}))

/** Batas opsi pilihan ganda (cermin PenanganPilihanGanda). */
export const MIN_OPSI = 2
export const MAKS_OPSI = 6
/** Minimal pasangan menjodohkan / item mengurutkan. */
export const MIN_ITEM = 2

/** @param {unknown} nilai @returns {string} */
export function teksAman(nilai) {
  return typeof nilai === 'string' ? nilai : ''
}

/**
 * Daftar item {id, teks} dari konten server (tahan data kotor).
 * @param {unknown} nilai
 * @returns {{ id: string, teks: string }[]}
 */
export function daftarAman(nilai) {
  if (!Array.isArray(nilai)) return []
  return nilai
    .filter((baris) => baris !== null && typeof baris === 'object')
    .map((baris) => ({ id: teksAman(/** @type {any} */ (baris).id), teks: teksAman(/** @type {any} */ (baris).teks) }))
}
```
Hmm `/** @type {any} */` — better `typeof baris === 'object'` narrowing then cast to `Record<string, unknown>`:
```js
const rekaman = /** @type {Record<string, unknown>} */ (baris)
```
That's cleaner.

```js
/**
 * Id berikutnya yang belum dipakai (mis. 'A', 'B', …).
 * @param {string} prefix
 * @param {{ id: string }[]} daftar
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function idBerikut(prefix, daftar) {
  const dipakai = new Set(daftar.map((satu) => satu.id))
  let nomor = 1
  while (dipakai.has(`${prefix}${nomor}`)) nomor += 1
  return `${prefix}${nomor}`
}
```

  ...
  return galat
}

/**
 * Ubah untai MathML menjadi elemen React tanpa dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
 * @param {string} teks
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode|null}
 */
export function mathmlKeElemen(teks) {
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') return null
  const dokumen = new DOMParser().parseFromString(teks, 'text/html')
  const akar = dokumen.querySelector('math')
  if (akar === null) return null
  return elemenDariSimpul(akar, 'm0')
}

Implementation:
```js
/** @param {Node} simpul @returns {import('react').ReactNode} */
function elemenDariSimpul(simpul) {
  if (simpul.nodeType === 3) return simpul.textContent
  if (simpul.nodeType !== 1) return null
  const elemen = /** @type {Element} */ (simpul)
  const nama = elemen.tagName.toLowerCase()
  if (!TAGS_DIIZINKAN.has(nama)) return elemen.textContent
  const props = {}
  for (const atribut of Array.from(elemen.attributes)) {
    if (ATRIBUT_DIIZINKAN.has(atribut.name)) props[atribut.name] = atribut.value
  }
  const anak = []
  let nomor = 0
  for (const isi of Array.from(elemen.childNodes)) {
    anak.push(<span key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</span>)
    nomor += 1
  }
```
Hmm wrapping in span for text breaks MathML semantics (text nodes inside <mn> must be raw). Instead:
```js
  const anak = Array.from(elemen.childNodes).map((isi, nomor) => (
    <Fragment key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</Fragment>
  ))
```
Using `Fragment` from react. Good — that preserves text nodes properly.

Then `createElement(nama, {...props, key}, ...anak)`? Since we're inside a React component returning ReactNode, we can use `createElement`. Use `import { Fragment, createElement } from 'react'`.

props keys: attribute names are lowercase (MathML attrs are lowercase) so no className conversion needed. Fine — for `class` attribute on math we'd need className; skip 'class' from allowlist. It's fine to pass as-is (React allows unknown attrs lowercase). Include 'xmlns'? XMLNS in createElement props is allowed as `xmlns`. Skip it to avoid warnings.

export default function MediaSoal({ konten }) {
  const matematika = teksAman(konten.matematika)
  const media = teksAman(konten.media)
  const elemenMath = matematika === '' ? null : mathmlKeElemen(matematika)
  return (
    <>
      {media !== '' && <img src={media} alt="Media pendukung soal" className="media-soal" />}
      {elemenMath !== null && <div className="mathml-soal">{elemenMath}</div>}
      {matematika !== '' && elemenMath === null && <p className="teks-lembut small mb-0">{matematika}</p>}
    </>
  )
}
```

import { daftarAman, teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'
import MediaSoal from './MediaSoal.jsx'

export default function SoalPilihanGanda({ konten, kunci = {}, nilai, onUbah, dinonaktifkan = false, tampilkanKunci = false, nama = 'soal' }) {
  const opsi = daftarAman(konten.opsi)
  const kunciJawaban = teksAman(kunci.jawaban)
  return (
    <div className="soal-render">
      <p className="soal-teks">{teksAman(konten.teks)}</p>
      <MediaSoal konten={konten} />
      <ul className="daftar-opsi list-unstyled mb-0">
        {opsi.map((satu) => {
          const benar = tampilkanKunci && satu.id === kunciJawaban
          return (
            <li key={satu.id} className="form-check d-flex gap-2 align-items-start">
              <input
                className="form-check-input mt-1"
                type="radio"
                name={nama}
                id={`${nama}-${satu.id}`}
                value={satu.id}
                checked={nilai === satu.id}
                disabled={dinonaktifkan}
                onChange={() => onUbah?.(satu.id)}
              />
              <label className={`form-check-label ${benar ? 'fw-semibold' : ''}`} htmlFor={`${nama}-${satu.id}`}>
                <span className="opsi-huruf">{satu.id}.</span> {satu.teks}
                {benar && <span className="badge-kunci ms-2">kunci</span>}
              </label>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { Fragment, createElement } from 'react'
import { teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'

/** Elemen MathML yang boleh dirender (daftar putih). */
const TAGS_MATHML = new Set([
  'math','mrow','mi','mn','mo','mtext','ms','mspace','msup','msub','msubsup','mfrac','msqrt','mroot',
  'mfenced','mtable','mtr','mtd','munder','mover','munderover','mmultiscripts','mprescripts','none',
  'mstyle','mpadded','mphantom','menclose','semantics','annotation','annotation-xml','mlabeledtr',
])

/** Atribut MathML yang diteruskan apa adanya ke elemen React. */
const ATRIBUT_MATHML = new Set([
  'display','mathvariant','mathsize','mathcolor','mathbackground','stretchy','fence','separator',
  'linethickness','notation','columnalign','rowalign','columnspacing','rowspacing','columnlines',
  'rowlines','width','height','depth','scriptlevel','movablelimits','accent','accentunder','form',
  'lspace','rspace','open','close','separators','minsize','maxsize','largeop','symmetric',
])

/**
 * Ubah simpul DOM hasil parse menjadi elemen React (tanpa innerHTML).
 * @param {Node} simpul
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode}
 */
function elemenDariSimpul(simpul) {
  if (simpul.nodeType === 3) return simpul.textContent
  if (simpul.nodeType !== 1) return null

  const elemen = /** @type {Element} */ (simpul)
  const nama = elemen.tagName.toLowerCase()

  if (!TAGS_MATHML.has(nama)) return elemen.textContent

  /** @type {Record<string, string>} */
  const sifat = {}
  for (const atribut of Array.from(elemen.attributes)) {
    if (ATRIBUT_MATHML.has(atribut.name)) sifat[atribut.name] = atribut.value
  }

  const anak = Array.from(elemen.childNodes).map((isi, nomor) => (
    <Fragment key={nomor}>{elemenDariSimpul(isi)}</Fragment>
  ))

  return createElement(nama, { ...sifat, key: nama }, ...anak)
}
```
Hmm `key: nama` weird — key only matters in arrays; we wrap in Fragment with key already. Remove key.

`createElement(nama, sifat, ...anak)` — typing: `createElement` accepts `(type: string, props: any, ...children)`. With TS + React 19 types, `createElement(type: FunctionComponent | string, ...)`. Since children are ReactNode, fine.

`Array.from(elemen.attributes)` → `Attr[]`; `atribut.name` ok.

`elemen.childNodes` → NodeListOf<ChildNode>; `Array.from(...)` ok.

Then:
```jsx
/**
 * MathML dari guru → elemen native. Bila DOMParser tidak ada (lingkungan uji
 * tanpa DOM), tampilkan teksnya saja supaya tidak ada markup mentah.
 * @param {string} teks
 * @returns {import('react').ReactNode|null}
 */
export function mathmlKeElemen(teks) {
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') return null

  const dokumen = new DOMParser().parseFromString(teks, 'text/html')
  const akar = dokumen.querySelector('math')
  if (akar === null) return null

  return elemenDariSimpul(akar)
}

/** Bersihkan tanda kurung sudut saat MathML tidak bisa dirender. */
export function teksTanpaTag(teks) {
  return teks.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
}

/** @param {{ konten: Record<string, unknown> }} props */
export default function MediaSoal({ konten }) {
  const media = teksAman(konten.media)
  const matematika = teksAman(konten.matematika).trim()
  const elemen = matematika === '' ? null : mathmlKeElemen(matematika)

  return (
    <>
      {media !== '' && (
        <img className="media-soal" src={media} alt="Media pendukung soal" loading="lazy" />
      )}
      {elemen !== null && <div className="mathml-soal">{elemen}</div>}
      {matematika !== '' && elemen === null && (
        <p className="mathml-soal teks-lembut small mb-0">{teksTanpaTag(matematika)}</p>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```

Wait: `dokumen.querySelector('math')` returns Element|null typed as Element. `elemenDariSimpul(akar)` accepts Node. fine.

One risk: parsing `<math>...</math>` via text/html — DOMParser will place it in body. querySelector('math') works.

/**
 * Renderer pilihan ganda (2–6 opsi).
 * konten: { teks, opsi:[{id,teks}] } · kunci: { jawaban: id }
 */
import MediaSoal from './MediaSoal.jsx'
import { daftarAman, teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'

/** @param {import('./props.js').PropsSoal} props */
export default function SoalPilihanGanda({
  konten,
  kunci = {},
  nilai,
  onUbah,
  dinonaktifkan = false,
  tampilkanKunci = false,
  nama = 'soal',
}) {
  const opsi = daftarAman(konten.opsi)
  const kunciJawaban = teksAman(kunci.jawaban)

  return (
    <div className="soal-render">
      <p className="soal-teks">{teksAman(konten.teks)}</p>
      <MediaSoal konten={konten} />
      <ul className="soal-opsi list-unstyled mb-0">
        {opsi.map((satu) => {
          const iniKunci = tampilkanKunci && satu.id === kunciJawaban
          const idInput = `${nama}-${satu.id}`
          return (
            <li key={satu.id} className="form-check d-flex gap-2 align-items-start">
              <input
                className="form-check-input mt-1"
                type="radio"
                name={nama}
                id={idInput}
                value={satu.id}
                checked={nilai === satu.id}
                disabled={dinonaktifkan}
                onChange={() => onUbah?.(satu.id)}
              />
              <label className="form-check-label" htmlFor={idInput}>
                <span className="opsi-huruf">{satu.id}.</span> {satu.teks}
                {iniKunci && <span className="badge-kunci ms-2">Kunci</span>}
              </label>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function SoalMengurutkan({ konten, kunci = {}, nilai, onUbah, dinonaktifkan = false, tampilkanKunci = false, nama = 'soal' }) {
  const item = daftarAman(konten.item)
  const jawaban = rekamanTeks(nilai)
  const kunciUrutan = daftarTeks(kunci.urutan)
  return (
    <ul className="soal-urut list-unstyled mb-0">
      {item.map((satu) => {
        const posisi = jawaban[satu.id] ?? ''
        const posisiKunci = kunciUrutan.indexOf(satu.id) + 1
        const benar = tampilkanKunci && Number(posisi) === posisiKunci
        return (
          <li key={satu.id} className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <input
              className="form-control form-control-sm urut-posisi"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={item.length}
              inputMode="numeric"
              aria-label={`Nomor urut untuk ${satu.teks}`}
              value={posisi}
              disabled={dinonaktifkan}
              onChange={(e) => onUbah?.({ ...jawaban, [satu.id]: e.target.value })}
            />
            <span>{satu.teks}</span>
            {tampilkanKunci && <span className="badge-kunci">{benar ? 'tepat' : `kunci: ${posisiKunci}`}</span>}
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ul>
  )
}

Props:
```js

 * }} props
 */
```
State: `const [state, setState] = useState(() => soal ? stateDariSoal(soal) : stateSoalKosong())`.
Effect: when `soal` changes (id changes) → reset state. Use `useEffect(() => { setState(soal ? stateDariSoal(soal) : stateSoalKosong()) }, [soal])`. Since `soal` object identity may change on each render of parent (list data), the effect could loop resetting edits. Parent passes `soal` from query data (stable per query result) or null. Safer to key the effect on `soal?.id ?? 'baru'`. Then if soal object changes but id is same, edits stay. Good.

Also `galat` state.

Helper setters: `function ubah(bidang, nilai) { setState((lama) => ({...lama, [bidang]: nilai})) }`.

  Simplification: one row per pairing: "kiri teks" + "kanan teks" where each kiri item pairs with a kanan item at the same index? That would lose flexibility, but backend allows arbitrary mapping. - Item list for mengurutkan: row: teks input + posisi number input + hapus.

/**
 * Label status kuis untuk murid (waktu relatif terhadap jadwal).
 * @param {{status: string, sedang_berjalan: boolean, mulai_at: string|null, selesai_at: string|null}} kuis
 * @returns {{ label: string, jenis: 'sukses'|'info'|'peringatan'|'lembut' }}
 */
export function statusTampilan(kuis) {
  if (kuis.status !== 'publikasi') return { label: kuis.status === 'arsip' ? 'Diarsipkan' : 'Draf', jenis: 'lembut' }
  if (kuis.sedang_berjalan) return { label: 'Sedang berjalan', jenis: 'sukses' }
  if (kuis.mulai_at !== null && new Date(kuis.mulai_at).getTime() > Date.now()) return { label: 'Belum dimulai', jenis: 'info' }
  return { label: 'Selesai', jenis: 'peringatan' }
}
```

```jsx
import { useAuthStore } from '../auth/authStore.js'
import HalamanKuis from './HalamanKuis.jsx'
import HalamanKuisMurid from './HalamanKuisMurid.jsx'

export default function PilihHalamanKuis() {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user)
  const sebagaiGuru = user?.role === 'guru' || user?.role === 'admin'
  return sebagaiGuru ? <HalamanKuis /> : <HalamanKuisMurid />
}

Interacting with React inputs: need a helper injected into the page:

```js
window.__isi = (el, nilai) => {
  const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype, 'value').set
  setter.call(el, nilai)
  el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
}
```
For textarea, constructor.prototype is HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype — the generic approach works. For select: set value + dispatch 'change'. For checkbox/radio: click().

Let me write helper functions inside the script as page-side code strings:

```js
const bantu = `
window.__isi = (pemilih, nilai) => { ... }
```

Simpler: define a page-side utility once via Runtime.evaluate:

```js
await evalJs(`window.__alat = {
  isi(sel, nilai) {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel)
    if (!el) throw new Error('elemen tidak ada: ' + sel)
    const proto = el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : el instanceof HTMLSelectElement ? HTMLSelectElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype
    Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set.call(el, nilai)
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
    return true
  },
  klik(sel) { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error('tidak ada: ' + sel); el.click(); return true },
  teks(sel) { return document.querySelector(sel)?.innerText ?? '' },
}`)
```
Note: for React controlled inputs, dispatching 'input' after native setter works.

For selects registered with RHF (select via register), 'change' triggers onChange. Good.

**PenilaianObjektif** (Scoring/Services/PenilaianObjektif.php):
```php
final class PenilaianObjektif
{
    /** @return array{status: StatusPenilaian, benar: bool|null, skor: float} */
    public function nilai(Soal $soal, mixed $jawaban): array
    {
        $tipe = $soal->tipeAman();
        if ($tipe === null) return ['status' => Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        if (! $tipe->objektif()) return ['status' => PerluTinjau, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        if ($jawaban === null) return ['status' => Dinilai, 'benar' => false, 'skor' => 0.0];
        try {
            $benar = RegistryTipeSoal::nilai($tipe, $soal->kontenSebagaiArray(), $soal->kunciSebagaiArray(), $jawaban);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return ['status' => Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
        }
        return ['status' => Dinilai, 'benar' => $benar, 'skor' => $benar ? (float) $soal->skor : 0.0];
    }
}
```

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Sections\Attempt\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\JenisAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\StatusAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Attempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Jawaban;
use App\Sections\Question\Models\Soal;
use App\Sections\Quiz\Models\Kuis;
use App\Sections\Scoring\Enums\StatusPenilaian;
use App\Sections\Scoring\Services\PenilaianObjektif;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AttemptService
{
    /** Toleransi keterlambatan mengumpulkan (detik) — server yang menentukan. */
    public const TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT = 120;

    public function __construct(private readonly PenilaianObjektif $penilaian) {}

    public function mulai(Kuis $kuis, User $murid, JenisAttempt $jenis = JenisAttempt::Ulangan): Attempt
    {
        $profil = $murid->murid;
        if ($profil === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Hanya akun murid yang bisa mengerjakan kuis.']);
        }
        if ($kuis->status !== StatusKuis::Publikasi) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Kuis belum diterbitkan.']);
        // kelas & sekolah
        if ((int) $profil->class_id !== (int) $kuis->class_id) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kuis' => 'Kuis ini bukan untuk kelasmu.']);

        $sekarang = Carbon::now();
        if ($kuis->mulai_at !== null && $kuis->mulai_at->greaterThan($sekarang)) throw ...'Kuis belum dimulai.'
        if ($kuis->selesai_at !== null && $kuis->selesai_at->lessThan($sekarang)) throw ...'Waktu kuis sudah berakhir.'

        $aktif = Attempt::query()
            ->where('quiz_id', $kuis->id)->where('student_id', $profil->id)
            ->where('jenis', $jenis->value)->where('aktif', true)->first();

        if ($aktif !== null) {
            return $this->muat($aktif);
        }

        $jumlahSoal = $kuis->soal()->count();

        $attempt = Attempt::query()->create([
            'school_id' => $kuis->school_id,
            'quiz_id' => $kuis->id,
            'student_id' => $profil->id,
            'jenis' => $jenis,
            'status' => StatusAttempt::Berjalan,
            'aktif' => true,
            'seed' => random_int(1, 2_147_483_647),
            'mulai_at' => $sekarang,
            'deadline_at' => $sekarang->copy()->addMinutes($kuis->durasi_menit),
            'jumlah_soal' => $jumlahSoal,
            'skor_maksimal' => (float) $kuis->soal()->sum('skor'),
        ]);

        return $this->muat($attempt);
    }
```

`kumpulkan(Attempt $attempt, string $idempotencyKey): Attempt`:
```php
$attempt->refresh(); // fresh state
return DB::transaction(function () use ($attempt, $idempotencyKey): Attempt {
    $baru = Attempt::query()->whereKey($attempt->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
    if (! $baru->berjalan()) {
        return $this->muat($baru);   // idempoten: dobel klik / dua tab
    }
    $sekarang = Carbon::now();
    $terlambat = $sekarang->greaterThan($baru->deadline_at);
    if ($terlambat && $sekarang->greaterThan($baru->deadline_at->copy()->addSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT))) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attempt' => 'Waktu ulangan sudah habis; jawaban tidak bisa dikumpulkan lagi.']);
    }
    $soal = $this->soalUntuk($baru);  // loads kuis.soal
    $total = 0.0; $benar = 0;
    foreach ($soal as $satu) {
        $hasil = $this->nilaiSatuSoal($baru, $satu, $sekarang);
        $total += $hasil['skor'];
        if ($hasil['benar'] === true) $benar++;
    }
    $baru->forceFill([
        'status' => StatusAttempt::Selesai,
        'aktif' => null,
        'dikumpulkan_at' => $sekarang,
        'terlambat' => $terlambat,
        'skor' => $total,
        'jumlah_benar' => $benar,
        'idempotency_key' => mb_substr($idempotencyKey, 0, 64),
    ])->save();
    return $this->muat($baru->refresh());
});
```
`nilaiSatuSoal(Attempt, Soal, Carbon): array` — writes Jawaban row:
```php
private function nilaiSatuSoal(Attempt $attempt, Soal $soal, Carbon $sekarang): array
{
    $jawaban = Jawaban::query()->where('attempt_id', $attempt->id)->where('question_id', $soal->id)->first();

    try {
        $hasil = $this->penilaian->nilai($soal, $jawaban?->jawaban);
    } catch (Throwable) {
        $hasil = ['status' => StatusPenilaian::Gagal, 'benar' => null, 'skor' => 0.0];
    }

    // Jawaban kosong tetap dicatat supaya guru tahu soal mana yang tidak diisi.
    $baris = $jawaban ?? new Jawaban(['attempt_id' => $attempt->id, 'question_id' => $soal->id, 'jawaban' => null]);
    $baris->forceFill([
        'status' => $hasil['status'],
        'benar' => $hasil['benar'],
        'skor' => $hasil['skor'],
        'dinilai_at' => $sekarang,
    ])->save();

    return $hasil;
}
```

AttemptPolicy:
```php
class AttemptPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }

    public function view(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt);
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid(); }

    public function jawab(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt) && $attempt->berjalan();
    }

    public function kumpulkan(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->milikMurid($user, $attempt) && $attempt->berjalan();
    }

    public function hasil(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        return $this->view($user, $attempt);
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }

    private function milikMurid(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        $profil = $user->murid;
        return $profil !== null && (int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $attempt->student_id;
    }
}

/** Kuis terbit berjalan + soal PG dan benar/salah (skor 5 masing-masing). */
function siapkanKuis(object $ctx, array $tambahan = []): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([
        'acak_soal' => false,
        'acak_opsi' => false,
        ...$tambahan,
    ]);

    $pg = Soal::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['skor' => 5]);
    $bs = Soal::factory()->benarSalah()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['skor' => 5]);

    $kuis->soal()->attach([$pg->id => ['urutan' => 1], $bs->id => ['urutan' => 2]]);

    return $kuis->refresh();
}

protected function wrap($data, $with = [], $additional = [])
{
    if ($data instanceof Collection) {
        $data = $data->all();

}

simpananJawaban.js (Zustand persist):
```js
/** Cadangan jawaban lokal (tanpa kunci) — dipulihkan saat jaringan/rel ulang. */
export const useSimpananJawaban = create(persist((set, get) => ({
  perAttempt: {},   // { [attemptId]: { jawaban: { [questionId]: nilai }, belumTerkirim: { [questionId]: nilai }, idempotencyKey, disimpanAt } }
  catat(attemptId, questionId, nilai) {...},
  tandaiTerkirim(attemptId, questionId) {...},
  ambil(attemptId) {...},
  kunciIdempotensi(attemptId) {...},  // generate once & keep
  bersihkan(attemptId) {...},
}), { name: 'ulangan-jawaban-v1' }))
```
Design details: `catat` stores into `jawaban` and also into `belumTerkirim`. `tandaiTerkirim` removes from `belumTerkirim`. `ambil(attemptId)` returns `{jawaban, belumTerkirim, idempotencyKey}`. Must not store kunci (nothing to store) — add a comment.

Note: persist requires localStorage → jsdom test env. Test with `// @vitest-environment jsdom` and check the merge/restore behavior: simulate by using the store API directly (set state, read). Also test that `belumTerkirim` survives.

For uuid: `crypto.randomUUID()` available in browsers & Node 22. Fallback if missing.

hitungMundur.js:
```js
/**
 * Sisa detik yang dikoreksi ke jam server.
 * @param {{ deadlineIso: string, serverNowIso: string, sekarangMs: number }} arg
 */
export function sisaDetikServer({ deadlineIso, serverNowIso, sekarangMs }) {
  const deadline = Date.parse(deadlineIso)
  const serverNow = Date.parse(serverNowIso)
  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline) || !Number.isFinite(serverNow)) return 0
  const geser = serverNow - sekarangMs       // jam server - jam klien (ms)
  return Math.max(0, Math.round((deadline - (sekarangMs + geser)) / 1000))
}
/** @param {number} detik */
export function formatSisa(detik) { ... 'MM:SS' or 'H:MM:SS' }
```

catat(attemptId, questionId, jawaban) {

      ...entri,
      jawaban: { ...entri.jawaban, [questionId]: jawaban },
      belumTerkirim: { ...entri.belumTerkirim, [questionId]: jawaban },
      disimpanAt: Date.now(),
    } } }
  })
}

Sisa waktu dihitung\n * dari `deadline_at` + `server_now` yang dikirim server, sehingga jam klien yang\n * digeser tidak menambah waktu pengerjaan.\n */\n\n/**\n * Selisih jam server terhadap jam klien (milidetik; positif = klien tertinggal).\n * @param {string} serverNowIso\n * @param {number} sekarangMs\n * @returns {number}\n */\nexport function geserJamMs(serverNowIso, sekarangMs) {\n  const jamServer = Date.parse(serverNowIso)\n\n  return Number.isFinite(jamServer) ? jamServer - sekarangMs : 0\n}\n\n/**\n * Sisa detik menurut jam server (tidak pernah negatif).\n * @param {{ deadlineIso: string, serverNowIso: string, sekarangMs: number }} arg\n * @returns {number}\n */\nexport function sisaDetik({ deadlineIso, serverNowIso, sekarangMs }) {\n  const deadline = Date.parse(deadlineIso)\n\n  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline)) return 0\n\n  const sisaMs = deadline - (sekarangMs + geserJamMs(serverNowIso, sekarangMs))\n\n  return Math.max(0, Math.round(sisaMs / 1000))\n}\n\n/**\n * Sisa detik dari payload attempt.\n * @param {{ deadline_at: string, server_now: string }} attempt\n * @param {number} sekarangMs\n * @returns {number}\n */\nexport function sisaDetikAttempt(attempt, sekarangMs) {\n  return sisaDetik({\n    deadlineIso: attempt.deadline_at,\n    serverNowIso: attempt.server_now,\n    sekarangMs,\n  })\n}\n\n/**\n * Format sisa detik menjadi \"MM:SS\" atau \"H:MM:SS\".\n * @param {number} detik\n * @returns {string}\n */\nexport function formatSisa(detik) {\n  const aman = Math.max(0, Math.floor(detik))\n  const jam = Math.floor(aman / 3600)\n  const menit = Math.floor((aman % 3600) / 60)\n  const sisa = aman % 60\n  /** @param {number} angka */\n  const duaDigit = (angka) => String(angka).padStart(2, '0')\n\n  return jam > 0 ? `${jam}:${duaDigit(menit)}:${duaDigit(sisa)}` : `${duaDigit(menit)}:${duaDigit(sisa)}`\n}\n\n/**\n * Peringatan waktu (untuk mewarnai timer) — ambang 5 menit dan 1 menit.\n * @param {number} detik\n * @returns {'aman'|'peringatan'|'kritis'}\n */\nexport function tingkatWaktu(detik) {\n  if (detik <= 60) return 'kritis'\n  if (detik <= 300) return 'peringatan'\n\n  return 'aman'\n}\n"}

```jsx
import { ErrorBoundary } from 'react-error-boundary'
import Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'
import { Tombol } from '../../shared/ui/Tombol.jsx'

/**
 * Pagar error khusus ulangan: fail-open — jangan biarkan satu error render
 * membuat murid kehilangan sesi pengerjaan; jawaban tetap ada di cadangan lokal.
 * @param {{ children: import('react').ReactNode }} props
 */
export default function BatasGalatUlangan({ children }) {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary
      fallbackRender={({ error, resetErrorBoundary }) => (
        <div className="kartu-soft p-4">
          <Banner jenis="salah" judul="Layar ulangan tersendat">
            <p className="mb-2">Jawaban yang sudah kamu isi tetap tersimpan di perangkat ini. Coba tampilkan lagi layar ulangan.</p>
            <p className="teks-lembut small mb-3">Catatan teknis: {error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'galat tidak dikenal'}</p>
            <Tombol onClick={resetErrorBoundary}>Coba tampilkan lagi</Tombol>
          </Banner>
        </div>
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </ErrorBoundary>
  )
}
```
react-error-boundary v6 API: `ErrorBoundary` with `fallbackRender`. Also needs `onError` optional. Type of `error` in fallbackRender: `Error`. In v6, fallbackRender receives `{error, resetErrorBoundary}`. Type check may complain about `error.message` if error typed as Error — fine.

Hmm: does `react-error-boundary` v6 keep `fallbackRender`? v5/v6 support `fallbackRender` and `FallbackComponent`. Yes.

Auto submit when detik hits 0 and status berjalan:
```jsx
  useEffect(() => {
    if (attempt === undefined || attempt.status !== 'berjalan') return
    if (detik === 0 && !sudahKumpul && !sedangKirim) void kumpulkan(true)

```
Dependencies: `kumpulkan` is a function declared with `function` inside the component → stable? No, recreated each render; including it in deps would loop. Since it's a function declaration inside the component body, referencing it inside the effect is fine (uses latest closure at each render? no — the effect closure captures the render's `kumpulkan`). To keep it simple and avoid lint warnings, use a ref for submit: `const kumpulkanRef = useRef(() => {})` and assign each render: `kumpulkanRef.current = kumpulkan`. Then the effect calls `kumpulkanRef.current(true)`.

Note: eslint `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` will complain about missing deps (a warning, not error) — the repo tolerates 2 existing warnings; let me avoid new warnings by using refs and including all used values.

Better approach for auto-submit: use a `useEffect` with deps [detik, attempt?.id, attempt?.status, sudahKumpul, sedangKirim] and call an internal async function defined inside the effect:
```jsx
useEffect(() => {
  if (detik > 0 || sudahKumpul || sedangKirim) return
  if (attempt === undefined || attempt.status !== 'berjalan') return
  const timer = window.setTimeout(() => void kirimSekarang(), 0)
  return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
}, [detik, sudahKumpul, sedangKirim, attempt, kirimSekarang])
```
`kirimSekarang` defined with `useCallback` to be stable-ish: `const kirimSekarang = useCallback(async (otomatis) => {...}, [attempt, jawaban, ...])`. Deps change often but that's fine (effect re-runs, timer resets).

Simplest robust: define `kirimSekarang` via useCallback with deps [attempt, bersihkan, kunciIdempotensi, navigate, tandaiTerkirim]. Inside, it reads `antrean.current` and current `jawaban` — using `jawaban` from closure. Since auto-submit only happens at detik===0, the closure will be from the latest render anyway (as the effect re-runs each second with fresh closure).

Let me write `kirimSekarang` with useCallback and deps [attempt, bersihkan, kunciIdempotensi, navigate, tandaiTerkirim]; inside it flushes the queue (`antrean.current`) — no need for `jawaban` state. That keeps deps small and avoids stale data issues (the queue holds unsent answers).

Flush logic:
```jsx
async function kirimAntrean(idAttempt) {
  const entri = [...antrean.current.entries()]
  antrean.current.clear()
  for (const [questionId, nilai] of entri) {
    try {
      await kirimJawaban(idAttempt, Number(questionId), nilai)
      tandaiTerkirim(idAttempt, Number(questionId))
    } catch (galat) {
      const status = /** @type {number|undefined} */ (galat?.response?.status)
      if (status === undefined || status === 408 || status === 429 || status >= 500) {
        antrean.current.set(questionId, nilai)
      } else {
        tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat))
      }
    }
  }
}
```
This one doesn't need to be a callback (no deps except tandaiTerkirim).

`kirimSekarang(otomatis)`:
```jsx
const kirimSekarang = useCallback(async (otomatis) => {
  if (attempt === undefined || sedangKirimRef.current) return
  sedangKirimRef.current = true
  setSedangKirim(true)
  try {
    if (timerKirim.current) { window.clearTimeout(timerKirim.current); timerKirim.current = 0 }
    await kirimAntrean(attempt.id)
    const kunci = kunciIdempotensi(attempt.id, kunciIdempotensiBaru)
    const hasil = await kumpulkanAttempt(attempt.id, kunci)
    bersihkan(attempt.id)
    setSudahKumpul(true)
    tampilkanToast('sukses', otomatis ? 'Waktu habis — jawaban terkumpul otomatis.' : 'Jawaban terkumpul.')
    navigate(ruteHasil(attempt.id), { replace: true })
    return hasil
  } catch (galat) {
    tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat))
  } finally {
    sedangKirimRef.current = false
    setSedangKirim(false)
  }
}, [attempt, bersihkan, kunciIdempotensi, navigate])
```
Hmm `kirimAntrean` is defined in component scope; used inside useCallback → not in deps → lint warning about missing dependency `kirimAntrean`. To avoid, define `kirimAntrean` as a module-level function taking (idAttempt, antrean, tandaiTerkirim). Let me do that — cleaner and testable.

Also autosave scheduling:
```jsx
function ubahJawaban(soalId, nilai) {
  if (attempt === undefined) return
  setJawaban((lama) => ({ ...lama, [String(soalId)]: nilai }))
  catat(attempt.id, soalId, nilai)
  antrean.current.set(String(soalId), nilai)
  if (timerKirim.current === 0) {
    timerKirim.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      timerKirim.current = 0
      void jalankanAntrean()
    }, JEDA_KIRIM)
  }
}
```
`jalankanAntrean` = async wrapper that calls module-level kirimAntrean then, if queue non-empty, schedules retry:
```jsx
async function jalankanAntrean() {
  if (attempt === undefined) return
  await kirimAntrean(attempt.id, antrean.current, tandaiTerkirim)
  if (antrean.current.size > 0 && timerUlang.current === 0) {
    timerUlang.current = window.setTimeout(() => { timerUlang.current = 0; void jalankanAntrean() }, JEDA_ULANG)
  }
}
```

1. `jalankanAntrean` accessed before declared (self-reference inside useCallback). Fix: use a ref-based approach: define `jalankanAntreanRef` and a plain function; or restructure so the retry doesn't self-reference: extract the retry scheduling into a separate callback that uses a ref.

Cleaner approach: use a single ref holding the runner:
```js

const jalankanAntrean = useCallback(async () => {
  if (attempt === undefined) return
  await kirimAntrean(attempt.id, antrean.current, tandaiTerkirim)
  if (antrean.current.size > 0 && timerUlang.current === 0) {
    timerUlang.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      timerUlang.current = 0
      void jalankanAntreanRef.current()
    }, JEDA_ULANG)
  }
}, [attempt, tandaiTerkirim])

// simpan versi terbaru untuk percobaan ulang
jalankanAntreanRef.current = jalankanAntrean
```
Assigning a ref during render — the compiler lint may complain? Probably fine (it's a ref mutation). Actually ESLint react-hooks may flag "ref access during render". Safer:
```js

```
That's an effect assigning a ref (not setState) — allowed.

2. setState in effect body (the timer `detak()` called synchronously in effect, plus `void kumpulkan(true)`). Errors at line 170 (auto-submit) and probably the detak effect.

For the auto-submit effect: calling `kumpulkan(true)` → it calls setState synchronously (setSedangKirim(true)) inside the effect body. Fix: wrap in a timeout (defer), so setState happens in a callback:
```js

  return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
}, [...])
```
I already planned that; I wrote `void kumpulkan(true)` directly. Fix.

For the countdown effect calling `detak()` synchronously → setDetik in effect body → same rule error. Fix: don't call detak() immediately; instead compute initial value in the state initializer / on数据 arrival (we already do `setDetik(sisaDetikAttempt(...))` in the init effect... which also calls setState synchronously in an effect → error #3 probably).

Better: keep a ref guard and fire from the interval callback:

jawaban), [String(soalId)]: nilai }))\n    catat(attempt.id, soalId, nilai)\n    antrean.current.set(String(soalId), nilai)\n\n    if (timerKirim.current === 0) {\n      timerKirim.current = window.setTimeout(() => {\n        timerKirim.current = 0\n        void jalankanRef.current()\n      }, JEDA_KIRIM)\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (mulainya.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Menyiapkan ulangan…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (mulainya.isError || attempt === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Ulangan belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-3\">\n          Mungkin gurumu belum menerbitkan kuis ini, jadwalnya belum mulai, atau sudah berakhir.\n        </p>\n        <TombolTaut to={RUTE.kuis} varian=\"tepi\">\n          Kembali ke daftar ulangan\n        </TombolTaut>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  if (attempt.status !== 'berjalan') {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"info\" judul=\"Ulangan ini sudah dikumpulkan\">\n        <p className=\"mb-3\">Hasilnya bisa kamu lihat di halaman hasil.</p>\n        <TombolTaut to={ruteHasil(attempt.id)}>Lihat hasil</TombolTaut>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const waktuHabis = detik === 0\n  const terjawab = attempt.soal.filter((satu) => jawaban[String(satu.id)] !== undefined).length\n  const tingkat = tingkatWaktu(detik)\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"row justify-content-center\">\n      <div className=\"col-lg-9\">\n        <div className=\"kartu-soal p-3 p-md-4 mb-3\">\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-3\">\n            <div className=\"me-auto\">\n              <h1 className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-0\">{attempt.judul_kuis ?? 'Ulangan'}</h1>\n              <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-0\">\n                {attempt.mapel_nama ?? '—'} · {attempt.kelas_nama ?? '—'} · {attempt.jumlah_soal} soal\n              </p>\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"text-end\">\n              <span className=\"teks-lembut small d-block\">Sisa waktu</span>\n              <span className={`timer-ulangan ${tingkat}`} role=\"timer\">\n                {formatSisa(detik)}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"text-end\">\n              <span className=\"teks-lembut small d-block\">Terjawab</span>\n              <span className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-0\">\n                {terjawab} / {attempt.soal.length}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {waktuHabis && (\n          <Banner jenis=\"peringatan\" judul=\"Waktu habis\">\n            <p className=\"mb-0\">Jawabanmu sedang dikumpulkan otomatis.</p>\n          </Banner>\n        )}\n\n        <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-3 mb-4\">\n          {attempt.soal.map((soal) => (\n            <section key={soal.id} className=\"kartu-soft p-3 p-md-4\" aria-label={`Soal nomor ${soal.nomor}`}>\n              <div className=\"d-flex align-items-baseline gap-2 mb-2\">\n                <h2 className=\"h6 fw-bold mb-0\">Soal {soal.nomor}</h2>\n                <span className=\"badge-status lembut\">{soal.tipe_label}</span>\n                <span className=\"teks-lembut small ms-auto\">{soal.skor} poin</span>\n              </div>\n\n              <RendererSoal\n                tipe={soal.tipe}\n                konten={soal.konten}\n                nilai={jawaban[String(soal.id)]}\n                onUbah={(nilai) => ubahJawaban(soal.id, nilai)}\n                dinonaktifkan={waktuHabis}\n                nama={`attempt-${attempt.id}-soal-${soal.id}`}\n              />\n            </section>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"kartu-soal p-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-3\">\n          <span className=\"teks-lembut small me-auto\">\n            Jawaban tersimpan otomatis. In status.js append:

```js
/**
 * ISO dari server → nilai <input type="datetime-local"> dalam waktu lokal.
 * @param {string|null} iso
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function keLokal(iso) {
  if (iso === null) return ''

  const waktu = new Date(iso)
  const duaDigit = (angka) => String(angka).padStart(2, '0')

  return (
    [waktu.getFullYear(), duaDigit(waktu.getMonth() + 1), duaDigit(waktu.getDate())].join('-') +
    `T${duaDigit(waktu.getHours())}:${duaDigit(waktu.getMinutes())}`
  )
}

/**
 * Nilai <input type="datetime-local"> (waktu lokal) → ISO UTC untuk server.
 * Tanpa konversi ini, jadwal yang diisi guru akan bergeser sebesar offset zona
 * waktu karena server menyimpan dalam UTC.
 * @param {string} lokal
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function keIso(lokal) {
  if (lokal === '') return null

  const waktu = new Date(lokal)
  return Number.isNaN(waktu.getTime()) ? null : waktu.toISOString()
}
```

First, `RankingService`.

```php
<?php declare(strict_types=1);
namespace App\Sections\Report\Services;

use App\Sections\Attempt\Enums\JenisAttempt;
use App\Sections\Attempt\Models\Attempt;
use App\Sections\Quiz\Models\Kuis;
use App\Sections\Settings\Enums\KunciPengaturan;
use App\Sections\Settings\Services\PengaturanService;

class RankingService
{
    public const BAWAAN_TOP = 10;
    public const TOP_MAKSIMAL = 50;

    public function __construct(private readonly PengaturanService $pengaturan) {}

    public function tampil(Kuis $kuis): bool
    {
        $peta = $this->pengaturan->semua((int)$kuis->school_id, (int)$kuis->class_id, (int)$kuis->getKey())['pengaturan'];
        return (bool) ($peta[KunciPengaturan::Ranking->value]['nilai'] ?? KunciPengaturan::Ranking->bawaan());
    }

    /** seluruh peringkat (tanpa dipotong) */
    public function semua(Kuis $kuis): array
    {
        $baris = Attempt::query()
            ->join('students', 'students.id', '=', 'attempts.student_id')
            ->join('users', 'users.id', '=', 'students.user_id')
            ->where('attempts.quiz_id', $kuis->getKey())
            ->where('attempts.jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
            ->where('attempts.asli', true)
            ->whereNotNull('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')
            ->orderByDesc('attempts.skor')
            ->orderBy('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')
            ->orderBy('users.name')
            ->get([
                'attempts.id as attempt_id',
                'attempts.skor',
                'attempts.skor_maksimal',
                'attempts.jumlah_benar',
                'attempts.jumlah_soal',
                'attempts.dikumpulkan_at',
                'students.id as murid_id',
                'users.name as nama',
            ]);

        $hasil = [];
        foreach ($baris as $i => $satu) {
            $maks = (float) $satu->skor_maksimal;
            $hasil[] = [
                'peringkat' => $i + 1,
                'attempt_id' => (int) $satu->attempt_id,
                'murid_id' => (int) $satu->murid_id,
                'nama' => (string) $satu->nama,
                'skor' => (float) $satu->skor,
                'skor_maksimal' => $maks,
                'persen' => $maks > 0 ? round((float)$satu->skor / $maks * 100, 1) : 0.0,
                'jumlah_benar' => (int) $satu->jumlah_benar,
                'jumlah_soal' => (int) $satu->jumlah_soal,
                'dikumpulkan_at' => $satu->dikumpulkan_at,
            ];
        }
        return $hasil;
    }
}
```

class LaporanTagService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PengaturanService $pengaturan) {}

    /** @return array{ambang_paham:int, ambang_mulai_paham:int, data_minimum:int} */
    public function ambang(int $sekolahId, ?int $kelasId = null, ?int $kuisId = null): array
    {
        $peta = $this->pengaturan->semua($sekolahId, $kelasId, $kuisId)['pengaturan'];
        return [
            'ambang_paham' => (int) ($peta[KunciPengaturan::AmbangPaham->value]['nilai'] ?? 80),
            'ambang_mulai_paham' => (int) (...),
            'data_minimum' => (int) (...),
        ];
    }

    public function untukMurid(Murid $murid, array $ambang): array
    {
        $attempts = Attempt::query()
            ->where('student_id', $murid->getKey())
            ->where('jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
            ->where('asli', true)
            ->whereNotNull('dikumpulkan_at')
            ->with(['jawaban', 'kuis.soal.tag'])
            ->get();

        $tema = [];
        foreach ($attempts as $attempt) {
            $kuis = $attempt->kuis;
            $jawaban = $attempt->jawaban->keyBy('question_id');
            foreach ($kuis->soal as $soal) {
                $tag = $soal->tag;
                if ($tag === null) continue;
                $kunci = $tag->getKey();
                $tema[$kunci] ??= ['tag_id'=>$tag->getKey(), 'tag_nama'=>$tag->nama, 'jumlah'=>0, 'benar'=>0];
                $tema[$kunci]['jumlah']++;
                $baris = $jawaban->get($soal->getKey());
                if ($baris?->benar === true) $tema[$kunci]['benar']++;
            }
        }
        // hitung tingkat
        foreach ($tema as $k => $t) {
            $persen = $t['jumlah'] > 0 ? round($t['benar']/$t['jumlah']*100,1) : 0.0;
            $tema[$k]['persen'] = $persen;
            $tema[$k]['tingkat'] = $this->tingkat($t['jumlah'], $persen, $ambang);
        }
        usort...
        return array_values($tema);
    }

    public function tingkat(int $jumlah, float $persen, array $ambang): string
    {
        if ($jumlah < $ambang['data_minimum']) return 'data_belum_cukup';
        if ($persen >= $ambang['ambang_paham']) return 'paham';
        if ($persen >= $ambang['ambang_mulai_paham']) return 'mulai_paham';
        return 'belum_paham';
    }
}
```

Also label map: paham → 'Paham', mulai_paham → 'Mulai paham', belum_paham → 'Belum paham', data_belum_cukup → 'Data belum cukup'.

/**
 * Kuis berjalan dengan 2 soal objektif bertag.
 * @return array{kuis: Kuis, tag: Tag, soal: array<int, int>}
 */
function siapkanKuis05(object $ctx, array $ubah = []): array
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([
        'acak_soal' => false, 'acak_opsi' => false, ...$ubah,
    ]);
    $tag = Tag::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah)->create();
    $a = Soal::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['tag_id' => $tag->id, 'skor' => 5]);
    $b = Soal::factory()->benarSalah()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel)->create(['tag_id' => $tag->id, 'skor' => 5]);
    $kuis->soal()->attach($a->id, ['urutan' => 1]);
    $kuis->soal()->attach($b->id, ['urutan' => 2]);
    return ['kuis' => $kuis->refresh(), 'tag' => $tag, 'soal' => [$a->id, $b->id]];
}
```

/** Label & kelas CSS untuk tingkat pemahaman. */
export function tingkatTampilan(tingkat) {
  switch (tingkat) {
    case 'paham': return { label: 'Paham', kelas: 'badge-status sukses' }
    case 'mulai_paham': return { label: 'Mulai paham', kelas: 'badge-status peringatan' }
    case 'belum_paham': return { label: 'Belum paham', kelas: 'badge-status salah' }
    default: return { label: 'Data belum cukup', kelas: 'badge-status lembut' }
  }
}

/** Kelas CSS lencana badge (emas/perak/perunggu/belum). */
export function kelasLencana(lencana) {
  switch (lencana?.kode) {
    case 'emas': return 'lencana lencana-emas'
    case 'perak': return 'lencana lencana-perak'
    case 'perunggu': return 'lencana lencana-perunggu'
    default: return 'lencana lencana-pendukung'
  }
}

/** Urutan peringkat: sudah dari server; sediakan pengurutan sisi klien untuk penyajian ulang. */
export function urutkanPeringkat(daftar) {
  return [...daftar].sort((a, b) => b.skor - a.skor || a.detik - b.detik || a.nama.localeCompare(b.nama))
}

- 🔧 `write_file` — {"path": "folder tanpa judul 2/lomba_m/frontend/src/sections/report/HalamanPeringkat.jsx", "instructions": "Add ranking page for slice 05.", "content": "/**\n * Halaman peringkat satu kuis (slice 05).\n *\n * Peringkat dihitung server HANYA dari skor asli (percobaan pertama), jadi\n * mengulang kuis tidak mengubah urutan. Bila guru mematikan saklar ranking,\n * murid melihat pesan kosong; guru tetap melihat data untuk laporan.\n */\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'\nimport { RUTE } from '../../routes.js'\nimport { useAuthStore } from '../auth/authStore.js'\nimport { ambilPeringkat } from './api.js'\n\nexport default function HalamanPeringkat() {\n  const { kuisId } = useParams()\n  const idKuis = Number(kuisId)\n  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user)\n  const sebagaiGuru = user?.role === 'guru' || user?.role === 'admin'\n\n  const peringkat = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['peringkat', idKuis],\n    queryFn: () => ambilPeringkat(idKuis, 20),\n    enabled: Number.isInteger(idKuis) && idKuis > 0,\n  })\n\n  const data = peringkat.data\n\n  if (peringkat.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Menyusun peringkat…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (peringkat.isError || data === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Peringkat belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-3\">Peringkat ini tidak tersedia untukmu.</p>\n        <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={RUTE.kuis}>\n          Kembali ke daftar kuis\n        </Link>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"row justify-content-center\">\n      <div className=\"col-lg-9\">\n        <div className=\"kartu-soft p-4 p-md-5\">\n          <h1 className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-1\">Peringkat · {data.judul_kuis}</h1>\n          <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-3\">\n            Dihitung dari <strong>nilai asli</strong> (percobaan pertama). Bila nilainya sama, yang\n            lebih cepat mengumpulkan naik; bila masih sama, urut nama.\n          </p>\n\n          {!data.tampil && (\n            <Banner jenis=\"info\" judul=\"Ranking sedang dimatikan guru\">\n              <p className=\"mb-0\">\n                {sebagaiGuru\n                  ? 'Murid tidak melihat peringkat sampai saklar ranking dinyalakan di pengaturan.'\n                  : 'Gurumu mematikan tampilan peringkat untuk kelas ini.'}\n              </p>\n            </Banner>\n          )}\n\n          {data.tampil && data.total === 0 && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Belum ada murid yang mengumpulkan ulangan ini.</p>\n          )}\n\n          {data.peringkat.length > 0 && (\n            <div className=\"table-responsive\">\n              <table className=\"table align-middle\">\n                <thead>\n                  <tr>\n                    <th scope=\"col\">#</th>\n                    <th scope=\"col\">Nama</th>\n                    <th scope=\"col\" className=\"text-end\">\n                      Skor\n                    </th>\n                    <th scope=\"col\" className=\"text-end\">\n                      Benar\n                    </th>\n                  </tr>\n                </thead>\n                <tbody>\n                  {data.peringkat.map((baris) => {\n                    const milikku = data.peringkat_saya?.murid_id === baris.murid_id\n\n                    return (\n                      <tr key={baris.attempt_id} className={milikku ? 'sorot-hangat' : undefined}>\n                        <td className=\"fw-bold\">{baris.peringkat}</td>\n                        <td>\n                          {baris.nama}\n                          {milikku && <span className=\"small ms-2\">(kamu)</span>}\n                        </td>\n                        <td className=\"text-end\">\n                          {baris.skor} / {baris.skor_maksimal} ({baris.persen}%)\n                        </td>\n                        <td className=\"text-end\">\n                          {baris.jumlah_benar} / {baris.jumlah_soal}\n                        </td>\n                      </tr>\n                    )\n                  })}\n                </tbody>\n              </table>\n            </div>\n          )}\n\n          {data.tampil && data.peringkat_saya === null && !sebagaiGuru && (\n            <p className=\"teks-lembut small\">\n              Kamu belum mengumpulkan ulangan ini, jadi belum masuk peringkat.\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          {data.total > data.peringkat.length && (\n            <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-0\">\n              Menampilkan {data.peringkat.length} peringkat teratas dari {data.total} peserta.\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4\">\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={`${RUTE.kuis}/${idKuis}`}>\n              Lihat kuis\n            </Link>\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-teks\" to={RUTE.kuis}>\n              Daftar kuis\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"}
- 🔧 `write_file` — {"path": "folder tanpa judul 2/lomba_m/frontend/src/sections/report/HalamanLaporan.jsx", "instructions": "Add teacher per-tag report page.", "content": "/**\n * Laporan pemahaman per tema untuk guru (slice 05).\n *\n * Setiap murid di kelas ditampilkan dengan tingkat per tema: paham, mulai\n * paham, belum paham, atau data belum cukup. Ambang dan jumlah data minimum\n * dibaca dari pengaturan tiga lapis, jadi guru bisa menyesuaikannya.\n */\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'\nimport { RUTE, rutePeringkat } from '../../routes.js'\nimport { ambilLaporanKuis } from './api.js'\nimport { ringkasTingkat, tingkatTampilan } from './tampilan.js'\n\nexport default function HalamanLaporan() {\n  const { id } = useParams()\n  const idKuis = Number(id)\n\n  const laporan = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['laporan', idKuis],\n    queryFn: () => ambilLaporanKuis(idKuis),\n    enabled: Number.isInteger(idKuis) && idKuis > 0,\n  })\n\n  const data = laporan.data\n\n  if (laporan.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Menghitung laporan…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (laporan.isError || data === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Laporan belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-3\">Laporan ini khusus guru.</p>\n        <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={RUTE.kuis}>\n          Kembali ke daftar kuis\n        </Link>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"row justify-content-center\">\n      <div className=\"col-lg-10\">\n        <div className=\"kartu-soft p-4 p-md-5\">\n          <h1 className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-1\">Laporan Tema · {data.judul_kuis}</h1>\n          <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-3\">\n            {data.mapel_nama ?? '—'} · kelas {data.kelas_nama ?? '—'} ·{' '}\n            <strong>hanya nilai asli</strong> yang dihitung. Paham ≥ {data.ambang.ambang_paham}%,\n            mulai paham ≥ {data.ambang.ambang_mulai_paham}%, dan tema baru dinilai setelah{' '}\n            {data.ambang.data_minimum} soal.\n          </p>\n\n          {data.murid.length === 0 && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Belum ada murid di kelas ini.</p>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-3\">\n            {data.murid.map((baris) => {\n              const ringkasan = ringkasTingkat(baris.tema)\n\n              return (\n                <section key={baris.murid_id} className=\"kartu-lembut p-3\">\n                  <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 mb-2\">\n                    <h2 className=\"h6 fw-bold mb-0\">{baris.nama}</h2>\n                    {ringkasan.paham > 0 && (\n                      <span className=\"badge-status sukses\">{ringkasan.paham} paham</span>\n                    )}\n                    {ringkasan.mulai_paham > 0 && (\n                      <span className=\"badge-status peringatan\">{ringkasan.mulai_paham} mulai paham</span>\n                    )}\n                    {ringkasan.belum_paham > 0 && (\n                      <span className=\"badge-status salah\">{ringkasan.belum_paham} belum paham</span>\n                    )}\n                  </div>\n\n                  {baris.tema.length === 0 && (\n                    <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-0\">Belum ada jawaban bertag dari murid ini.</p>\n                  )}\n\n                  <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-2\">\n                    {baris.tema.map((tema) => {\n                      const tampil = tingkatTampilan(tema.tingkat)\n\n                      return (\n                        <div key={tema.tag_id} className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2\">\n                          <span className=\"fw-semibold\" style={{ minWidth: '10rem' }}>\n                            {tema.tag_nama}\n                          </span>\n                          <span className={tampil.kelas}>{tampil.label}</span>\n                          <span className=\"teks-lembut small\">\n                            {tema.jumlah_benar}/{tema.jumlah_soal} benar ({tema.persen}%)\n                          </span>\n                        </div>\n                      )\n                    })}\n                  </div>\n                </section>\n              )\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4\">\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={rutePeringkat(idKuis)}>\n              Lihat peringkat\n            </Link>\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-teks\" to={`${RUTE.kuis}/${idKuis}`}>\n              Detail kuis\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"}
