- 🔧 `write_file` — {"path": "folder tanpa judul 2/lomba_m/frontend/src/sections/report/HalamanBadge.jsx", "instructions": "Add student badge page.", "content": "/**\n * Halaman badge murid (slice 05): lencana per mapel dari rata-rata nilai asli.\n */\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'\nimport { RUTE } from '../../routes.js'\nimport { ambilBadgeSaya } from './api.js'\nimport { kelasLencana } from './tampilan.js'\n\nexport default function HalamanBadge() {\n  const badge = useQuery({ queryKey: ['badge-saya'], queryFn: ambilBadgeSaya })\n  const data = badge.data\n\n  if (badge.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Membuka kotak lencana…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (badge.isError || data === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Lencana belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-0\">Halaman ini khusus murid yang sudah masuk.</p>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"row justify-content-center\">\n      <div className=\"col-lg-9\">\n        <div className=\"kartu-soft p-4 p-md-5\">\n          <h1 className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-1\">Lencana Saya</h1>\n          <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-3\">\n            Dihitung dari rata-rata <strong>nilai asli</strong> tiap mapel: emas ≥ 90, perak ≥ 75,\n            perunggu ≥ 60. Nilai ulangan ulang tidak dihitung supaya lencanamu tetap jujur.\n          </p>\n\n          <p className=\"mb-4\">\n            <span className=\"lencana lencana-pendukung\">{data.jumlah_lencana} mapel berlencana</span>\n          </p>\n\n          {data.badge.length === 0 && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">\n              Belum ada nilai. Kerjakan ulanganmu dulu, lencana akan muncul di sini.\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-3\">\n            {data.badge.map((satu) => (\n              <div\n                key={satu.mapel_id ?? satu.mapel_nama}\n                className=\"kartu-lembut p-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-3\"\n              >\n                <div className=\"me-auto\">\n                  <span className=\"fw-semibold d-block\">{satu.mapel_nama}</span>\n                  <span className=\"teks-lembut small\">\n                    {satu.jumlah_ulangan} ulangan · rata-rata {satu.rata_rata}%\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n                <span className={kelasLencana(satu.lencana)}>{satu.lencana.label}</span>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4\">\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={RUTE.progresTema}>\n              Lihat progres tema\n            </Link>\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-teks\" to={RUTE.kuis}>\n              Ulangan saya\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"}
- 🔧 `write_file` — {"path": "folder tanpa judul 2/lomba_m/frontend/src/sections/report/HalamanProgresTema.jsx", "instructions": "Add student per-theme progress page with remedial.", "content": "/**\n * Halaman progres tema murid (slice 05).\n *\n * Menampilkan pemahaman per tema + latihan remedial otomatis dari tema lemah.\n * Remedial hanya merekomendasikan soal; nilai asli tidak pernah berubah.\n */\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport Banner from '../../shared/ui/Banner.jsx'\nimport { RUTE } from '../../routes.js'\nimport { ambilProgresSaya } from './api.js'\nimport { kelasLencana, ringkasTingkat, tingkatTampilan } from './tampilan.js'\n\nexport default function HalamanProgresTema() {\n  const progres = useQuery({ queryKey: ['progres-saya'], queryFn: ambilProgresSaya })\n  const data = progres.data\n\n  if (progres.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Menyusun progres…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (progres.isError || data === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Progres belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-0\">Halaman ini khusus murid yang sudah masuk.</p>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const ringkasan = ringkasTingkat(data.tema)\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"row justify-content-center\">\n      <div className=\"col-lg-9\">\n        <div className=\"kartu-soft p-4 p-md-5\">\n          <h1 className=\"h5 fw-bold mb-1\">Progres Tema · {data.nama}</h1>\n          <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-3\">\n            Dihitung dari nilai asli. Paham ≥ {data.ambang.ambang_paham}% dan mulai paham ≥{' '}\n            {data.ambang.ambang_mulai_paham}%; tema dinilai setelah {data.ambang.data_minimum} soal.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4\">\n            <span className=\"badge-status sukses\">{ringkasan.paham} paham</span>\n            <span className=\"badge-status peringatan\">{ringkasan.mulai_paham} mulai paham</span>\n            <span className=\"badge-status salah\">{ringkasan.belum_paham} belum paham</span>\n            <span className=\"badge-status lembut\">{ringkasan.data_belum_cukup} belum cukup data</span>\n          </div>\n\n          {data.tema.length === 0 && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">\n              Belum ada tema yang bisa dinilai. Kerjakan ulangan bertag dulu ya.\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-3\">\n            {data.tema.map((tema) => {\n              const tampil = tingkatTampilan(tema.tingkat)\n\n              return (\n                <div key={tema.tag_id} className=\"kartu-lembut p-3\">\n                  <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2\">\n                    <span className=\"fw-semibold me-auto\">{tema.tag_nama}</span>\n                    <span className={tampil.kelas}>{tampil.label}</span>\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"bar-tema my-2\" role=\"img\" aria-label={`${tema.tag_nama}: ${tema.persen}%`}>\n                    <span style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, tema.persen))}%` }} />\n                  </div>\n                  <span className=\"teks-lembut small\">\n                    {tema.jumlah_benar}/{tema.jumlah_soal} soal benar ({tema.persen}%)\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n              )\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          <h2 className=\"h6 fw-bold text-uppercase teks-lembut mt-4 mb-2\">Latihan remedial</h2>\n\n          {!data.remedial.diaktifkan && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">\n              Remedial sedang dimatikan guru. Nilaimu tetap tersimpan dan bisa dilihat.\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          {data.remedial.diaktifkan && data.remedial.soal.length === 0 && (\n            <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">\n              Belum ada tema yang perlu diulang. Pertahankan ya!\n            </p>\n          )}\n\n          {data.remedial.diaktifkan && data.remedial.soal.length > 0 && (\n            <>\n              <p className=\"teks-lembut small\">\n                Soal-soal ini diambil dari tema yang masih lemah. Ini latihan tambahan — nilai aslimu\n                tidak berubah.\n              </p>\n              <div className=\"d-flex flex-column gap-2\">\n                {data.remedial.soal.map((soal) => (\n                  <div key={soal.id} className=\"kartu-soal p-3\">\n                    <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2\">\n                      <span className=\"badge-status lembut\">{soal.tipe_label}</span>\n                      <span className=\"badge-status info\">{soal.tag_nama ?? 'Tanpa tema'}</span>\n                      <span className=\"teks-lembut small ms-auto\">skor {soal.skor}</span>\n                    </div>\n                    <p className=\"mb-0 mt-2\">{soal.teks}</p>\n                  </div>\n                ))}\n              </div>\n            </>\n          )}\n\n          <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4\">\n            <Link className=\"btn btn-tepi\" to={RUTE.badge}>\n              Lencana saya\n            </Link>\n            <span className={kelasLencana(data.badge.badge[0]?.lencana)}>\n              {data.badge.jumlah_lencana} mapel berlencana\n            </span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"}

Scoring rules (PenilaianTeks::isian):
1. normalisasi(jawaban) & normalisasi(baku)

6. else false.

`kemiripanKata`: per-word tolerant matching — for each word in the reference, find a word in the answer with similar_text percent >= 80 (or levenshtein <= 1 for short words); also compare word counts roughly (allow ±? no). Actually spec: "toleransi typo per kata, kemiripan huruf > 80%".

```php
public static function kemiripanKata(string $baku, string $jawaban): float
{
    $a = self::kata($baku); $b = self::kata($jawaban);
    if ($a === [] || $b === []) return 0.0;
    $cocok = 0;
    foreach ($a as $kata) {
        foreach ($b as $i => $lain) {
            if (self::mirip($kata, $lain)) { $cocok++; unset($b[$i]); break; }
        }
    }
    return $cocok / max(count($a), count($b));  // hmm
}
```
Using max(count(a), count(b)) penalizes extra words — good (negation guard also). Let me use `$cocok / max(count($a), count($b))`.

`mirip($x,$y)`: identical → true; if both numeric → false (numbers must be exact); else similar_text percent >= 80.

Dipakai agar angka harus persis:\n     * \"1/2\" dan \"0,5\" tidak dianggap mirip, tetapi \"1,5\" dan \"1.5\" sama.\n     *\n     * @return array<int, string>\n     */\n    public static function angka(string $teks): array\n    {\n        preg_match_all('/\\d+(?:[.,]\\d+)?/u', $teks, $cocok);\n\n        return array_map(\n            static fn (string $satu): string => str_replace(',', '.', $satu),\n            $cocok[0],\n        );\n    }\n\n    public static function miripHuruf(string $a, string $b): float\n    {\n        $a = self::normalisasi($a);\n        $b = self::normalisasi($b);\n\n        if ($a === '' || $b === '') {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n\n        if ($a === $b) {\n            return 1.0;\n        }\n\n        similar_text($a, $b, $persen);\n\n        return $persen / 100;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Dua kata dianggap sama bila identik atau mirip ≥ 80%. Kata berupa angka\n     * tidak pernah dianggap mirip — angka harus persis.\n     */\n    public static function miripKata(string $a, string $b): bool\n    {\n        if ($a === $b) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        if ($a === '' || $b === '') {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        if (ctype_digit($a) || ctype_digit($b)) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return self::miripHuruf($a, $b) >= self::AMBANG_MIRIP_KATA;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Kemiripan per kata: setiap kata baku dicari pasangannya di jawaban.\n     * Hasil 0..1 dibagi jumlah kata terbanyak supaya kalimat yang terlalu\n     * panjang (mis. ditambah kata sanggahan) tidak otomatis lolos.\n     */\n    public static function kemiripanKata(string $baku, string $jawaban): float\n    {\n        $kataBaku = self::kata($baku);\n        $sisa = self::kata($jawaban);\n\n        if ($kataBaku === [] || $sisa === []) {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n\n        $cocok = 0;\n\n        foreach ($kataBaku as $kata) {\n            foreach ($sisa as $indeks => $lain) {\n                if (self::miripKata($kata, $lain)) {\n                    $cocok++;\n                    unset($sisa[$indeks]);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $cocok / max(count($kataBaku), count($sisa));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Penjaga negasi: ada kata negasi di jawaban murid yang tidak ada di\n     * jawaban baku.\n     *\n     * @param  array<int, string>  $baku  daftar jawaban baku/sinonim\n     * @param  array<int, string>  $negasi\n     */\n    public static function melawanNegasi(string $jawaban, array $baku, array $negasi = self::NEGASI_BAWAAN): bool\n    {\n        $kataJawaban = self::kata($jawaban);\n        $kataBaku = self::kata(implode(' ', $baku));\n\n        foreach ($negasi as $satu) {\n            $satu = self::normalisasi($satu);\n\n            if ($satu !== '' && in_array($satu, $kataJawaban, true) && !
```php
final class PenilaiSoal
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PenilaianObjektif $objektif,
        private readonly PenilaianTeks $teks,
    ) {}

    public function nilai(Soal $soal, mixed $jawaban): array
    {
        $tipe = $soal->tipeAman();
        if ($tipe === null) return Gagal;
        return $tipe->objektif() ? $this->objektif->nilai($soal,$jawaban) : $this->teks->nilai($soal,$jawaban);
    }
}
```

```php
function buatSoal06(object $ctx, string $tipe, array $konten, array $kunci, int $skor = 4): Soal
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);

    $respons = test()->postJson('/api/v1/soal', [
        'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id,
        'tipe' => $tipe,
        'konten' => $konten,
        'kunci' => $kunci,
        'skor' => $skor,
    ])->assertCreated();

    return Soal::query()->findOrFail((int) $respons->json('id'));
}

function kuis06(object $ctx, array $soal): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create([
        'acak_soal' => false, 'acak_opsi' => false,
    ]);

    foreach ($soal as $urutan => $satu) {
        $kuis->soal()->attach($satu->id, ['urutan' => $urutan + 1]);
    }

    return $kuis->refresh();
}

function kerjakan06(object $ctx, Kuis $kuis, Murid $murid, array $jawaban): Attempt
{
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($murid->user);
    $mulai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/kuis/{$kuis->id}/mulai")->assertCreated();
    $attemptId = (int) $mulai->json('id');
    foreach ($jawaban as $soalId => $nilai) {
        test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/jawab", ['question_id' => $soalId, 'jawaban' => $nilai])->assertOk();
    }
    test()->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$attemptId}/kumpulkan", ['idempotency_key' => 'kunci-'.uniqid()])->assertOk();
    return Attempt::query()->findOrFail($attemptId);
}
```

Isian rules tests:
- normalisasi: baku 'Jakarta', jawaban 'JAKARTA.' → true (punctuation removed, lowercase).
- sinonim: baku ['ibu kota indonesia'], sinonim [['jakarta']], jawaban 'Jakarta' → true.
- typo per kata: baku 'gunung berapi' jawaban 'gunug berapi' → kemiripanKata: words ['gunung','berapi'] vs ['gunug','berapi'] → gunung~gunug similar_text ≥80? similar_text('gunung','gunug') = 5 common of 6/5 → percent = 2*5/(6+5)=90.9% ≥80 → true. So answer 'gunug berapi' → true. 
- angka persis: baku '12' jawaban '13' → false. Also baku '1/2' jawaban '1/2' → true; '0,5' vs '1/2' → angka ['0.5'] vs [] (1/2 has no decimals; digits: 1 and 2) → false. Good.
- negasi: baku 'air mengalir dari tempat tinggi', jawaban 'air tidak mengalir dari tempat tinggi' → negasi 'tidak' not in baku → false (even though similarity high).

- answer mentioning only 1 (klorofil, 1/4=0.25) → perlu_tinjau.

```js
export function kunciDariState(state) {
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.benarSalah) return { benar: state.benar }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.menjodohkan) return { pasangan: { ...state.pasangan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.mengurutkan) return { urutan: urutanDariItem(state.item) }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.letakKata) return { penempatan: { ...state.penempatan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.hubungKata) return { sambungan: { ...state.sambungan } }
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.isianSingkat) return kunciIsian(state)
  if (state.tipe === TIPE.uraian) return kunciUraian(state)
  return { jawaban: state.jawaban }
}
```

with helpers:

```js
export function kunciIsian(state) {
  const kunci = {
    jawaban_baku: state.jawabanBaku.map((satu) => satu.teks.trim()),
  }

  const sinonim = state.jawabanBaku.map((satu) =>
    satu.sinonim.split(',').map((alias) => alias.trim()).filter((alias) => alias !== ''),
  )
  if (sinonim.some((daftar) => daftar.length > 0)) kunci.sinonim = sinonim
  if (state.angkaPersis) kunci.angka_persis = true
  const ambang = Number(state.ambang)
  if (Number.isFinite(ambang) && ambang > 0 && ambang <= 1) kunci.ambang = ambang
  const negasi = daftarKata(state.negasi)
  if (negasi.length > 0) kunci.negasi = negasi
  return kunci
}
```
Hmm angka_persis: default backend is true. Only emit when false? Backend: `$angkaPersis = $kunci['angka_persis'] ?? true;`. Emitting true is harmless. But cleaner to emit only when false: `if (!state.angkaPersis) kunci.angka_persis = false`. Yes.

```js
export function kunciUraian(state) {
  const kunci = {
    kata_kunci: state.kataKunci.map((satu) => {
      const bobot = Number(satu.bobot)
      return Number.isFinite(bobot) && bobot > 0 && satu.bobot.trim() !== ''
        ? { teks: satu.teks.trim(), bobot }
        : { teks: satu.teks.trim() }
    }),
  }
  const ambang = Number(state.ambangLulus)
  if (state.ambangLulus.trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(ambang) && ambang > 0 && ambang <= 1) kunci.ambang_lulus = ambang
  const sinonim = sinonimUraian(state.sinonimUraian)
  if (Object.keys(sinonim).length > 0) kunci.sinonim = sinonim
  return kunci
}
```

```jsx
/**
 * Renderer isian singkat: satu kotak teks.
 * konten: { teks } · kunci: { jawaban_baku: [teks, …], sinonim?: [[alias, …]] }
 * nilai : string
 */
import MediaSoal from './MediaSoal.jsx'
import { daftarTeks, pisahKata, teksAman } from '../tipeSoal.js'

function kandidat(kunci, indeks) {
  const baku = daftarTeks(kunci.jawaban_baku)
  const sinonim = Array.isArray(kunci.sinonim) ? kunci.sinonim : []
  return [baku[indeks] ?? '', ...daftarTeks(sinonim[indeks])].filter((satu) => satu !== '')
}
```

'', ...daftarTeks(sinonim[indeks])].filter(\n    (satu) => satu !== '',\n  )\n}\n\n/** @param {import('./props.js').PropsSoal} props */\nexport default function SoalIsianSingkat({\n  konten,\n  kunci = {},\n  nilai,\n  onUbah,\n  dinonaktifkan = false,\n  tampilkanKunci = false,\n  nama = 'soal',\n}) {\n  const jawabanBaku = daftarTeks(kunci.jawaban_baku)\n  const semuaKandidat = jawabanBaku.map((_, indeks) => kandidat(kunci, indeks))\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"soal-render\">\n      <p className=\"soal-teks\">{teksAman(konten.teks)}</p>\n      <MediaSoal konten={konten} />\n\n      <input\n        className=\"form-control\"\n        type=\"text\"\n        name={nama}\n        aria-label=\"Jawaban isian singkat\"\n        value={typeof nilai === 'string' ? nilai : ''}\n        disabled={dinonaktifkan}\n        onChange={(e) => onUbah?.(e.target.value)}\n        placeholder={teksAman(konten.petunjuk) || 'Tulis jawabanmu…'}\n      />\n\n      {tampilkanKunci && semuaKandidat.length > 0 && (\n        <ul className=\"list-unstyled teks-lembut small mt-2 mb-0\">\n          {semuaKandidat.map((daftar, indeks) => (\n            <li key={indeks}>\n              <span className=\"badge-kunci\">Kunci</span> {daftar.join(' · ')}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"}

```js
export function jawabanTeks(jawaban) {
  if (jawaban === null || jawaban === undefined) return '(belum dijawab)'
  if (typeof jawaban === 'boolean') return jawaban ? 'Benar' : 'Salah'
  if (typeof jawaban === 'string') return jawaban.trim() === '' ? '(kosong)' : jawaban
  if (typeof jawaban === 'number') return String(jawaban)
  if (Array.isArray(jawaban)) return jawaban.map(...).join(', ')
  // peta id->nilai
  return Object.entries(jawaban).map(([k,v]) => `${k} → ${jawabanTeks(v)}`).join(', ')
}

export function ringkasKunci(kunci) {
  if (kunci === null || typeof kunci !== 'object') return '—'
  return Object.entries(kunci).map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${ringkasNilai(v)}`).join(' · ')
}
```

```js
  state.kata = [

    { id: 'P2', teks: 'Predikat' },
  ]
  state.penempatan = { W1: 'P1', W2: 'P2' }
  return state
}

/** State hubung kata valid. */

}
```

tampilan.test.js:
```js
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { jawabanTeks, kelasStatus, ringkasKunci } from '../../../sections/scoring/tampilan.js'

describe('jawabanTeks', () => {
  it('menandai jawaban kosong dan belum dijawab', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(null)).toBe('(belum dijawab)')
    expect(jawabanTeks(undefined)).toBe('(belum dijawab)')
    expect(jawabanTeks('   ')).toBe('(kosong)')
  })
  it('menampilkan boolean, angka, dan teks apa adanya', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(true)).toBe('Benar')
    expect(jawabanTeks(false)).toBe('Salah')
    expect(jawabanTeks(9)).toBe('9')
    expect(jawabanTeks('sembilan')).toBe('sembilan')
  })
  it('meringkas daftar dan peta jawaban bertingkat', () => {
    expect(jawabanTeks(['I2','I1'])).toBe('I2, I1')
    expect(jawabanTeks({ K1: 'N2', K2: 'N1' })).toBe('K1 → N2, K2 → N1')
    expect(jawabanTeks({ K1: null })).toBe('K1 → (belum dijawab)')
  })
})

describe('ringkasKunci', () => {
  it('menggabungkan bidang kunci jadi satu baris', () => {
    expect(ringkasKunci({ jawaban: 'B' })).toBe('jawaban: B')
    expect(ringkasKunci({ pasangan: { K1: 'N1' } })).toBe('pasangan: K1 → N1')
  })
  it('memberi tanda pisah untuk kunci kosong atau bukan objek', () => {
    expect(ringkasKunci({})).toBe('—')
    expect(ringkasKunci(null)).toBe('—')
    expect(ringkasKunci(['a'])).toBe('—')
  })
})

describe('kelasStatus', () => {
  it('memetakan status antrean ke kelas lencana', () => {
    expect(kelasStatus('perlu_tinjau')).toBe('badge-status peringatan')
    expect(kelasStatus('gagal')).toBe('badge-status salah')
    expect(kelasStatus('dinilai')).toBe('badge-status lembut')
  })
})
```

```js
    attempt_id: 2,
    question_id: 4,
    murid_id: 3,
    murid_nama: 'Ayu',
    no_attempt: 1,
    status: 'perlu_tinjau',

    tipe: 'uraian',

    jawaban: 'karena ...',
    kunci: { kata_kunci: [{ teks: 'jumlah' }] },
    skor_maksimal: 10,
    skor_sekarang: 4,
    dinilai_manual: false,
    ...ubah,
  }
}

describe('skema antrean koreksi', () => {

    expect(data.item[0].dinilai_manual).toBe(false)
    expect(data.alasan_min).toBe(10)
  })
  it('menolak item tanpa bidang wajib', () => {

  })
  it('menerima mapel/kelas kosong dan murid tanpa nama', () => {

    expect(data.item[0].murid_nama).toBeNull()
  })
})

})
```

```jsx
}
```

**Thinking (mentah):**

Issues in the script:
1. `byTeks` function is declared after use inside the function body — function declarations hoist, so fine. But it's messy: `const soalTeks = byTeks(bacaKembali)` then `function byTeks(peta)` ignores peta. Let me simplify: replace both with a direct mapping. Let me clean that up.

2. `mintaTokenPendek` uses `/v1/attempt/1/koreksi/token` with attempt id 1 — that's the dev DB attempt id 1. But the guru may not own it... Policy `AttemptPolicy::koreksi` requires guru. 10. **K9**: frontend: fetch the CSRF cookie once per app load and refresh on 419. Implement: in `client.js`, a module-level promise cache + interceptor: on 419 response → clear cache so the next call refetches. Then remove `await ambilCsrfCookie()` from each api.js function... but api.js calls it before mutations. Simpler approach that keeps behavior: keep calling `ambilCsrfCookie()` but make it idempotent/cached:

```js
let janjiCsrf = null
export async function ambilCsrfCookie({ segarkan = false } = {}) {
  if (segarkan) janjiCsrf = null
  janjiCsrf ??= axiosRoot.get('/sanctum/csrf-cookie').catch((g) => { janjiCsrf = null; throw g })
  return janjiCsrf
}
```
And in the response interceptor, on 419 → `janjiCsrf = null` (so the next request refetches). This satisfies K9 (not one network call per mutation) with a tiny diff and no call-site churn.

```php
    {
        if (! $user->hasVerifiedEmail()) {
            // Status hanya dinaikkan dari Pending: akun yang ditangguhkan sekolah
            // tidak boleh hidup kembali hanya karena tautan verifikasi diklik.

            if ($user->status === UserStatus::Pending) {

            }

            $user->forceFill($perubahan)->save();

            event(new Verified($user));
        }
    }
```

And kirimUlangPublik:
```php
    /**
     * Kirim ulang tautan verifikasi TANPA sesi (akun pending yang belum bisa masuk).
     * Penelusuran email + penjaga status sengaja di sini (bukan di controller)
     * supaya controller hanya bicara dengan service.
     */
    public function kirimUlangPublik(string $email): void
    {
        $email = mb_strtolower(trim($email));

        if ($email === '') {
            return;
        }

        $user = User::query()->where('email', $email)->first();

        // Pending (belum verifikasi) justru yang boleh kirim ulang; suspend/dihapus tidak.
        if ($user === null) {
            return;
        }

        if (in_array($user->status, [UserStatus::Suspended, UserStatus::Dihapus], true)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->kirimUlang($user);
    }
```

```php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Arch;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

/*

*/

arch('setiap berkas PHP di app memakai strict_types')
    ->expect('App')
    ->toUseStrictTypes();

arch('tidak ada dd, dump, ray, atau var_dump di kode aplikasi')
    ->expect(['dd', 'dump', 'ray', 'var_dump'])
    ->not->toBeUsed();

/**
 * Semua namespace controller dari seluruh section, dibaca dari struktur folder
 * supaya section baru (slice berikutnya) otomatis ikut diperiksa.
 *
 * @return array<int, string>
 */
function namespaceController(): array
{
    $hasil = [];

    foreach (glob(app_path('Sections/*/Http/Controllers'), GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [] as $folder) {
        $section = basename(dirname(dirname($folder)));
        $hasil[] = 'App\\Sections\\'.$section.'\\Http\\Controllers';
    }
```

## Yang dikerjakan
5 commit (`edbbce1` → `0b9ef1e`), sudah di-push (`54b1bd8..0b9ef1e`):
1. **Auth**: tautan reset → frontend, status verifikasi hanya naik dari `Pending`, anti-timing `Hash::check` dummy, throttle 2 lapis (5/menit per ip|email **+ 20/menit per IP**), closure `/v1/sesi` → `CekSesiController` (route:cache jalan), kirim-ulang verifikasi pindah ke service.
2. **Satu penulis peran** (`User::tetapkanPeran`) + `ArchitectureTest` benar-benar memeriksa.
3. **Scaffold backend dibersihkan** + root `GET /` → `302 → frontend`.
4. **Frontend**: cache janji cookie CSRF + lupakan saat 419, normalisasi email dipusatkan.
5. **Dokumentasi A.10** + catatan demo + jurnal + log mentah + ekspor Word.

Snapshot inilah yang pertama dikirim, lalu aliran SSE melanjutkan\n * pembaruannya; tanpa SSE, guru cukup memanggil ulang endpoint ini (polling).\n */\nclass MonitorService\n{\n    public function __construct(\n        private readonly PresenceService $presence,\n        private readonly KecuranganService $kecurangan,\n    ) {}\n\n    /**\n     * @return array<string, mixed>\n     */\n    public function snapshot(Kuis $kuis): array\n    {\n        // Sapuan sekali setiap guru membuka monitor: penjadwal cron tidak bisa\n        // lebih rapat dari satu menit, sedangkan status yang dilihat guru harus\n        // segar saat itu juga.\n        $this->presence->sapu();\n\n        $kuisId = (int) $kuis->getKey();\n        $hadir = $this->presence->daftar($kuis);\n        $petaHadir = [];\n\n        foreach ($hadir as $entri) {\n            $petaHadir[$entri['attempt_id']] = $entri;\n        }\n\n        $ringkasanKecurangan = $this->kecurangan->ringkasan($kuis);\n\n        $attempt = Attempt::query()\n            ->where('quiz_id', $kuisId)\n            ->with(['murid.user'])\n            ->orderBy('attempt_no')\n            ->get();\n\n        $progres = $this->progres($kuisId);\n\n        $murid = [];\n\n        foreach ($attempt as $satu) {\n            $id = (int) $satu->getKey();\n            $kehadiran = $petaHadir[$id] ?? null;\n            $jumlahDijawab = $progres[$id] ?? 0;\n            $jumlahSoal = max(1, (int) $satu->jumlah_soal);\n\n            $murid[] = [\n                'attempt_id' => $id,\n                'student_id' => (int) $satu->student_id,\n                'nama' => $satu->murid?->user?->name,\n                'attempt_no' => (int) $satu->attempt_no,\n                'status' => $satu->status->value,\n                'status_label' => $satu->status->label(),\n                'dijawab' => $jumlahDijawab,\n                'jumlah_soal' => (int) $satu->jumlah_soal,\n                'persen' => (int) round($jumlahDijawab / $jumlahSoal * 100),\n                'online' => $kehadiran['online'] ?? false,\n                'detik_terakhir' => $kehadiran['detik_terakhir'] ?? null,\n                'skor' => $satu->skor,\n                'kecurangan' => $ringkasanKecurangan[$id] ?? [\n                    'jumlah' => 0,\n                    'skor_tertinggi' => 0,\n                    'belum_ditinjau' => 0,\n                ],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'kuis' => [\n                'id' => $kuisId,\n                'judul' => $kuis->judul,\n                'status' => $kuis->status->value,\n                'kelas_nama' => $kuis->kelas?->nama,\n            ],\n            'murid' => $murid,\n            'jumlah_online' => count(array_filter($murid, static fn (array $m): bool => $m['online'] === true)),\n            'server_now' => Carbon::now()->toIso8601String(),\n            // Ambang ini dikirim supaya klien bisa menampilkan \\\"online/offline\\\"\n            // tanpa menebak sendiri.\n            'ambang_segar_detik' => PresenceService::AMBANG_SEGAR,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Jumlah soal terjawab per attempt (satu query untuk seluruh kuis).\n     *\n     * @return array<int, int>\n     */\n    private function progres(int $kuisId): array\n    {\n        $baris = DB::table('answers')\n            ->join('attempts', 'attempts.id', '=', 'answers.attempt_id')\n            ->where('attempts.quiz_id', $kuisId)\n            ->whereNotNull('answers.jawaban')\n            ->selectRaw('answers.attempt_id, COUNT(*) as jumlah')\n            ->groupBy('answers.attempt_id')\n            ->get();\n\n        $hasil = [];\n\n        foreach ($baris as $satu) {\n            $hasil[(int) $satu->attempt_id] = (int) $satu->jumlah;\n        }\n\n        return $hasil;\n    }\n}\n"}

waktu <= UMUR_ANTREAN_MS\n  })\n\n  // Sisakan yang paling baru bila melebihi batas.\n  return hidup.slice(-BATAS_ANTREAN)\n}\n\n/**\n * Buat pengirim kejadian untuk satu attempt.\n *\n * @param {object} opsi\n * @param {number} opsi.attemptId\n * @param {(attemptId: number, kejadian: Array<Record<string, unknown>>) => Promise<unknown>} opsi.kirim\n * @param {() => number} [opsi.jam]\n * @param {(kunci: string) => string | null} [opsi.baca]\n * @param {(kunci: string, nilai: string) => void} [opsi.tulis]\n * @param {() => void} [opsi.bersihkan]\n * @param {string} [opsi.kunciSimpan]\n * @returns {{\n *   catat: (kategori: string, rincian?: Record<string, unknown>) => boolean,\n *   jumlahTertunda: () => number,\n *   kirimSekarang: () => Promise<{ terkirim: number, gagal: boolean }>,\n * }}\n */\nexport function buatPengirimKejadian({\n  attemptId,\n  kirim,\n  jam = () => Date.now(),\n  baca = () => null,\n  tulis = () => {},\n  bersihkan = () => {},\n  kunciSimpan = `kejadian-ulangan-${attemptId}`,\n}) {\n  /** @type {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} */\n  let buffer = []\n  /** @type {Record<string, number>} */\n  const cooldown = {}\n\n  // Antrean dari sesi sebelumnya (mis. jaringan mati lalu halaman ditutup).\n  const tersimpan = baca(kunciSimpan)\n  if (tersimpan) {\n    try {\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(tersimpan)\n      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) buffer = rapikanAntrean(parsed, jam())\n    } catch {\n      // data rusak diabaikan; lebih baik kehilangan catatan daripada gagal ujian\n      bersihkan(kunciSimpan)\n    }\n  }\n\n  function simpan() {\n    if (buffer.length === 0) {\n      bersihkan(kunciSimpan)\n      return\n    }\n\n    tulis(kunciSimpan, JSON.stringify(buffer))\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Catat satu kejadian. Mengembalikan false bila ditolak dedupe.\n   *\n   * @param {string} kategori\n   * @param {Record<string, unknown>} [rincian]\n   */\n  function catat(kategori, rincian) {\n    const sekarang = jam()\n    const terakhir = cooldown[kategori] ?? 0\n\n    // Cooldown: kejadian yang sama tidak dicatat dua kali dalam jendela singkat\n    // (mis. tombol tempel ditekan berulang).\n    if (sekarang - terakhir < COOLDOWN_MS) {\n      return false\n    }\n\n    cooldown[kategori] = sekarang\n\n    const entri = {\n      kategori,\n      client_at: new Date(sekarang).toISOString(),\n    }\n\n    if (rincian !== undefined) {\n      entri.rincian = rincian\n    }\n\n    buffer = rapikanAntrean([...buffer, entri], sekarang)\n    simpan()\n\n    return true\n  }\n\n  function jumlahTertunda() {\n    return buffer.length\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Kirim seluruh antrean dalam kelompok maksimal 50.\n   */\n  async function kirimSekarang() {\n    if (buffer.length === 0) return { terkirim: 0, gagal: false }\n\n    let terkirim = 0\n    let gagal = false\n\n    while (buffer.length > 0) {\n      const kelompok = buffer.slice(0, BATAS_BERKELOMPOK)\n\n      try {\n        await kirim(attemptId, kelompok)\n        buffer = buffer.slice(kelompok.length)\n        terkirim += kelompok.length\n        simpan()\n      } catch (galat) {\n        gagal = harusCobaLagi(galat)\n\n        if (!gagal) {\n          // Ditolak permanen: buang agar antrean tidak macet selamanya.\n          buffer = buffer.slice(kelompok.length)\n          simpan()\n          continue\n        }\n\n        break\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { terkirim, gagal }\n  }\n\n  return { catat, jumlahTertunda, kirimSekarang }\n}\n"}

POLLING_LAMBAT : POLLING_CEPAT\n\n  const monitor = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['monitor', idKuis],\n    queryFn: () => ambilMonitor(idKuis),\n    enabled: Number.isInteger(idKuis) && idKuis > 0,\n    refetchInterval: selang,\n  })\n\n  const kejadian = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['kejadian', idKuis, saring],\n    queryFn: () => ambilKejadian(idKuis, saring || undefined),\n    enabled: Number.isInteger(idKuis) && idKuis > 0,\n    refetchInterval: selang,\n  })\n\n  // SSC: tiket sekali pakai → EventSource → pembaruan langsung.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!Number.isInteger(idKuis) || idKuis <= 0) return undefined\n\n    let batal = false\n    let sumber = null\n\n    async function sambung() {\n      try {\n        const tiket = await terbitkanTiketSse(idKuis)\n        if (batal) return\n\n        sumber = new EventSource(`${DASAR_REALTIME}/sse/monitor?tiket=${encodeURIComponent(tiket.tiket)}`)\n        sumberRef.current = sumber\n\n        sumber.onopen = () => setStatusSse('hidup')\n        sumber.onmessage = () => {\n          // Cukup minta data baru; bentuk payload tidak dipercaya klien.\n          void monitor.refetch()\n          void kejadian.refetch()\n        }\n        sumber.onerror = () => {\n          // Fail-open: tanpa SSE, polling sudah menutupi.\n          setStatusSse('polling')\n          sumber?.close()\n          sumberRef.current = null\n        }\n      } catch {\n        setStatusSse('polling')\n      }\n    }\n\n    void sambung()\n\n    return () => {\n      batal = true\n      sumber?.close()\n      sumberRef.current = null\n    }\n    // `monitor`/`kejadian` sengaja tidak jadi dependensi: menyambung ulang pada\n    // setiap refetch akan membuat tiket baru terus-menerus.\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [idKuis])\n\n  const data = monitor.data\n\n  const tertinggi = useMemo(() => {\n    if (data === undefined) return []\n\n    return [...data.murid].sort((a, b) => b.kecurangan.skor_tertinggi - a.kecurangan.skor_tertinggi).slice(0, 3)\n  }, [data])\n\n  async function tinjau(kejadianId, status) {\n    setSedangTinjau(kejadianId)\n\n    try {\n      await tinjauKejadian(kejadianId, status)\n      tampilkanToast('sukses', status === 'valid' ? 'Catatan ditandai valid.' : 'Catatan ditandai tidak valid.')\n      await kejadian.refetch()\n      await monitor.refetch()\n    } catch (galat) {\n      tampilkanToast('salah', pesanGalatApi(galat))\n    } finally {\n      setSedangTinjau(0)\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (monitor.isLoading) {\n    return <p className=\"text-body-secondary\">Memuat Live Monitor…</p>\n  }\n\n  if (monitor.isError || data === undefined) {\n    return (\n      <Banner jenis=\"salah\" judul=\"Live Monitor belum bisa dibuka\">\n        <p className=\"mb-3\">Mungkin kuis ini bukan milikmu, atau sesimu sudah berakhir.</p>\n        <TombolTaut to={RUTE.kuis} varian=\"tepi\">\n          Kembali ke daftar kuis\n        </TombolTaut>\n      </Banner>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const lencanaSse =\n    statusSse === 'hidup'\n      ? { kelas: 'sukses', teks: 'Langsung (SSE)' }\n      : statusSse === 'polling'\n        ? { kelas: 'lembut', teks: 'Polling 5 detik' }\n        : { kelas: 'lembut', teks: 'Menyambung…' }\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div className=\"d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 mb-3\">\n        <div className=\"me-auto\">\n          <h1 className=\"h4 fw-bold mb-0\">Live Monitor</h1>\n          <p className=\"teks-lembut small mb-0\">\n            {data.kuis.judul} · {data.kuis.kelas_nama ?? Catatan ini bahan tanya baik-baik, bukan bukti pelanggaran.\n          </p>\n        </Banner>\n      )}\n\n      <div className=\"kartu-soal p-0 mb-4 table-responsive\">\n        <table className=\"table align-middle mb-0\">\n          <caption className=\"px-3 small teks-lembut\">\n            Progres dan kehadiran diperbarui dari aktivitas murid; tab yang disembunyikan tetap dihitung hadir.\n          </caption>\n          <thead>\n            <tr>\n              <th scope=\"col\">Murid</th>\n              <th scope=\"col\">Kehadiran</th>\n              <th scope=\"col\">Progres</th>\n              <th scope=\"col\">Status</th>\n              <th scope=\"col\">Catatan</th>\n            </tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            {data.murid.length === 0 && (\n              <tr>\n                <td colSpan={5} className=\"teks-lembut\">\n                  Belum ada murid yang membuka kuis ini.\n                </td>\n              </tr>\n            )}\n\n            {data.murid.map((baris) => (\n              <tr key={baris.attempt_id}>\n                <td>\n                  <span className=\"fw-semibold\">{baris.nama ?? Confirmed: the Node process **crashed** with "Connection is closed." from ioredis. This happened when my cleanup ran: `pendengar.disconnect()` — ioredis's `disconnect()` closes the socket, and pending queued commands (the `subscribe` we awaited, or `unsubscribe`) throw an unhandled error that crashes the process.

Root cause: calling `disconnect()` while operations are queued causes ioredis to `flushQueue(new Error(CONNECTION_CLOSED_ERROR_MSG))` → unhandled promise rejection → process exit.

This is a **real bug** in my SSE cleanup path that would crash the realtime service in production whenever a guru closes the Live Monitor tab. That's exactly the kind of thing the smoke test caught. 

Fix: 
- Use `quit()` (graceful) instead of `disconnect()`, and await it; wrap in try/catch.
- Better: `unsubscribe()` first, then `quit()`. And attach the `error` handler to the subscriber so errors don't crash.
- Add a global safety: `process.on('unhandledRejection')`? Better to fix the cause: don't call disconnect during pending ops; use `quit()` inside an async function with catch, and also add `pendengar.on('error', ...)` so ioredis errors are handled (an unhandled 'error' event on an EventEmitter throws).

Actually the crash trace shows the error was thrown from within ioredis's close handler → it's the flushQueue rejecting queued commands. Those queued commands' promises are ours (the awaited subscribe) — but we await subscribe before registering the cleanup... Not necessarily: if the client closes while `subscribe` is still queued, the promise rejects → we catch it (in the try) — hmm, we do catch subscribe errors. But the trace shows `flushQueue` throwing synchronously inside the socket close handler, i.e. the rejection happens for a command whose promise has no handler → unhandledRejection → Node 22 default = crash.

Which command? Possibly a second `subscribe` retry, or the `unsubscribe` call I fire-and-forget in the cleanup (`pendengar.unsubscribe?.(...)` without await/catch!). Yes — in `bersihkan()` I call `pendengar.unsubscribe(...)` without catching its promise, then `disconnect()`. The unsubscribe promise rejects when the connection is closed → unhandled rejection → crash.

Fixes:
1. In `bersihkan`, await/catch properly: make it async-safe:
```js
const bersihkan = () => {
  clearInterval(keepalive)
  if (sudahBersih) return
  sudahBersih = true
  pendengar.removeListener?.('message', teruskan)
  // Lepas langganan lalu tutup dengan sopan; semua promise ditangani supaya
  // penutupan koneksi tidak pernah menjatuhkan service.
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => pendengar.unsubscribe?.(...kanal))
    .catch(() => {})
    .finally(() => {
      try { pendengar.quit?.() } catch {}
    })
}
```
2. Add `pendengar.on('error', ...)` to swallow connection errors on the subscriber.
3. Guard double cleanup (both `request.raw.on('close')` and `reply.raw.on('close')` fire).

Also for the main `redis` client, `redis.disconnect()` in onClose hook is fine.

**Thinking (mentah):**

Confirmed the bug: `reply.raw.writeHead(200, {...})` does NOT include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <origin>`. For a cross-origin `EventSource` (origin `http://localhost:5173` → `http://localhost:4000`), the browser requires the ACAO header on the response. Without it, the browser blocks and fires `onerror` — hence the console error and the frontend falls back to polling.

The origin check exists but no CORS header is emitted. So the "SSE langsung" state never engages; Live Monitor always falls back to polling. That's a functional defect in slice 07 that the summary claimed working ("SSE Live Monitor"). Actually the summary said the smoke test passed 21/21 — but the smoke test may not have asserted the SSE connection itself. Regardless, this is a real bug I should fix.

Fix: after validating the origin, echo it in `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` (and `Vary: Origin`). Also handle preflight? EventSource GET doesn't trigger preflight. So just ACAO on the SSE response.

Also for the 403/503/401 error responses, add ACAO too so the client can read status (optional).

```css
/* Kelas tombol Bootstrap masih dipakai di halaman guru; dipetakan ke variabel

.btn-outline-primary {
  --bs-btn-color: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-border-color: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-hover-bg: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-hover-color: var(--kartu);
  --bs-btn-hover-border-color: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-active-bg: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-active-color: var(--kartu);
  --bs-btn-active-border-color: var(--link);
  --bs-btn-disabled-color: var(--teks-lembut);
  --bs-btn-disabled-border-color: var(--garis-input);
  background-color: var(--kartu);
  color: var(--link);
  border: 2px solid var(--link);
}
```

Let me write it as:
```js
/**
 * @param {import('fastify').FastifyInstance} app
 * @param {string} url
 * @param {Record<string,string>} headers
 */
async function ambilHeader(app, url, headers) {
  await app.listen({ port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1' })
  const alamat = app.server.address()
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request(
      { host: '127.0.0.1', port: alamat.port, path: url, headers },
      (res) => {
        res.once('data', () => {
          resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers })
          req.destroy()
        })
        res.once('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers }))
      },
    )
    req.on('error', reject)
    req.end()
  })
}
```

```js
})
```

Found a potential security issue in the realtime service: **the Origin check is bypassable.** 

```js
const origin = request.headers.origin
if (typeof origin === 'string' && !daftarOrigin().includes(origin)) {
  return reply.code(403)...
}
```

If there's no `Origin` header (e.g., a server-side request, curl, or a malicious page that... hmm, browsers always send Origin for cross-origin requests including EventSource). So the check only applies when Origin is present. Browser always sends Origin for cross-origin EventSource. So an attacker's site would send its own Origin and be rejected. OK, so not exploitable from a browser. Non-browser clients (curl) don't send Origin → allowed, but they'd need a valid one-time ticket. Fine.

But wait — **the ticket is consumed for ANY origin?** No, the origin check happens before the GETDEL. Good.

Hmm, but is there a **CSRF/DoS** angle: any site can make a cross-origin request to `/sse/monitor?tiket=...`? They'd need the ticket which is only given to the guru via authorized API (and the ticket value is never in a URL the attacker can read).

OK. But here's a real bug: **`redis.getdel`** — `GETDEL` requires Redis 6.2+. ioredis supports it. If the Redis version is older, it throws → caught → 503. Fine.

Another: **`retryStrategy: () => null`** means the main redis connection never reconnects after failure. `lazyConnect: true` + `retryStrategy: () => null` → once the connection drops, ioredis won't retry, and `redis.status` becomes 'end'. Then `redis.status === 'waiting'` is false, so we call `redis.getdel(...)` on an ended connection → ioredis with maxRetriesPerRequest: 1 → throws "Connection is closed." → caught → 503. Hmm, but `redis.connect()` is never retried. So after the first Redis hiccup, realtime stays broken until restart. That's a real robustness issue. Tradeoff: changing retryStrategy alters behavior. Actually the existing test in the repo documents that they set retryStrategy to null deliberately? Let me check the tests.

Found a **real bug in `usePresence.js`**:

```js
export default function usePresence(opsi) {
  const { attemptId, aktif, jam = () => Date.now() } = opsi
  useEffect(..., [attemptId, aktif, jam])
```

`jam` defaults to a **new arrow function on every render**. So the `useEffect` dependency `jam` changes every render → the effect tears down and re-registers every render. For `HalamanKerjakan`, every keystroke causes a re-render (well, `ubahJawaban` triggers state change), so the presence timers reset constantly. Consequence: the 5-second interval restarts, `terakhirAktif` resets → the ping that should fire after 15s of inactivity NEVER fires, because `terakhirAktif` resets on every render (activity events also reset it, but only real activity). Actually resetting on re-render isn't "activity", so it's a subtle bug that makes pings less frequent. Also it re-adds/removes 3 window listeners on every render — wasteful ("unoptimize").

Same pattern issue: is it a real impact? The interval is cleared and recreated on each render; `terakhirAktif = jam()` resets. Actually, there IS a safe middle ground that preserves fail-open: use a bounded retryStrategy and a bounded connect:
```js
retryStrategy: (times) => (times > 3 ? null : Math.min(times * 200, 1000)),
```
With `maxRetriesPerRequest: 1` and `connectTimeout: 2000`, `connect()` would retry 3 times (~2s each?) then give up → status 'end' → 503. ## 1. Perbaikan dari zip — diterapkan apa adanya
- `AppServiceProvider`: tautan verifikasi pakai **tanda tangan relatif** (`URL::temporarySignedRoute(..., false)`) + limiter `verifikasi-klik` 120/menit — murid satu kelas di belakang NAT sekolah (satu IP) tidak lagi kena 429 hanya karena menekan tautan bersamaan.
- `bootstrap/app.php`: `InvalidSignatureException` pada rute `verification.verify` → **redirect ke halaman frontend**, bukan JSON 403 mentah.
- `routes/api.php`: `signed` → `signed:relative`.
- `HalamanVerifikasiEmail.jsx`: segarkan user setelah `?status=berhasil` (tanpa ini, tombol “Masuk sekarang” memantul balik ke `/perlu-verifikasi`).
- 3 test regresi baru (host berbeda, tautan kedaluwarsa) — **31 test auth lulus**.

## 2. Bug yang saya temukan sendiri & perbaiki

**#1 — Fitur isian singkat & uraian tidak bisa diterbitkan (berat).**
`KuisService::galatKelengkapan()` masih menolak semua soal non-objektif: *“Tahap ini baru mendukung soal objektif (…)”.* Jadi guru yang menyusun kuis berisi uraian/isian dan menekan **Terbitkan** dapat 422 — padahal penilaian bertingkat + antrean koreksi sudah ada sejak slice 06. Test slice 06 tidak menangkapnya karena helper `kuisSoal06()` membuat kuis lewat factory `berjalan()`, mem-bypass endpoint publikasi.
→ Saya buktikan dulu (test baru **merah** dengan 422 asli), lalu ganti penjaganya menjadi “jenisnya dikenal mesin penilaian” (`RegistryTipeSoal::dukung`) + pakai `tipeAman()` agar baris bertipe rusak tidak melempar `ValueError`. Test sekarang **hijau**.

**#2 — Jawaban terakhir hilang diam-diam saat “Kumpulkan”.**
`kumpulkan()` di `HalamanKerjakan.jsx` mengabaikan hasil `kirimAntrean`: kalau jaringan putus tepat saat menekan Kumpulkan, jawaban yang gagal terkirim tidak pernah masuk, attempt tetap dikumpulkan, **cadangan lokal dihapus**, dan murid dinilai 0 untuk soal itu.
→ Sekarang kumpul manual mencoba ulang antrean (3× dengan jeda 700 ms), dan bila masih gagal **tidak** mengumpulkan: muncul pesan “Sebagian jawaban belum tersimpan…”. Cadangan lokal hanya dihapus bila semua benar-benar tersimpan. Kumpul otomatis saat waktu habis tetap mengirim apa adanya (perilaku lama dipertahankan — kalau tidak, murid bisa macet tak bisa submit).

**#3 — Kunci layar `focus_lock` habis jauh lebih cepat dari 60 detik.**
Tiap `blur` memasang interval baru tanpa mematikan yang lama; keluar jendela 3× = hitungan 3× lebih cepat.
→ Sekarang satu penghitung saja.

**#4 — Effect presence bongkar-pasang di setiap render.**
`usePresence` memakai nilai bawaan `jam = () => Date.now()` di destructuring → referensi baru tiap render → 3 pendengar `window` dilepas-dipasang terus dan jendela 15 detik direset, sehingga ping penambal praktis tak pernah jalan.
→ Jam bawaan diangkat jadi satu referensi modul.

## 4. Tradeoff yang saya temukan tapi **sengaja tidak** saya sentuh
1. **Redis realtime tidak auto-reconnect** (`retryStrategy: () => null`). Setelah Redis restart, `/sse/monitor` balas 503 terus sampai service Node dijalankan ulang — Live Monitor nyangkut di mode polling. Memperbaikinya berarti menukar fail-fast 503 dengan `connect()` yang bisa menggantung; itu menyentuh inti perilaku fail-open slice 07, jadi saya lepaskan.
2. **Race tulis peta presence** (`Cache::get` → ubah → `Cache::put` tanpa lock). Dua murid yang ping bersamaan bisa saling menimpa sehingga lencana “online” salah. memperbaikinya menambah kunci di jalur panas yang dipanggil setiap request attempt; dampaknya hanya kosmetik di layar guru.
3. **`LaporanTagService::untukKuis` N+1** — satu set query berat per murid. Untuk 40 murid ini pelan; perbaikannya perlu agregasi ulang di SQL.
4. **Attempt macet**: attempt `aktif` yang ditinggalkan melewati deadline tidak pernah ditutup, sehingga murid itu tidak bisa mencoba lagi selamanya (tombol Mulai menyulut attempt lama). Perlu job pembersih/auto-kumpul — perubahan kebijakan, bukan sekadar tambalan.
5. **Tenancy ringan**: `KuisService::sinkronSoal` memvalidasi soal hanya dengan `exists:questions,id`, tidak `school_id`. Aman sekarang (aplikasi satu sekolah), berbahaya bila multi-sekolah.
6. Dua fix frontend (#2, #3) **belum punya test otomatis**: repo ini tidak memakai `@testing-library/react`, jadi mengujinya berarti menambah dependensi baru. Saya tidak melakukannya sesuai aturan repo.

```php
it('attempt yang ditinggalkan jauh lewat deadline ditutup otomatis dan murid bisa mencoba lagi', function (): void {
    $kuis = siapkanKuis($this);
    $hasil = mulaiUlangan($this, $kuis);
    $soalId = (int) $hasil['soal'][0]['id'];

    // Jawaban sempat tersimpan sebelum murid menutup tab.
    $this->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$hasil['attempt']}/jawab", [
        'question_id' => $soalId,
        'jawaban' => 'a',
    ])->assertOk();

    // Tab ditutup lalu dibuka lagi 10 menit setelah deadline (di luar toleransi 120 detik).
    Attempt::query()->whereKey($hasil['attempt'])->update(['deadline_at' => Carbon::now()->subMinutes(10)]);

    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($this->murid->user);
    $kedua = $this->postJson("/api/v1/kuis/{$kuis->id}/mulai")->assertCreated();

    $lama = Attempt::query()->findOrFail($hasil['attempt']);
    expect((int) $kedua->json('id'))->not->toBe($hasil['attempt'])
        ->and($lama->status->value)->toBe('selesai')
        ->and($lama->aktif)->toBeNull()
        ->and($lama->terlambat)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($lama->dikumpulkan_at)->not->toBeNull()
        // Jawaban yang sempat tersimpan tetap dinilai, bukan dibuang.
        ->and((int) $lama->jawaban()->count())->toBe(2)
        ->and((int) $kedua->json('attempt_no'))->toBe(2);
});
```

CSRF token mismatch (419). The cookie jar path — let me debug. Issue: my `csrf()` function calls `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` then greps the jar for XSRF-TOKEN. The jar file format: `domain  flag  path  secure  expiry  name  value` → fields: 1=domain,2=flag,3=path,4=secure,5=expiry,6=name,7=value.
```python
class SimpanCookie(urllib.request.BaseHandler):
    def __init__(self, sesi): self.sesi = sesi
    def http_request(self, req):
        if self.sesi.cookies:
            req.add_header("Cookie", "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.sesi.cookies.items()))
        return req
    def http_response(self, req, resp):
        for h in resp.headers.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []:
            pasangan = h.split(";")[0]
            if "=" in pasangan:
                k, v = pasangan.split("=", 1)
                self.sesi.cookies[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        return resp
```

```php
    case Berisiko = 2;      // bisa memuat skrip/tautan keluar: PDF, SVG, dokumen kantor, HTML
```

Detection order:
1. empty → tidak dikenal
2. signatures:
   - `\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n` → image/png, aman
   - `\xFF\xD8\xFF` → image/jpeg, aman
   - `GIF87a`/`GIF89a` → image/gif, aman
   - `RIFF`+`WEBP` at 8 → image/webp, aman
   - `%PDF-` → application/pdf, berisiko
   - `PK\x03\x04` → zip container: look for `[Content_Types].xml`/`word/`/`ppt/` in cuplikan → docx/xlsx/pptx, berisiko (fallback application/zip berisiko)
   - `\xD0\xCF\x11\xE0\xA1\xB1\x1A\xE1` → OLE2 → application/x-ole-storage, berisiko
   - `ftyp` at 4 → video/mp4 or audio/mp4 → aman
   - `\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3` → video/webm, aman
   - `ID3` or MPEG frame sync (\xFF\xFB) → audio/mpeg, aman
   - `OggS` → audio/ogg, aman
   - `Rar!`/7z: `7z\xBC\xAF\x27\x1C` → berisiko? -> TidakDikenal? archives: berisiko (force download) — but we can't render anyway. Set berisiko.
   - text: if all bytes printable-ish (no NUL) → text/plain aman, unless starts with `<?xml` or contains `<svg` → image/svg+xml berisiko; if contains `<html`/`<!doctype html` → text/html berisiko.
3. else TidakDikenal.

Handle webp and wav both RIFF; need custom checks. Simpler to write explicit if-chain for correctness/clarity:

```php
public function kenali(string $isi): array
{
    $a = substr($isi, 0, 16);

    if (str_starts_with($a, "\xFF\xD8\xFF")) return $this->hasil('jpg','image/jpeg',Umum);
    if (str_starts_with($a, "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")) return ...
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'GIF87a') || str_starts_with($a, 'GIF89a')) gif
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'RIFF')) { if (substr($a,8,4)==='WEBP') webp; if (substr($a,8,4)==='WAVE') wav; }
    if (str_starts_with($a, '%PDF-')) pdf
    if (substr($a,4,4) === 'ftyp') → mp4 (video/mp4) — but m4a is ftypM4A. Could be audio. Keep 'mp4' => 'video/mp4' with Amn? For audio m4a, mime 'audio/mp4'. Simplify: 'mp4'/'video/mp4'.
    if (str_starts_with($a, "\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3")) webm (video/webm)
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'OggS')) ogg (audio/ogg)
    if (str_starts_with($a, 'ID3') || (ord($a[0])===0xFF && (ord($a[1]) & 0xE0) === 0xE0)) mp3
    if (str_starts_with($a, "PK\x03\x04")) → zip => Berisiko, ext 'zip', mime 'application/zip'
    if (str_starts_with($a, "Rar!\x1A\x07")) rar risky
    if (str_starts_with($a, "7z\xBC\xAF\x27\x1C")) 7z risky
    // Teks berbahaya / tak dikenal: SVG & XML & HTML harus jatuh ke TidakDikenal (tidak pernah Aman).
    return hasil('bin', 'application/octet-stream', TidakDikenal);
}
```

```php
class MateriService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PenyimpananMateri $penyimpanan) {}

    public function simpan(Sekolah $sekolah, User $pembuat, array $data): Materi
    {
        $materi = Materi::query()->create([
            'school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(),
            'subject_id' => $data['subject_id'],
            'class_id' => $data['class_id'],
            'tag_id' => $data['tag_id'] ?? null,
            'judul' => $data['judul'],
            'deskripsi' => $data['deskripsi'] ?? null,
            'status' => StatusMateri::Draf,
            'urutan' => (int) ($data['urutan'] ?? 0),
            'dibuat_oleh' => $pembuat->getKey(),
        ]);

        return $materi;
    }

    public function perbarui(Materi $materi, array $data): Materi { ... }

    public function hapus(Materi $materi): void {
        // hapus berkas
        foreach ($materi->unggahan()->get() as $u) { $this->penyimpanan->hapus($u); }
        $materi->delete();
    }

    public function sinkronBlok(Materi $materi, array $blok): Materi
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($materi, $blok) {
            $materi->blok()->get(); // ...
            foreach (array_values($blok) as $i => $satu) {
                $urutan = $i + 1;
                $tipe = TipeBlok::from((string) $satu['tipe']);
                $isi = null; $quizId = null;
                if ($tipe->berkuis()) { $quizId = $this->validasiKuis($materi, (int)$satu['quiz_id']); }
                else { $isi = $this->validasiIsi($materi, $tipe, (array)($satu['isi'] ?? [])); }
                BlokMateri::query()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['material_id' => $materi->getKey(), 'urutan' => $urutan],
                    ['tipe' => $tipe, 'wajib' => (bool)($satu['wajib'] ?? true), 'isi' => $isi, 'quiz_id' => $quizId],
                );
            }
            BlokMateri::query()->where('material_id', $materi->getKey())->where('urutan','>', count($blok))->delete();
        });
        return $materi->refresh()->load('blok.kuis');
    }

    public function publikasi(Materi $materi): Materi {
        // require minimal 1 blok
        if ($materi->blok()->count() === 0) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['blok' => 'Materi belum punya blok apa pun.']);
        $materi->forceFill(['status' => StatusMateri::Publikasi, 'publikasi_at' => now()])->save();
        return $materi->refresh();
    }
```

```php
class LaporanMateriService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly LaporanTagService $tag) {}

    public function untukMateri(Materi $materi): array
    {
        $materi->loadMissing(['kelas','mapel','tag','blok.kuis.soal.tag']);
        $ambang = $this->tag->ambang((int)$materi->school_id, (int)$materi->class_id, null);

        $blok = $materi->blok; // ordered

        $murid = Murid::query()->where('class_id', $materi->class_id)->with('user')->orderBy('id')->get();

        $progres = ProgresMateri::query()
            ->where('material_id', $materi->getKey())
            ->with(['attempt.jawaban'])
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('student_id');

        $daftar = [];
        foreach ($murid as $satuMurid) {
            $barisMurid = $progres->get($satuMurid->getKey()) ?? collect();
            $perBlok = [];
            $temaKumpul = []; // tag_id => ['tag_id','tag_nama','jumlah_soal','jumlah_benar']
            $selesaiWajib = 0; $jumlahWajib = 0;
            $skorLatihan = 0.0; $skorMaks = 0.0;

            foreach ($blok as $satuBlok) {
                $baris = $barisMurid->firstWhere('block_id', $satuBlok->getKey());
                $status = $baris?->status->value ?? 'belum';
                if ($satuBlok->wajib) { $jumlahWajib++; if ($status === 'selesai') $selesaiWajib++; }

                $attempt = $baris?->attempt;
                if ($satuBlok->tipe->berkuis() && $attempt?->status === StatusAttempt::Selesai) {
                    $skorLatihan += (float)$attempt->skor;
                    $skorMaks += (float)$attempt->skor_maksimal;
                    $jawaban = $attempt->jawaban->keyBy('question_id');
                    foreach ($satuBlok->kuis?->soal ?? [] as $soal) {
                        $tag = $soal->tag; if ($tag === null) continue;
                        $kunci = (int)$tag->getKey();
                        $temaKumpul[$kunci] ??= ['tag_id'=>$kunci,'tag_nama'=>$tag->nama,'jumlah_soal'=>0,'jumlah_benar'=>0];
                        $temaKumpul[$kunci]['jumlah_soal']++;
                        if ($jawaban->get($soal->getKey())?->benar === true) $temaKumpul[$kunci]['jumlah_benar']++;
                    }
                }

                $perBlok[] = [
                    'block_id' => $satuBlok->getKey(),
                    'urutan' => $satuBlok->urutan,
                    'tipe' => $satuBlok->tipe->value,
                    'tipe_label' => $satuBlok->tipe->label(),
                    'wajib' => $satuBlok->wajib,
                    'status' => $status,
                    'status_label' => $baris?->status->label() ?? 'Belum dibuka',
                    'skor' => (float)($baris->skor ?? 0),
                    'attempt_id' => $baris?->attempt_id,
                    'dikumpulkan_at' => $attempt?->dikumpulkan_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ];
            }

            $tema = [];
            foreach ($temaKumpul as $satuTema) {
                $persen = $satuTema['jumlah_soal'] > 0 ? round($satuTema['jumlah_benar']/$satuTema['jumlah_soal']*100, 1) : 0.0;
                $tingkat = $this->tag->tingkat((int)$satuTema['jumlah_soal'], $persen, $ambang);
                $tema[] = [... 'persen'=>$persen,'tingkat'=>$tingkat,'tingkat_label'=>LaporanTagService::labelTingkat($tingkat)];
            }
            usort($tema, fn($a,$b)=>$a['persen'] <=> $b['persen']);

            $daftar[] = [
              'murid_id'=>, 'nama'=>$satuMurid->user?->name,
              'blok_selesai'=>collect($perBlok)->where('status','selesai')->count(),
              'jumlah_blok'=>count($blok),
              'selesai_wajib'=>$selesaiWajib,'jumlah_wajib'=>$jumlahWajib,
              'skor_latihan'=>round($skorLatihan,2),'skor_latihan_maksimal'=>round($skorMaks,2),
              'tema'=>$tema,'blok'=>$perBlok,
            ];
        }

        return [
          'materi'=>[...],
          'ambang'=>$ambang,
          'blok'=>[... map],
          'murid'=>$daftar,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
class MateriPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }
    public function view(User $user, Materi $materi): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        if (! $materi->terbit()) return false;
        $kelas = $user->murid?->class_id;
        return $kelas !== null && (int)$kelas === (int)$materi->class_id;
    }
    public function create/update/delete/publikasi/laporan → isGuru()
    public function kelolaBerkas(User $user, Materi $materi): bool  => isGuru()
}
```

```php
        return MateriResource::collection($daftar);
    }
```

```php
class BerkasController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananMateri $penyimpanan): Response
    {
        $unggahan = UnggahanMateri::query()->where('kode',$kode)->where('status', Selesai)->firstOrFail();
        $path = $unggahan->path;
        $namaUnduh = $unggahan->nama_asli; // for risky add .upload? ekstensi already 'upload' on disk
        // Cat 2/3: attachment + nama asli + '.upload'
        $headers = [
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Content-Type' => $unggahan->mime,
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
        ];
        if ($unggahan->kategori->bolehTampilLangsung()) {
            $headers['Content-Disposition'] = 'inline; filename="'.$this->bersih($namaUnduh).'"';
        } else {
            $headers['Content-Disposition'] = 'attachment; filename="'.$this->bersih($namaUnduh).'.upload"';
        }
        $prefix = config('material.x_accel_prefix');
        if (!empty($prefix)) {
            $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($unggahan);
            return response('', 200, $headers);
        }
        if (! Storage::disk(PenyimpananMateri::DISK)->exists($path)) abort(404);
        return response()->file(Storage::disk(...)->path($path), $headers);
    }
}
```

Dua hal yang selalu dikirim:\n *\n * - `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` — browser tidak boleh menebak tipe sendiri.\n * - Berkas kategori berisiko/tidak dikenal **wajib** diunduh (`attachment`),\n *   dengan nama berakhiran `.upload`, sehingga tidak pernah dijalankan inline.\n *\n * Bila ada reverse proxy (nginx) yang menyajikan langsung dari disk, header\n * `X-Accel-Redirect` dipakai supaya berkas besar tidak melewati PHP.\n */\nclass BerkasController extends Controller\n{\n    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananMateri $penyimpanan): Response\n    {\n        $unggahan = UnggahanMateri::query()\n            ->where('kode', $kode)\n            ->where('status', StatusUnggahan::Selesai->value)\n            ->firstOrFail();\n\n        $namaUnduh = $this->namaAman((string) $unggahan->nama_asli);\n        $tampilLangsung = $unggahan->kategori->bolehTampilLangsung();\n\n        $headers = [\n            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',\n            'Content-Type' => (string) $unggahan->mime,\n            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',\n            'Content-Disposition' => $tampilLangsung\n                ? 'inline; filename=\"'.$namaUnduh.'\"'\n                : 'attachment; filename=\"'.$namaUnduh.'.upload\"',\n        ];\n\n        $prefix = (string) config('material.x_accel_prefix', '');\n\n        if ($prefix !== '') {\n            $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($unggahan);\n\n            return response('', 200, $headers);\n        }\n\n        $path = (string) $unggahan->path;\n\n        if ($path === '' || ! $penyimpanan->disk()->exists($path)) {\n            abort(404, 'Berkas tidak ditemukan.');\n        }\n\n        return $this->berkas($penyimpanan->disk()->path($path), $headers);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @param  array<string, string>  $headers\n     */\n    private function berkas(string $path, array $headers): BinaryFileResponse\n    {\n        return response()->file($path, $headers);\n    }\n\n    /** Nama unduhan tanpa jalur maupun kuotasi yang bisa merusak header. */\n    private function namaAman(string $nama): string\n    {\n        $bersih = str_replace(['\"', \"\\r\", \"\\n\", '\\\\', '/'], '', $nama);\n\n        return $bersih === '' ? 'berkas' : mb_substr($bersih, 0, 120);\n    }\n}\n"}

```php
public function buka(Request $request, Materi $materi, BlokMateri $blok, ProgresMateriService $service, AttemptService $attemptService): JsonResponse
{
    $this->authorize('kerjakan', $materi);
    $pengguna = $request->user(); if null abort 401
    $hasil = $service->buka($materi, $blok, $pengguna);
    $payload = ['blok' => $hasil['blok'], 'attempt' => null];
    if ($hasil['attempt'] !== null) {
        $resource = new AttemptResource($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->soal = $attemptService->payloadSoal($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->jawaban = $attemptService->payloadJawaban($hasil['attempt']);
        $resource->proteksi = $attemptService->saklarAntiCheat($blok->kuis);
        $payload['attempt'] = $resource->resolve($request);  // resolve gives array
    }
    return response()->json($payload);
}
```

```php
        'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id,
        'tag_id' => $tagId,
        'tipe' => $tipe,
        'konten' => $konten,
        'kunci' => $kunci,

    ])->assertCreated();

}
```

```php
function m08Kuis(object $ctx, array $soal): Kuis
{
    $kuis = Kuis::factory()->untukSekolah($ctx->sekolah, $ctx->mapel, $ctx->kelas)->berjalan()->create(['acak_soal'=>false,'acak_opsi'=>false]);
    foreach (array_values($soal) as $urutan => $satu) { $kuis->soal()->attach($satu->id, ['urutan'=>$urutan+1]); }
    return $kuis->refresh();
}

function m08Materi(object $ctx, array $data = []): Materi  // via API
{
    auth()->forgetGuards(); Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);
    $id = (int) test()->postJson('/api/v1/materi', array_merge([
        'judul' => 'Materi Penjumlahan', 'subject_id' => $ctx->mapel->id, 'class_id' => $ctx->kelas->id, 'tag_id' => $ctx->tag->id,
    ], $data))->assertCreated()->json('id');
    return Materi::query()->findOrFail($id);
}

function m08Unggah(object $ctx, Materi $materi, string $nama, string $isi): array
{
    auth()->forgetGuards(); Sanctum::actingAs($ctx->guru);
    $mulai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/materi/{$materi->id}/unggahan", ['nama'=>$nama,'ukuran'=>strlen($isi)])->assertCreated();
    $kode = (string) $mulai->json('kode');
    $jumlah = (int) $mulai->json('jumlah_potongan');
    $chunk = (int) config('material.chunk_byte');
    for ($i=0;$i<$jumlah;$i++) {
        $bagian = substr($isi, $i*$chunk, $chunk);
        test()->putJson("/api/v1/unggahan/{$kode}/potongan/{$i}", ['isi_base64'=>base64_encode($bagian),'hash'=>hash('sha256',$bagian)])->assertOk();
    }
    $selesai = test()->postJson("/api/v1/unggahan/{$kode}/selesai")->assertOk();
    return ['kode'=>$kode,'response'=>$selesai];
}
```

Note `putJson` works for the route. Good.

For PNG bytes: minimal PNG signature `\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n` + some bytes.

```php
it('mengunggah materi berkategori umum dan menyajikannya lewat URL bertanda tangan', function (): void {
    $materi = m08Materi($this);
    $isi = "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".str_repeat('a', 100);

    expect($hasil['response']->json('kategori'))->toBe('umum')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('ekstensi'))->toBe('png')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('mime'))->toBe('image/png')
        ->and($hasil['response']->json('hash'))->toBe(hash('sha256',$isi));

    $unggahan = UnggahanMateri::query()->where('kode',$hasil['kode'])->firstOrFail();
    expect(Storage::disk('local')->exists((string) $unggahan->path))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Storage::disk('public')->exists((string) $unggahan->path))->toBeFalse();

    // Murid bisa memuat tanpa sesi, cukup URL bertanda tangan.
    auth()->forgetGuards();
    $url = (string) $hasil['response']->json('url');
    $respons = $this->get($url)->assertOk();
    expect($respons->headers->get('X-Content-Type-Options'))->toBe('nosniff')
        ->and($respons->headers->get('Content-Type'))->toBe('image/png')
        ->and($respons->headers->get('Content-Disposition'))->toContain('inline');
});
```

`handleLazyLoadingViolation`:
```php
public function handleLazyLoadingViolation($key)
{
    if (isset(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback)) {
        return call_user_func(static::$lazyLoadingViolationCallback, $this, $key);
    }
    if (! $this->exists || $this->wasRecentlyCreated) {
        return;
    }
    throw new LazyLoadingViolationException($this, $key);
}
```

Schemas based on actual server responses:

UnggahanResource: {kode, nama_asli, ekstensi, mime, kategori, kategori_label, tampil_langsung, ukuran, ukuran_manusia, jumlah_potongan, ukuran_potongan, hash, status, status_label, url}
BlokResource: {block_id, urutan, tipe, tipe_label, wajib, teks, unggahan_kode, keterangan, quiz_id, kuis_judul?, jumlah_soal?}
MateriResource: {id, judul, deskripsi, status, status_label, subject_id, class_id, tag_id, urutan, mapel_nama?, kelas_nama?, tema_nama?, publikasi_at, jumlah_blok?, blok?, unggahan?}
Murid list: {materi: [{id, judul, deskripsi, mapel_nama, tema_nama, jumlah_blok}]}
Ringkasan (GET /materi/{id}/progres): {materi:{id,judul,deskripsi,mapel_nama,tema_nama}, blok:[{block_id,urutan,tipe,tipe_label,wajib,status,status_label,skor}], jumlah_blok, selesai_wajib, jumlah_wajib, persen}
buka response: {blok: {...payload...}, attempt: attempt|null}
  - payload: {block_id, urutan, tipe, tipe_label, wajib, status, status_label, skor, teks?, media?, kuis?}
selesai response: {blok: {...}}
laporan: {materi:{...}, ambang:{...}, blok:[...], murid:[{murid_id,nama,blok_selesai,jumlah_blok,selesai_wajib,jumlah_wajib,skor_latihan,skor_latihan_maksimal,tema:[...],blok:[...]}]}

- ambilMateri() → GET /v1/materi
- ambilMateriDetail(id) → GET /v1/materi/{id}
- buatMateri(data) / ubahMateri(id, data) / hapusMateri(id)
- sinkronBlok(id, blok) → PUT /v1/materi/{id}/blok
- publikasiMateri(id)
- mulaiUnggahan(id, {nama, ukuran}) → POST
- kirimPotongan(kode, indeks, gumpalan, hash) → POST/PUT multipart: client.put(`/v1/unggahan/${kode}/potongan/${indeks}`, formData). Note: axios PUT with FormData works.

`unggahBerkas(materiId, berkas, opsi)`:
```js
export async function unggahBerkas(materiId, berkas, { onProgres } = {}) {
  await ambilCsrfCookie()
  const sesi = await mulaiUnggahan(materiId, { nama: berkas.name, ukuran: berkas.size })
  const gumpalan = potongBerkas(await berkas.arrayBuffer(), sesi.ukuran_potongan)
  for (let i = 0; i < gumpalan.length; i++) {
    await kirimPotongan(sesi.kode, i, gumpalan[i])
    onProgres?.(Math.round(((i + 1) / gumpalan.length) * 100))
  }
  return selesaikanUnggahan(sesi.kode)
}
```
Careful: `sesi.jumlah_potongan` may be less than gumpalan.length if chunking differs; use gumpalan.length.

potongBerkas(isi, ukuranPotongan):
```js
export function potongBerkas(isi, ukuranPotongan) {
  const ukuran = Number(ukuranPotongan) > 0 ? Number(ukuranPotongan) : 1024 * 1024
  const buffer = isi instanceof ArrayBuffer ? isi : new Uint8Array(isi).buffer
  const potongan = []
  for (let mulai = 0; mulai < buffer.byteLength; mulai += ukuran) {
    potongan.push(buffer.slice(mulai, Math.min(mulai + ukuran, buffer.byteLength)))
  }
  return potongan.length > 0 ? potongan : [new ArrayBuffer(0)]
}
```
Hmm, for empty file we send 1 empty chunk; backend rejects ukuran<=0 anyway.

kirimPotongan(kode, indeks, buffer):
```js
export async function kirimPotongan(kode, indeks, buffer) {
  await ambilCsrfCookie()
  const bentuk = new FormData()
  bentuk.append('potongan', new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/octet-stream' }), `potongan-${indeks}.bin`)
  const respons = await client.put(`/v1/unggahan/${kode}/potongan/${indeks}`, bentuk)
  return skemaResponsPotongan.parse(respons.data)
}
```

Pure UI helper `blokBerikutnya(ringkasan)`:
```js
export function blokBerikutnya(ringkasan) {
  const blok = [...(ringkasan?.blok ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.urutan - b.urutan)
  for (const b of blok) {
    if (b.wajib && b.status !== 'selesai') return b
  }
  return blok.find((b) => b.status !== 'selesai') ?? null
}
```
And `bolehDibuka(ringkasan, blok)`:
```js
export function bolehDibuka(ringkasan, blok) {
  const sebelumnya = (ringkasan?.blok ?? []).filter((b) => b.urutan < blok.urutan && b.wajib)
  return sebelumnya.every((b) => b.status === 'selesai')
}
```
These mirror the server's rule (and are tested).

karakter maksimal untuk satu panggilan alat di transkrip\n\n\ndef md5(berkas: str) -> str:\n    h = hashlib.md5()\n    with open(berkas, \"rb\") as f:\n        for potong in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b\"\"):\n            h.update(potong)\n    return h.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef gzip_byte_exact(sumber: str, tujuan: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Gzip isi berkas apa adanya (byte-exact setelah didekompresi).\"\"\"\n    with open(sumber, \"rb\") as masuk, gzip.open(tujuan, \"wb\", compresslevel=9) as keluar:\n        shutil.copyfileobj(masuk, keluar, length=1024 * 1024)\n\n\ndef ringkas(nilai, batas: int = POTONG_ALAT) -> str:\n    teks = nilai if isinstance(nilai, str) else json.dumps(nilai, ensure_ascii=False)\n    teks = \" \".join(teks.split())\n    return teks if len(teks) <= batas else teks[:batas] + \" …\"\n\n\ndef blok_ke_markdown(baris: list, blok: dict) -> None:\n    jenis = blok.get(\"type\")\n    if jenis == \"text\":\n        label = \"Thinking (mentah)\" if blok.get(\"textType\") == \"reasoning\" else \"Balasan\"\n        baris.append(f\"**{label}:**\\n\")\n        baris.append((blok.get(\"content\") or \"\") + \"\\n\")\n    elif jenis == \"tool\":\n        baris.append(f\"- 🔧 `{blok.get('toolName')}` — {ringkas(blok.get('input'))}\")\n    elif jenis == \"ask-user\":\n        baris.append(f\"- ❓ `ask_user` — {ringkas(blok.get('input'))}\")\n    elif jenis == \"mode-divider\":\n        baris.append(f\"- ⌁ mode: {blok.get('mode')}\")\n    else:\n        baris.append(f\"- ▪ blok `{jenis}` — {ringkas(blok)}\")\n\n\ndef tulis_transkrip(sesi: str, berkas_chat: str, tujuan: str) -> int:\n    pesan = json.load(open(berkas_chat, encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    baris: list = [\n        \"# Log Mentah — Transkrip Sesi\",\n        \"\",\n        \"Bantuan baca. - Report by murid (must be murid, cannot report own avatar).
- Rate limit: e.g., 10 reports per hour per murid (route throttle + per-murid check).

- Guru queue: list avatars with laporan pending (or hidden). Guru can: pulihkan (restore → visible, status Aktif, keep reports as tidak_valid) or hapus (delete file + mark) — both audited via activity('avatar').

AvatarPolicy:
```php
namespace App\Sections\Avatar\Policies;

class AvatarPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool { return true; }

    /** Lihat satu avatar: guru selalu; pemilik selalu; murid lain hanya bila aktif & sekelas. */
    public function lihat(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool
    {
        if ($user->isGuru()) return true;
        $profil = $user->murid;
        if ($profil === null) return false;
        if ((int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $avatar->student_id) return true;
        return $avatar->terlihatSemua() && (int) $profil->class_id === (int) ($avatar->murid?->class_id);
    }

    /** Murid mengunggah/menghapus avatarnya sendiri (punya profil murid). */
    public function unggah(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid() && $user->murid !== null; }

    public function hapusSendiri(User $user): bool { return $user->isMurid() && $user->murid !== null; }

    /** Melaporkan avatar teman. */
    public function lapor(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool
    {
        if (! $user->isMurid()) return false;
        $profil = $user->murid;
        if ($profil === null) return false;
        if ((int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $avatar->student_id) return false;
        return $avatar->terlihatSemua() && $this->lihat($user, $avatar);
    }

    /** Antrean moderasi + pulihkan/hapus: guru saja. */
    public function moderasi(User $user): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }

    public function delete(User $user, Avatar $avatar): bool { return $user->isGuru(); }
}
```

```php
class AvatarController extends Controller
{
    /** Avatar sendiri (atau penanda "pakai avatar bawaan"). */
    public function saya(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Avatar::class);
        $profil = $request->user()?->murid;
        if ($profil === null) return response()->json(['avatar' => null, 'bawaan' => true]);
        $avatar = Avatar::terkiniUntuk((int) $profil->getKey());
```
