```php
class BerkasAvatarController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananAvatar $penyimpanan): Response
    {
        $avatar = Avatar::query()->where('kode', $kode)->where('status','!=',Dihapus)->firstOrFail();
        $headers = [
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Content-Type' => (string) $avatar->mime,
            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'inline; filename="avatar-'.$avatar->kode.'.jpg"',
            // Gambar tidak pernah dieksekusi; CSP ketat sebagai lapis tambahan.
            'Content-Security-Policy' => "default-src 'none'; sandbox",
        ];
        $prefix = (string) config('avatar.x_accel_prefix','');
        if ($prefix !== '') { $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($avatar); return response('',200,$headers); }
        $path = (string) $avatar->path;
        if ($path === '' || ! $penyimpanan->disk()->exists($path)) abort(404, 'Gambar tidak ditemukan.');
        return response()->file($penyimpanan->disk()->path($path), $headers);
    }
}
```

Meski isinya selalu gambar hasil encode ulang server, responsnya\n * tetap dikunci: `nosniff`, `Content-Disposition: inline` dengan nama acak, dan\n * CSP `default-src 'none'; sandbox` supaya berkas ini tidak pernah menjadi\n * dokumen yang bisa menjalankan apa pun.\n */\nclass BerkasAvatarController extends Controller\n{\n    public function __invoke(string $kode, PenyimpananAvatar $penyimpanan): Response\n    {\n        $avatar = Avatar::query()\n            ->where('kode', $kode)\n            ->where('status', '!=', StatusAvatar::Dihapus->value)\n            ->firstOrFail();\n\n        $headers = [\n            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',\n            'Content-Type' => (string) $avatar->mime,\n            'Cache-Control' => 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',\n            'Content-Disposition' => 'inline; filename=\"avatar-'.$avatar->kode.'.jpg\"',\n            'Content-Security-Policy' => \"default-src 'none'; sandbox\",\n        ];\n\n        $prefix = (string) config('avatar.x_accel_prefix', '');\n\n        if ($prefix !== '') {\n            $headers['X-Accel-Redirect'] = $penyimpanan->pathInternal($avatar);\n\n            return response('', 200, $headers);\n        }\n\n        $path = (string) $avatar->path;\n\n        if ($path === '' || ! $penyimpanan->disk()->exists($path)) {\n            abort(404, 'Gambar tidak ditemukan.');\n        }\n\n        return new BinaryFileResponse($penyimpanan->disk()->path($path), 200, $headers);\n    }\n}\n"}

Private: direktori, encodePng.

For PNG encode:
```php
private function encodePng(string $isi): string
{
    try {
        $gambar = @imagecreatefromstring($isi);
    } catch (Throwable) { $gambar = false; }

    if (! $gambar instanceof \GdImage) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['unggahan' => 'Gambar jawaban tidak bisa dibaca.']);
    }

    ob_start();
    imagepng($gambar);
    $keluaran = (string) ob_get_clean();
    imagedestroy($gambar);

    if ($keluaran === '') throw ValidationException::withMessages([...]);

    return $keluaran;
}
```
Note: imagepng on a palette/truecolor image; for canvas-sourced PNG with alpha it's fine.

Should I also cap dimensions to prevent decompression bombs? Good practice: check imagesx/imagesy <= e.g. 6000 and pixel count <= 40M before re-encoding. GD's imagecreatefromstring already may allocate. Let me add a guard using getimagesizefromstring() before decoding:
```php
$info = @getimagesizefromstring($isi);
if ($info === false) → 422
[$lebar,$tinggi] = $info;
if ($lebar*$tinggi > 40_000_000) → 422 'Gambar terlalu besar dimensinya.'
```
Good — that's a real security measure worth adding.

rtrim((string) config('app.url'), '/').$relatif;\n    }\n\n    /** Lokasi internal berkas (untuk header X-Accel-Redirect). */\n    public function pathInternal(UnggahanJawaban $unggahan): string\n '.$satuan[$indeks];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Aturan \"boleh mengunggah sekarang?\" untuk satu attempt + soal.\n     *\n     * @throws ValidationException\n     */\n    private function pastikanBolehUnggah(\n        Attempt $attempt,\n        Soal $soal,\n        JenisUnggahanJawaban $jenis,\n        bool $izinRekam,\n    ): void {\n        if (! $attempt->berjalan()) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attempt' => 'Ulangan ini sudah dikumpulkan.']);\n        }\n\n        if (Carbon::now()->greaterThan($attempt->deadline_at)) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'attempt' => 'Waktu ulangan sudah habis; lampiran jawaban tidak bisa diunggah lagi.',\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        if (! $attempt->kuis->soal()->whereKey($soal->getKey())->exists()) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['question_id' => 'Soal itu bukan bagian dari kuis ini.']);\n        }\n\n        if ($jenis->perluIzin() && ! $izinRekam) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'jenis' => 'Rekaman diri belum diizinkan sekolah/guru untuk kuis ini.',\n            ]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Gambar kanvas: dibaca, dibatasi dimensinya, lalu **diencode ulang ke PNG**.\n     *\n     * @return array{0: string, 1: string, 2: KategoriBerkas, 3: string}\n     */\n    private function prosesGambarKanvas(string $isi, UnggahanJawaban $unggahan): array\n    {\n        $info = @getimagesizefromstring($isi);\n\n        if ($info === false) {\n            // Termasuk SVG/HTML yang dikirim dengan nama gambar: GD tidak bisa\n            // membacanya, jadi tidak pernah lolos sebagai \"gambar jawaban\".\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'unggahan' => 'Gambar jawaban tidak bisa dibaca. Coba kirim ulang gambarnya.',\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        if (((int) $info[0] * (int) $info[1]) > self::BATAS_PIKSEL) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'unggahan' => 'Gambar jawaban terlalu besar dimensinya.',\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        try {\n            $gambar = @imagecreatefromstring($isi);\n        } catch (Throwable) {\n            $gambar = false;\n        }\n\n        if (! $gambar instanceof \\GdImage) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['unggahan' => 'Gambar jawaban tidak bisa dibaca.']);\n        }\n\n        ob_start();\n        imagepng($gambar);\n        $keluaran = (string) ob_get_clean();\n        imagedestroy($gambar);\n\n        if ($keluaran === '') {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['unggahan' => 'Gagal menyiapkan gambar jawaban.']);\n        }\n\n        return ['png', 'image/png', KategoriBerkas::Umum, $keluaran];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Berkas biasa: kategori ditentukan **isi** berkas, bukan nama kiriman.\n     *\n     * @return array{0: string, 1: string, 2: KategoriBerkas, 3: string}\n     */\n    private function prosesBerkasBiasa(string $isi): array\n    {\n        $hasil = $this->klasifikasi->kenali($isi);\n        $ekstensiSajian = $hasil['kategori']->ekstensiSajian($hasil['ekstensi']);\n        $mimeSajian = $hasil['kategori']->bolehTampilLangsung() ? $hasil['mime'] : 'application/octet-stream';\n\n        return [$ekstensiSajian, $mimeSajian, $hasil['kategori'], $isi];\n    }\n\n    private function direktori(UnggahanJawaban $unggahan): string\n    {\n        return 'jawaban/'.$unggahan->school_id.'/'.$unggahan->kode;\n    }\n}\n"}

`createImageBitmap` is widely supported; fallback to raw file on failure.

```jsx
async function kePngKecil(berkas) {
  try {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(berkas)
    const skala = Math.min(1, sisiMaks / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height))
    const lebar = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * skala))
    const tinggi = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * skala))
    const kanvas = document.createElement('canvas')
    kanvas.width = lebar; kanvas.height = tinggi
    const konteks = kanvas.getContext('2d')
    if (!konteks) return berkas
    konteks.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, lebar, tinggi)
    const blob = await new Promise((r) => kanvas.toBlob((b) => r(b), 'image/png'))
    return blob ?? berkas
  } catch { return berkas }
}
```

useEffect(() => {

      perekam.current?.stop()

```php
private function susunMinta(array $chunk): array
{
    $barisSoal = [];
    $barisJawaban = [];

    foreach (array_values($chunk) as $indeks => $kandidat) {
        $nomor = $indeks + 1;
        $soal = $kandidat['soal'];
        $kunci = $soal->kunciSebagaiArray();
        $kataKunci = [];
        foreach (($kunci['kata_kunci'] ?? []) as $satu) {
            if (is_array($satu) && isset($satu['teks'])) $kataKunci[] = (string) $satu['teks'];
        }
        $rincian = [
            'nomor' => $nomor,
            'skor_maksimal' => (float) $soal->skor,
            'pertanyaan' => $this->pangkas((string) ($soal->kontenSebagaiArray()['teks'] ?? '')),
            'kata_kunci' => $kataKunci,
        ];
        if (isset($kunci['pembahasan']) && is_string($kunci['pembahasan']) && $kunci['pembahasan'] !== '') {
            $rincian['pembahasan_pembanding'] = $this->pangkas($kunci['pembahasan']);
        }
        $barisSoal[] = $rincian;
        // jawaban murid = DATA: ditulis di antara pembatas agar tidak dibaca sebagai perintah.
        $barisJawaban[] = ['nomor' => $nomor, 'jawaban' => $this->pangkas($kandidat['jawaban'])];
    }
    ...
}

Careful: json_encode with JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE may break out of the tag if answer contains `</jawaban_murid>`. Sanitize: strip `</jawaban_murid>` and `<jawaban_murid>` from answer text. Good defensive measure; test can assert.

Parsing:
```php
private function urai(?array $payload): array
{
    $isi = data_get($payload, 'choices.0.message.content');
    if (! is_string($isi)) $isi = data_get($payload, 'output_text');
    if (! is_string($isi)) {
        // sebagian server lokal mengembalikan JSON terstruktur apa adanya
        $langsung = data_get($payload, 'penilaian');
        return is_array($langsung) ? $langsung : [];
    }
    $isi = trim($isi);
    // Buang pagar markdown ```json ... ```
    if (str_starts_with($isi, '```')) { $isi = preg_replace('/^```[a-zA-Z]*\s*|\s*```$/', '', $isi) ?? $isi; }
    $data = json_decode($isi, true);
    if (! is_array($data)) {
        $awal = strpos($isi, '{'); $akhir = strrpos($isi, '}');
        if ($awal === false || $akhir === false || $akhir <= $awal) return [];
        $data = json_decode(substr($isi, $awal, $akhir - $awal + 1), true);
    }
    $penilaian = is_array($data) ? ($data['penilaian'] ?? $data) : [];
    return is_array($penilaian) ? array_values(array_filter($penilaian, 'is_array')) : [];
}
```

Then in `kirim`, map by `nomor`.

```php
private function kirim(array $chunk): array
{
    $kuis = config(...);
    try {
        $respons = Http::withToken((string) config('ai.kunci'))
            ->acceptJson()
            ->timeout((int) config('ai.timeout_detik'))
            ->connectTimeout(min(5, (int) config('ai.timeout_detik')))
            ->post((string) config('ai.url'), [
                'model' => (string) config('ai.model'),
                'temperature' => 0,
                'response_format' => ['type' => 'json_object'],
                'messages' => [
                    ['role' => 'system', 'content' => self::PERAN],
                    ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $minta['pengguna']],
                ],
            ]);
    } catch (Throwable) {
        // Jaringan/timeout: tidak pernah melempar keluar; guru tetap meninjau.
        return [];
    }

    if (! $respons->successful()) return [];

    $daftar = $this->urai($respons->json());
    $saran = [];
    foreach (array_values($chunk) as $indeks => $kandidat) {
        $nomor = $indeks + 1;
        $cocok = null;
        foreach ($daftar as $satu) { if ((int)($satu['nomor'] ?? 0) === $nomor) { $cocok = $satu; break; } }
        if ($cocok === null || ! isset($cocok['skor']) || ! is_numeric($cocok['skor'])) continue;
        $maks = (float) $kandidat['soal']->skor;
        $skor = (float) $cocok['skor'];
        if (! is_finite($skor)) continue;
        $saran[$kandidat['question_id']] = [
            'skor' => max(0.0, min($skor, $maks)),   // skor AI dibatasi rentang soal
            'alasan' => $this->pangkasAlasan(isset($cocok['alasan']) && is_string($cocok['alasan']) ? $cocok['alasan'] : ''),
        ];
    }
    return $saran;
}
```

Note negative clamp: max(0, ...). Test: skor -50 → 0; skor 999 → maks.

```php
final class NilaiAiAttempt implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithQueue, Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 1;
    public int $timeout = 120;

    public function __construct(public readonly int $attemptId) {}

    public function handle(PenilaiAiService $service): void
    {
        $attempt = Attempt::query()->find($this->attemptId);
        if ($attempt === null) return;
        $service->proses($attempt);
    }
}
```
Careful with `SerializesModels` + readonly promoted property: fine.

```php
public function proses(Attempt $attempt): int
{
    if (! $this->aktif()) return 0;

    $kandidat = $this->kandidat($attempt);
    if ($kandidat === []) return 0;

    $jumlah = 0;
    foreach ($this->bagi($kandidat) as $chunk) {
        foreach ($this->kirim($chunk) as $questionId => $satu) {
            if ($this->simpanSaran($questionId, $satu['skor'], $satu['alasan'])) $jumlah++;
        }
    }
    return $jumlah;
}

Add to `Attempt` model a scope `milikMurid($muridId)` that matches `student_id = X` OR (team attempt where the murid is a member). Something like:

```php
public function scopeMilikMurid(Builder $query, int $muridId): Builder
{
    return $query->where(function (Builder $q) use ($muridId): void {
        $q->where('student_id', $muridId)
          ->orWhereIn('team_id', function ($sub) use ($muridId): void {
              $sub->select('team_id')->from('team_members')->where('student_id', $muridId);
          });
    });
}
```
That's neat: with one scope, all three services (BadgeService, LaporanTagService, and anything using student_id) can include team attempts. Then replace `->where('student_id', $murid->getKey())` with `->milikMurid((int) $murid->getKey())` in BadgeService and LaporanTagService (both occurrences).     {

            $baris = Jawaban::query()
                ->where('attempt_id', $attempt->getKey())
                ->where('question_id', $soal->getKey())
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            $sebelum = $baris?->jawaban;

            if ($attempt->team_id !== null && $berubah) {
                $versi++;
            }

            $baris->forceFill([
                'jawaban' => $jawaban,
                'status' => StatusPenilaian::Menunggu,
                'benar' => null,
                'skor' => 0,
                'dinilai_at' => null,
                'penjawab_id' => $penjawabId ?? $baris->penjawab_id,
                'versi' => $versi,
            ])->save();

            // Riwayat versi hanya untuk jawaban bersama: di mode individu tidak

                    'question_id' => $soal->getKey(),
                    'student_id' => $penjawabId,
                    'versi' => $versi,
                    'jawaban' => $jawaban,
                ]);
            }

            return $baris;
        });
    }

Policy implementation:
```php
    private function milikMurid(User $user, Attempt $attempt): bool
    {
        $profil = $user->murid;

        if ($profil === null) {
            return false;
        }

        if ((int) $profil->getKey() === (int) $attempt->student_id) {
            return true;
        }

        // Mode tim: lembar jawaban milik tim, jadi semua anggotanya boleh.
        if ($attempt->team_id !== null) {
            return $attempt->tim()->whereHas('keanggotaan', static fn ($query) => $query->where('student_id', $profil->getKey()))->exists();
        }

        return false;
    }
```

class TimController extends Controller
{
    public function daftar(Kuis $kuis, TimService $service): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $kuis);
        return response()->json($service->daftar($kuis));
    }

    public function simpan(SimpanTimRequest $request, Kuis $kuis, TimService $service): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $kuis);
        $tim = null;
        if ($request->filled('tim_id')) { $tim = Tim::query()->findOrFail((int) $request->input('tim_id')); }
        $hasil = $service->simpan($kuis, $tim, (string) $request->input('nama'), array_map('intval', (array) $request->input('murid', [])));
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Tim tersimpan.', 'tim' => $hasil] + ...);
    }

    public function bagi(BagiTimRequest $request, Kuis $kuis, TimService $service): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $kuis);

private function semuaTim(Kuis $kuis): array
{
    $baris = Attempt::query()
        ->join('teams', 'teams.id', '=', 'attempts.team_id')
        ->where('attempts.quiz_id', $kuis->getKey())
        ->where('attempts.jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)
        ->where('attempts.asli', true)
        ->whereNotNull('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')
        ->orderByDesc('attempts.skor')->orderBy('attempts.dikumpulkan_at')->orderBy('teams.nama')
        ->get(['attempts.id as attempt_id','attempts.skor','attempts.skor_maksimal','attempts.jumlah_benar','attempts.jumlah_soal','attempts.dikumpulkan_at','teams.id as tim_id','teams.nama as tim_nama']);

    $hasil = [];
    foreach ($baris as $indeks => $satu) {
        $maksimal = (float) $satu->skor_maksimal;
        $hasil[] = [
            'peringkat' => $indeks + 1,
            'attempt_id' => (int) $satu->attempt_id,
            // murid_id null pada baris tim: yang dinilai adalah tim, bukan anak.

}

skemaTim>} DataTim\n * @typedef {z.infer<typeof skemaDaftarTim>} DataDaftarTim\n * @typedef {z.infer<typeof skemaMuridKelas>} DataMuridKelas\n */\n\n/**\n * @param {number} kuisId\n * @returns {Promise<DataDaftarTim>}\n */\nexport async function ambilDaftarTim(kuisId) {\n  const respons = await client.get(`/v1/kuis/${kuisId}/tim`)\n  return skemaDaftarTim.parse(respons.data)\n}\n\n/**\n * @param {number} kuisId\n * @param {{ tim_id?: number, nama: string, murid: number[] }} data\n * @returns {Promise<z.infer<typeof skemaHasilSimpanTim>>}\n */\nexport async function simpanTim(kuisId, data) {\n  await ambilCsrfCookie()\n  const respons = await client.post(`/v1/kuis/${kuisId}/tim`, data)\n  return skemaHasilSimpanTim.parse(respons.data)\n}\n\n/**\n * @param {number} kuisId\n * @param {number} jumlahTim\n * @returns {Promise<DataDaftarTim>}\n */\nexport async function bagiTimOtomatis(kuisId, jumlahTim) {\n  await ambilCsrfCookie()\n  const respons = await client.post(`/v1/kuis/${kuisId}/tim/bagi`, { jumlah_tim: jumlahTim })\n  return skemaDaftarTim.parse(respons.data)\n}\n\n/**\n * @param {number} kuisId\n * @param {number} timId\n * @returns const respons = await client.get(`/v1/kuis/${kuisId}/tim-saya`)\n  return skemaTimSaya.parse(respons.data)\n}\n\n/**\n * Jumlah tim yang masuk akal untuk sekian murid (dibulatkan ke bawah, minimal 2),\n * dipakai sebagai nilai awal kotak \"bagi otomatis\".\n *\n * @param {number} jumlahMurid\n * @param {number} ukuranIdeal  anggota per tim yang diinginkan\n * @returns {number}\n */\nexport function usulJumlahTim(jumlahMurid, ukuranIdeal = 3) {\n  if (jumlahMurid < 4) return 0\n\n  const ideal = Number.isFinite(ukuranIdeal) && ukuranIdeal > 0 ? Math.floor(ukuranIdeal) : 3\n\n  return Math.max(2, Math.min(20, Math.floor(jumlahMurid / ideal)))\n}\n\n/**\n * Murid yang belum masuk tim mana pun pada kuis ini.\n * @param {DataMuridKelas[]} muridKelas\n * @returns {DataMuridKelas[]}\n */\nexport function muridTanpaTim(muridKelas) {\n  return muridKelas.filter((murid) => murid.tim_id === null)\n}\n\n/**\n * Ringkasan satu tim untuk ditampilkan (nama + anggota, tanpa duplikat).\n * @param {DataTim} tim\n * @returns {string}\n */\nexport function ringkasAnggotaTim(tim) {\n  if (tim.anggota.length === 0) return 'belum ada anggota'\n\n  return tim.anggota.map((anggota) => anggota.nama).join(', ')\n}\n"}

Interesting — this test passed when run alone but fails when run with other Slice09 tests. Why? The assertion: POST tim {tim_id: Tim1, murid: [murid0, murid1]} expecting 422 "sudah masuk tim lain".

Tim1's members: round-robin by name, unknown mapping. `$this->murid[0]` and `$this->murid[1]` may both happen to be in Tim 1 (then no conflict → 200). When run alone, names happen to differ. Random names → flaky!

$this->postJson(..., ['tim_id' => $tim[0]->id, 'nama' => 'Tim 1', 'murid' => [$anggotaTimSatu[0]->id, $penyusup->id]])->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonValidationErrors(['murid']);
```
And for the other-class murid case: use `$anggotaTimSatu[1]->id` + `$muridLain->id` → 422 (murid not in class).

Note the nama 'Tim 1' must match the actual name of $tim[0]; `Tim::orderBy('nama')` first is "Tim 1" only if 2 teams named "Tim 1","Tim 2". Fine.

Line 149: `onClick={() => bagi.mutate(saranJumlah)}` — no; error says "Argument of type 'void' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'" at 149:52 → `onClick={() => buang.mutate(tim.id)}`? Let's think: mutate is typed `(variables: void) => void` because `mutationFn: (timId) => hapusTim(nomor, timId)` — I annotated `(timId)` without a type, so TS infers `timId: void`?? Actually with `useMutation({ mutationFn: (timId) => hapusTim(nomor, timId) })`, TS infers TVariables from the callback's parameter type which is implicitly `any`... but checkJs with noImplicitAny would complain. Hmm, it inferred `void` — likely because `hapusTim(nomor, timId)` requires number and... whatever.

Fix: annotate the mutationFn params explicitly:
```js
const bagi = useMutation({
  mutationFn: (/** @type {number} */ jumlah) => bagiTimOtomatis(nomor, jumlah),
  ...
})
const buang = useMutation({
  mutationFn: (/** @type {number} */ timId) => hapusTim(nomor, timId),
```
Then errors at 237/283 ("number not assignable to void") are `buang.mutate(tim.id)` — resolved by the same fix.

Pada mode tim, semua anggota mendapat baris\n *   dengan skor tim yang sama (persis seperti aturan \"skor dibagi sama\"), sehingga\n *   ekspor ini langsung bisa dipakai sebagai buku nilai.\n * - Sel diamankan dari CSV injection dengan pengaman yang sama seperti ekspor murid.\n */\nclass EksporNilaiService\n{\n    public function ekspor(Kuis $kuis): StreamedResponse\n    {\n        $kuis->loadMissing(['kelas', 'mapel']);\n        $soal = $kuis->soal()->orderBy('quiz_questions.urutan')->get();\n\n        $namaBerkas = 'nilai-kuis-'.$kuis->getKey().'-'.now()->format('Ymd-His').'.csv';\n\n        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($kuis, $soal): void {\n            $keluaran = fopen('php://output', 'w');\n\n            if ($keluaran === false) {\n                return;\n            }\n\n            $penulis = Writer::createFromStream($keluaran);\n\n            $judulKolom = [\n                'nama', 'nis', 'nisn', 'kelas', 'tim', 'jumlah_anggota_tim',\n                'skor', 'skor_maksimal', 'persen', 'jumlah_benar', 'jumlah_soal',\n                'dikumpulkan_at', 'percobaan',\n            ];\n\n            foreach ($soal as $nomor => $satu) {\n                $judulKolom[] = 'soal_'.($nomor + 1).' (maks '.$this->angka($satu->skor).')';\n            }\n\n            $penulis->insertOne($judulKolom);\n\n            foreach ($this->baris($kuis, $soal) as $satu) {\n                $attempt = $satu['attempt'];\n                $murid = $satu['murid'];\n                $maksimal = (float) $attempt->skor_maksimal;\n\n                $baris = [\n                    EksporMuridService::amankanSel($murid->user?->name),\n                    EksporMuridService::amankanSel($murid->nis),\n                    EksporMuridService::amankanSel($murid->nisn),\n                    EksporMuridService::amankanSel($kuis->kelas?->nama),\n                    EksporMuridService::amankanSel($satu['tim']),\n                    (string) $satu['jumlah_anggota'],\n                    $this->angka($attempt->skor),\n                    $this->angka($maksimal),\n                    $this->angka($maksimal > 0 ? round((float) $attempt->skor / $maksimal * 100, 1) : 0.0),\n                    (string) $attempt->jumlah_benar,\n                    (string) $attempt->jumlah_soal,\n                    $attempt->dikumpulkan_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',\n                    (string) $attempt->attempt_no,\n                ];\n\n                $jawaban = $attempt->jawaban->keyBy('question_id');\n\n                foreach ($soal as $satuSoal) {\n                    $nilai = $jawaban->get($satuSoal->getKey());\n                    $baris[] = $this->angka($nilai?->skor);\n                }\n\n                $penulis->insertOne($baris);\n            }\n\n            fclose($keluaran);\n        }, $namaBerkas, ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8']);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Susun baris ekspor: satu baris per murid, skor tim dibagi ke anggotanya.\n     *\n     * @param  \\Illuminate\\Support\\Collection<int, \\App\\Sections\\Question\\Models\\Soal>  $soal\n     * @return array<int, array{murid: Murid, attempt: Attempt, tim: string|null, jumlah_anggota: int}>\n     */\n    private function baris(Kuis $kuis, $soal): array\n    {\n        $attempts = Attempt::query()\n            ->where('quiz_id', $kuis->getKey())\n            ->where('jenis', JenisAttempt::Ulangan->value)\n            ->where('asli', true)\n            ->whereNotNull('dikumpulkan_at')\n            ->with(['murid.user', 'jawaban', 'tim.murid.user'])\n            ->get();\n\n        $baris = [];\n\n        foreach ($attempts as $attempt) {\n            $tim = $attempt->tim;\n\n            /** @var array<int, Murid> $anggota */\n            $anggota = $tim !== null\n                ? $tim->murid->all()\n                : array_filter([$attempt->murid]);\n\n            foreach ($anggota as $murid) {\n                $baris[] = [\n                    'murid' => $murid,\n                    'attempt' => $attempt,\n                    'tim' => $tim?->nama,\n                    'jumlah_anggota' => count($anggota),\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Urut nama supaya cocok dengan daftar kelas yang biasa dilihat guru.\n        usort($baris, static fn (array $a, array $b): int => strcmp(\n            (string) $a['murid']->user?->name,\n            (string) $b['murid']->user?->name,\n        ));\n\n        return $baris;\n    }\n\n    /** Angka tanpa nol ekor yang mengganggu (10.00 → 10, 2.50 → 2.5). */\n    private function angka(float|int|string|null $nilai): string\n    {\n        $angka = (float) $nilai;\n\n        if ($angka === floor($angka)) {\n            return (string) (int) $angka;\n        }\n\n        return rtrim(rtrim(number_format($angka, 2, '.', ''), '0'), '.');\n    }\n}\n"}

`ingat`:
```php
public function ingat(string $kunci, callable $sumber, string $ruang): mixed
{
    $this->pintu->catat($ruang);

    if (! $this->pintu->aktif($ruang)) {
        // Traffic rendah: L1 tidak dipakai dan salinannya dibuang (hanya salinan sementara).
        $this->l1()?->lupakanRuang($ruang);
        return $this->dariL2($kunci, $sumber);
    }

    $versi = $this->versi($kunci);
    $salinan = $this->l1()?->ambil($kunci);

    if ($salinan !== null) {
        if ((int) ($salinan['versi'] ?? -1) === $versi) {
            return $salinan['muatan'];
        }
        // Validation check gagal (ada perubahan di proses lain) → buang salinan basi.
        $this->l1()?->lupakan($kunci);
    }

    $muatan = $this->dariL2($kunci, $sumber);
    $this->l1()?->simpan($kunci, $muatan, $versi);

    return $muatan;
}

private function dariL2(string $kunci, callable $sumber): mixed
{
    $lapisan = $this->lapisan[0];
    $isi = $lapisan->ambil($kunci);
    if ($isi !== null) return $isi['muatan'];
    $muatan = $sumber();     // L3: database
    $lapisan->simpan($kunci, $muatan, $this->versi($kunci));
    return $muatan;
}
```
Careful: `dariL2` uses `$this->lapisan[0]` = L2. Fine.

`lupakan($kunci, $ruang)`:
```php
public function lupakan(string $kunci): void
{
    // Urutan invalidation yang disepakati: penulis DB sudah selesai (pemanggil),
    // lalu versi dinaikkan supaya salinan L1 di proses lain langsung ditolak,
    // lalu Redis (L2), baru L1 — L1 tidak pernah jadi sumber kebenaran.
    $this->naikkanVersi($kunci);

    foreach ($this->lapisan as $lapisan) {
        $lapisan->lupakan($kunci);
    }

    $this->siarkan($kunci);
}
```
`siarkan`: Redis publish in try/catch:
```php
private function siarkan(string $kunci): void
{
    $kanal = (string) config('cache_l1.kanal', '');
    if ($kanal === '') return;
    try { Redis::publish($kanal, json_encode(['kunci'=>$kunci,'versi'=>$this->versi($kunci),'at'=>now()->toIso8601String()])); }
    catch (Throwable) { /* pub/sub gagal bukan alasan menggagalkan request */ }
}
```
Careful: with `Redis::publish` inside try/catch, facade mocking works.

Di antara dua ambang itu\n * keputusan terakhir dipertahankan (histeresis) supaya L1 tidak berkedip\n * nyala-mati saat lalu lintas naik-turun.\n */\nfinal class PintuTraffic\n{\n    public function __construct(\n        private readonly int $jendelaDetik,\n        private readonly float $ambangAktif,\n        private readonly float $ambangMati,\n    ) {}\n\n    /** Catat `jumlah` pembacaan pada satu ruang (dipakai untuk mengukur laju). */\n    public function catat(string $ruang, int $jumlah = 1): void\n    {\n        $kunci = $this->kunciLaju($ruang);\n        $jendela = max(1, $this->jendelaDetik);\n\n        // Cache::add hanya berhasil bila kunci belum ada → aman sebagai penghitung\n        // yang reset sendiri setiap jendela.\n        Cache::add($kunci, 0, $jendela);\n        Cache::increment($kunci, max(1, $jumlah));\n    }\n\n    /** Laju rata-rata (permintaan per detik) pada jendela terakhir. */\n    public function laju(string $ruang): float\n    {\n        $jumlah = (int) Cache::get($this->kunciLaju($ruang), 0);\n\n        return $jumlah / max(1, $this->jendelaDetik);\n    }\n\n    /** Apakah L1 boleh dipakai untuk ruang ini (dengan histeresis). */\n    public function aktif(string $ruang): bool\n    {\n        $laju = $this->laju($ruang);\n        $sebelumnya = Cache::get($this->kunciStatus($ruang));\n\n        $aktif = match (true) {\n            $laju >= $this->ambangAktif => true,\n            $laju <= $this->ambangMati => false,\n            default => (bool) ($sebelumnya ?? false),\n        };\n\n        Cache::put($this->kunciStatus($ruang), $aktif, max(3, $this->jendelaDetik * 3));\n\n        return $aktif;\n    }\n\n    /** Lupakan hitungan & status satu ruang (dipakai test dan saat pembersihan). */\n    public function bersihkan(string $ruang): void\n    {\n        Cache::forget($this->kunciLaju($ruang));\n        Cache::forget($this->kunciStatus($ruang));\n    }\n\n    private function kunciLaju(string $ruang): string\n    {\n        return 'l1:laju:'.$ruang;\n    }\n\n    private function kunciStatus(string $ruang): string\n    {\n        return 'l1:status:'.$ruang;\n    }\n}\n"}

L1 tidak pernah menjadi\n *    sumber kebenaran — ia hanya salinan sementara.\n * 3. **Sebar**: satu pesan pub/sub Redis diberitahukan ke proses lain (service\n *    realtime) setelah invalidasi; kegagalan menyiarkan tidak pernah\n *    menggagalkan permintaan guru/murid.\n */\nfinal class CacheBerlapis\n{\n    public const RUANG_PENGATURAN = 'pengaturan';\n\n    private const AKHIRAN_VERSI = ':versi';\n\n    /**\n     * @param  array<int, LapisanCache>  $lapisan  urutan lapisan dari yang paling\n     *                                             tahan lama ke yang paling sementara\n     */\n    public function __construct(\n        private readonly PintuTraffic $pintu,\n        private readonly array $lapisan,\n    ) {\n        if ($this->lapisan === []) {\n            throw new \\InvalidArgumentException('Cache berlapis butuh minimal satu lapisan.');\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Ambil dari cache; bila kosong, jalankan `$sumber` (database) lalu simpan.\n     *\n     * @template T\n     *\n     * @param  callable(): T  $sumber\n     * @return T\n     */\n    public function ingat(string $kunci, callable $sumber, string $ruang = self::RUANG_PENGATURAN): mixed\n    {\n        $this->pintu->catat($ruang);\n\n        $l1 = $this->lapisanL1();\n\n        if (! $this->pintu->aktif($ruang)) {\n            // Lalu lintas reda: L1 hanya salinan sementara, jadi dibuang.\n            $l1?->lupakanRuang($ruang);\n\n            return $this->dariLapisanTahanLama($kunci, $sumber);\n        }\n\n        $versi = $this->versi($kunci);\n        $salinan = $l1?->ambil($kunci);\n\n        if ($salinan !== null) {\n            if ((int) ($salinan['versi'] ?? -1) === $versi) {\n                return $salinan['muatan'];\n            }\n\n            // Validation check gagal: proses lain sudah mengubah data ini.\n            $l1?->lupakan($kunci);\n        }\n\n        $muatan = $this->dariLapisanTahanLama($kunci, $sumber);\n        $l1?->simpan($kunci, $muatan, $versi);\n\n        return $muatan;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Invalidasi berurutan setelah database ditulis pemanggil.\n     *\n     * @param  string|null  $ruang  bila diisi, salinan L1 satu ruang sekaligus dibuang\n     */\n    public function lupakan(string $kunci, ?string $ruang = null): void\n    {\n        $this->naikkanVersi($kunci);\n\n        foreach ($this->lapisan as $satu) {\n            $satu->lupakan($kunci);\n        }\n\n        if ($ruang !== null) {\n            $this->lapisanL1()?->lupakanRuang($ruang);\n        }\n\n        $this->siarkan($kunci);\n    }\n\n    /** Versi penanda: salinan cache dengan versi lama selalu ditolak. */\n    public function versi(string $kunci): int\n    {\n        $isi = $this->lapisan[0]->ambil($kunci.self::AKHIRAN_VERSI);\n\n        return $isi !== null ? (int) $isi['muatan'] : 0;\n    }\n\n    /** Nama lapisan yang aktif (untuk laporan/diagnosa). */\n    public function lapisan(): array\n    {\n        return array_map(static fn (LapisanCache $satu): string => $satu->nama(), $this->lapisan);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @template T\n     *\n     * @param  callable(): T  $sumber\n     * @return T\n     */\n    private function dariLapisanTahanLama(string $kunci, callable $sumber): mixed\n    {\n        $tahanLama = $this->lapisan[0];\n        $isi = $tahanLama->ambil($kunci);\n\n        if ($isi !== null) {\n            return $isi['muatan'];\n        }\n\n        $muatan = $sumber();\n        $tahanLama->simpan($kunci, $muatan, $this->versi($kunci));\n\n        return $muatan;\n    }\n\n    private function naikkanVersi(string $kunci): int\n    {\n        $baru = $this->versi($kunci) + 1;\n        $this->lapisan[0]->simpan($kunci.self::AKHIRAN_VERSI, $baru, $baru);\n\n        return $baru;\n    }\n\n    private function lapisanL1(): ?LapisanL1\n    {\n        foreach ($this->lapisan as $satu) {\n            if ($satu instanceof LapisanL1 && $satu->tersedia()) {\n                return $satu;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private function siarkan(string $kunci): void\n    {\n        $kanal = trim((string) config('cache_l1.kanal', ''));\n\n        if ($kanal === '') {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        try {\n            Redis::publish($kanal, (string) json_encode([\n                'kunci' => $kunci,\n                'versi' => $this->versi($kunci),\n                'pada' => Carbon::now()->toIso8601String(),\n            ]));\n        } catch (Throwable) {\n            // Pub/sub hanya pemberitahuan; permintaan tetap dianggap berhasil.\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}

Better: mark the L1 layer explicitly — e.g. `CacheBerlapis` picks the **last** layer as the "sementara" (volatile) layer, matching the documented order (tahan lama → sementara). ### Controller
```php
class LayarController extends Controller
{
    public function show(Request $request, Kuis $kuis, LayarService $layar): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('layar', $kuis);
        $guru = (bool) $request->user()?->isGuru();
        return response()->json($layar->baca($kuis, $guru));
    }

    public function simpan(SimpanLayarRequest $request, Kuis $kuis, LayarService $layar): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $kuis);
        $pengguna = $request->user();
        if ($pengguna === null || ! $pengguna->isGuru()) abort(403, ...);
        return response()->json($layar->ubah($pengguna, $kuis, ...));
    }
}
```

export default function useLayar(kuisId, opsi = {}) {

}

Hmm, `Mockery::mock(X)->makePartial()` — for a class without constructor, makePartial creates an instance without calling the constructor then mocks methods that have expectations; un-mocked methods call the real code. Yes, that's how makePartial works (Mockery 1.x: `makePartial()` on a mock of a class creates a partial mock where only expectations are overridden). Good.

```js
export const POLLING_CEPAT = 5000
export const POLLING_LAMBAT = 20000

/**
 * @param {number} kuisId
 * @param {{ peran?: 'guru'|'murid', aktif?: boolean }} [opsi]
 */
export default function useLayar(kuisId, opsi = {}) {
  const { peran = 'murid', aktif: boleh = true } = opsi
  const [statusSse, setStatusSse] = useState('tidak-dipakai')
  const selang = statusSse === 'hidup' ? POLLING_LAMBAT : POLLING_CEPAT
  const kueri = useQuery({...})
  useEffect(() => { if (peran !== 'murid') return undefined; ... }, [kuisId, peran])
  return { ...kueri, statusSse }
}
```

For murid, initial 'mencoba'.

The hook returns `{...kueri, statusSse}` — spreading a QueryResult is fine.

Itulah yang membuat layar kelas tidak\n * pernah kosong saat service realtime mati.\n */\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react'\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { urlSse } from '../../shared/api/realtime.js'\nimport { ambilLayar, terbitkanTiketLayar } from './layar.js'\n\n/** Selang polling saat SSE tidak tersedia (ms). */\nexport const POLLING_CEPAT = 5000\n\n/** Selang polling saat SSE hidup — cukup sebagai jaring pengaman (ms). */\nexport const POLLING_LAMBAT = 20000\n\n/**\n * @param {number} kuisId\n * @param {{ peran?: 'guru'|'murid', aktif?: boolean }} [opsi]\n */\nexport default function useLayar(kuisId, opsi = {}) {\n  const peran = opsi.peran ?? 'murid'\n  const boleh = opsi.aktif ?? true\n  const [statusSse, setStatusSse] = useState(peran === 'murid' ? 'mencoba' : 'polling')\n\n  const selang = statusSse === 'hidup' ? POLLING_LAMBAT : POLLING_CEPAT\n\n  const kueri = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['layar', kuisId],\n    queryFn: () => ambilLayar(kuisId),\n    enabled: boleh && Number.isInteger(kuisId) && kuisId > 0,\n    refetchInterval: selang,\n  })\n\n  const refetch = kueri.refetch\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (peran !== 'murid' || !boleh || !Number.isInteger(kuisId) || kuisId <= 0) return undefined\n\n    let batal = false\n    /** @type {EventSource|null} */\n    let sumber = null\n\n    async function sambung() {\n      try {\n        const tiket = await terbitkanTiketLayar(kuisId)\n        if (batal) return\n\n        sumber = new EventSource(urlSse('kuis', tiket.tiket))\n\n        sumber.onopen = () => setStatusSse('hidup')\n        sumber.onmessage = () => {\n          void refetch()\n        }\n        sumber.onerror = () => {\n          // Fail-open: tanpa SSE, polling sudah menutupi.\n          setStatusSse('polling')\n          sumber?.close()\n          sumber = null\n        }\n      } catch {\n        setStatusSse('polling')\n      }\n    }\n\n    void sambung()\n\n    return () => {\n      batal = true\n      sumber?.close()\n      sumber = null\n    }\n    // `refetch` stabil (react-query), jadi menyambung ulang hanya terjadi saat\n    // kuis berganti — bukan pada setiap pembaruan data.\n  }, [kuisId, peran, boleh, refetch])\n\n  return { ...kueri, statusSse }\n}\n"}

### Fix 4: Password reset "already used" UI
Backend: distinguish status. Laravel broker statuses:
- `Password::RESET_LINK_SENT` = 'passwords.sent'
- `Password::PASSWORD_RESET` = 'passwords.reset'
- `Password::INVALID_USER` = 'passwords.user'
- `Password::INVALID_TOKEN` = 'passwords.token'
- `Password::RESET_THROTTLED` = 'passwords.throttled'

Scenario A — token used: Password::reset deleted the row. hashTerakhir = ''. I CANNOT compare against anything. I have no way to know from the DB that a token was ever issued.

Cleanest: on successful reset, write a cache key `reset-dipakai:{sha256(email)}` = hash of used token with TTL (e.g., 24h or token lifetime 60min... use config('auth.passwords.'.config('auth.passwords.default').'.expire')). This detects reuse of the EXACT token — which is precisely the user's scenario (click link again). A fresh invalid token from a new email wouldn't match. 

And edge: used then a NEW reset requested → new token created (row exists again) → reuse of old token: Password::reset fails (INVALID_TOKEN because row's hash differs), cache says old token was used → "sudah dipakai" — still correct messaging ("Tautan ini sudah pernah dipakai. What about someone submitting a random garbage token? Cache miss → generic message. Good — no info leak (can't distinguish "never issued" from "expired"; both generic). Reuse detection only fires for genuinely-used tokens.

```php
public function terapkan(...): array / throws HttpException
{
    $status = Password::reset([...], $callback);
    if ($status === Password::PASSWORD_RESET) {
        Cache::put($this->kunciTombstone($token), 'dipakai', now()->addHours(24));
        return 'Kata sandi berhasil diganti. Silakan masuk.';
    }
    if ($status === Password::INVALID_TOKEN && Cache::has($this->kunciTombstone($token))) {
        throw new HttpException(409, 'Tautan ini sudah pernah dipakai...');
    }
    throw new ValidationException::withMessages(['token' => 'Tautan tidak valid atau kedaluwarsa.'])
}
```

Let me design:

```php
/** Nama kelas penampung murid self-register yang belum ditempatkan guru. */
public const KELAS_PENAMPUNG = 'Tanpa Kelas';

/**
 * Profil murid milik user, dibuatkan bila belum ada (idempoten).
 * ...
 */
public function pastikanProfil(User $user): ?Murid
{
    $ada = Murid::query()->where('user_id', $user->getKey())->first();
    if ($ada !== null) {
        return $ada;
    }
    return $this->buatDiKelasPenampung($user);
}

private function buatDiKelasPenampung(User $user): ?Murid
{
    $sekolah = Sekolah::query()->first();
    if ($sekolah === null) {
        return null;
    }
    $kelas = Kelas::query()->firstOrCreate(
        ['school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(), 'nama' => self::KELAS_PENAMPUNG],
        ['tingkat' => 1, 'tahun_ajaran' => null],
    );
    return Murid::query()->create([
        'school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(),
        'class_id' => $kelas->getKey(),
        'user_id' => $user->getKey(),
    ]);
}
```

### 1. `MuridService::pastikanProfil(User $user): ?Murid`

Add to `app/Sections/School/Services/MuridService.php`:

```php
use App\Sections\School\Models\Kelas;
use App\Sections\School\Models\Sekolah;

/** Nama kelas penampung untuk murid yang belum ditempatkan guru. */
public const KELAS_PENAMPUNG = 'Tanpa Kelas';

/**
 * Profil murid milik user, dibuatkan bila belum ada (idempoten).
 *
 * Akun murid yang dibuat di luar jalur resmi (impor lama, baris `users`
 * langsung, atau sebelum fitur kelas penampung ada) bisa tidak punya baris
 * `students`. Tanpa profil, seluruh endpoint murid menolak dengan 403 padahal
 * akunnya sah. Method ini menyembuhkan keadaan itu saat diakses: murid
 * ditempatkan di kelas penampung yang sama dengan murid self-register.
 *
 * Mengembalikan null hanya bila instalasi belum punya data sekolah — saat itu
 * tidak ada kelas valid untuk ditempati.
 */
public function pastikanProfil(User $user): ?Murid
{
    $ada = Murid::query()->where('user_id', $user->getKey())->first();

    if ($ada !== null) {
        return $ada;
    }

    $sekolah = Sekolah::query()->first();

    if ($sekolah === null) {
        return null;
    }

    $kelas = Kelas::query()->firstOrCreate(
        ['school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(), 'nama' => self::KELAS_PENAMPUNG],
        ['tingkat' => 1, 'tahun_ajaran' => null],
    );

    return Murid::query()->create([
        'school_id' => $sekolah->getKey(),
        'class_id' => $kelas->getKey(),
        'user_id' => $user->getKey(),
    ]);
}
```

**BadgeController::saya** — inject MuridService:
```php
public function saya(Request $request, BadgeService $service, MuridService $muridService): JsonResponse
{
    $pengguna = $request->user();
    if ($pengguna === null) abort(401, 'Sesi tidak ditemukan.');

    $pengguna->loadMissing('murid');
    $murid = $pengguna->murid;

    if ($murid === null && $pengguna->isMurid()) {
        $murid = $muridService->pastikanProfil($pengguna);
    }

    if ($murid === null) {
        abort(403, 'Hanya akun murid yang punya badge.');
    }

    return response()->json($service->untukMurid($murid));
}
```

Output: /tmp/palet-masuk.png\n * Prasyarat: Chrome headless --remote-debugging-port=9333 dan Vite di 5173.\n */\nconst CDP = 'http://127.0.0.1:9333'\nconst APP = 'http://localhost:5173'\nconst sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))\n\nasync function utama() {\n  const buatan = await fetch(`${CDP}/json/new?${encodeURIComponent(`${APP}/masuk`)}`, { method: 'PUT' })\n  const tab = await buatan.json()\n\n  const WS = (await import('node:ws')).default\n  const ws = new WS(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl, { perMessageDeflate: false })\n  let urut = 0\n  const tunggu = {}\n  ws.on('message', (data) => {\n    const pesan = JSON.parse(data.toString())\n    if (pesan.id && tunggu[pesan.id]) { tunggu[pesan.id](pesan); delete tunggu[pesan.id] }\n  })\n  const kirim = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((selesai) => {\n    urut += 1\n    tunggu[urut] = selesai\n    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: urut, method, params }))\n  })\n\n  await new Promise((s) => ws.on('open', s))\n  await kirim('Page.enable')\n  await kirim('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: 1440, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 2, mobile: false })\n  await sleep(3000)\n\n  const hasil = await kirim('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' })\n  const fs = await import('node:fs')\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/palet-masuk.png', Buffer.from(hasil.result.data, 'base64'))\n  console.log('tersimpan /tmp/palet-masuk.png')\n\n  // Mode gelap\n  await kirim('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: `document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme','dark')` })\n  await sleep(600)\n  const gelap = await kirim('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' })\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/palet-masuk-gelap.png', Buffer.from(gelap.result.data, 'base64'))\n  console.log('tersimpan /tmp/palet-masuk-gelap.png')\n\n  ws.close()\n  await fetch(`${CDP}/json/close/${tab.id}`)\n}\n\nutama().catch((e) => { console.error('gagal:', e.message); process.exit(1) })\n"}

- 🔧 `write_file` — {"path": "docs/tangkap-palet.mjs", "instructions": "Create screenshot capture script using Node 22 built-in WebSocket without dependencies", "content": "/**\n * Tangkap halaman masuk (auth) untuk bukti visual palet baru.\n * Hanya tangkapan — tidak ada asersi. Output: /tmp/palet-masuk*.png\n * Prasyarat: Chrome headless --remote-debugging-port=9333 dan Vite di 5173.\n * Tanpa pustaka: memakai WebSocket global bawaan Node 22.\n */\nconst CDP = 'http://127.0.0.1:9333'\nconst APP = 'http://localhost:5173'\nconst sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))\n\nasync function utama() {\n  const buatan = await fetch(`${CDP}/json/new?${encodeURIComponent(`${APP}/masuk`)}`, { method: 'PUT' })\n  const tab = await buatan.json()\n\n  const ws = new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl)\n  let urut = 0\n  const tunggu = new Map()\n  ws.onmessage = (kejadian) => {\n    const pesan = JSON.parse(kejadian.data)\n    if (pesan.id && tunggu.has(pesan.id)) {\n      tunggu.get(pesan.id)(pesan)\n      tunggu.delete(pesan.id)\n    }\n  }\n  const kirim = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((selesai) => {\n    urut += 1\n    tunggu.set(urut, selesai)\n    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: urut, method, params }))\n  })\n\n  await new Promise((s, g) => { ws.onopen = s; ws.onerror = () => g(new Error('WS gagal')) })\n  await kirim('Page.enable')\n  await kirim('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: 1440, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 2, mobile: false })\n  await sleep(3000)\n\n  const fs = await import('node:fs')\n  const terang = await kirim('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' })\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/palet-masuk.png', Buffer.from(terang.result.data, 'base64'))\n  console.log('tersimpan /tmp/palet-masuk.png')\n\n  await kirim('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: `document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme','dark')` })\n  await sleep(600)\n  const gelap = await kirim('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' })\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/palet-masuk-gelap.png', Buffer.from(gelap.result.data, 'base64'))\n  console.log('tersimpan /tmp/palet-masuk-gelap.png')\n\n  ws.close()\n  await fetch(`${CDP}/json/close/${tab.id}`)\n}\n\nutama().catch((e) => { console.error('gagal:', e.message); process.exit(1) })\n"}
**Balasan:**

```css
/* ===== Editor materi gaya video editor (slice 09) ===== */
.editor-materi {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .editor-materi {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}

.timeline-klip {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  background: var(--kartu-lembut);
  border: 1px solid var(--garis);
  border-radius: var(--radius-kecil);
}

.klip {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 6.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  background: var(--kartu);
  border: 1px solid var(--garis);
  border-radius: var(--radius-kecil);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: grab;
}

.klip:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.klip-aktif {
  background: var(--sorot-hangat);
  border-color: var(--teks);
}

.klip-diseret { opacity: 0.5; }

.monitor-materi {
  background: var(--kartu);
  border: 1px solid var(--garis);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
```

  return (
    <section className="kartu-soal p-3">
      <div className="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <h2 className="h6 fw-bold mb-0">{materi.judul}</h2>
        {belumTersimpan && <span className="badge-status peringatan">Belum tersimpan</span>}
        <span className="badge-status lembut ms-auto">{materi.status_label ?? materi.status}</span>
      </div>

      {galat && <Banner jenis="salah">{galat}</Banner>}

      <div className="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
        {TIPE_BLOK.map((satu) => (
          <Tombol key={satu.nilai} varian="tepi" onClick={() => { setBlok((sebelum) => [...sebelum, blokBaru(satu.nilai)]); setTerpilih(blok.length) }}>
            + {satu.label}
          </Tombol>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="editor-materi mb-3">
        <div>
          {/* Timeline klip */}
          <div className="timeline-klip mb-2" aria-label="Timeline blok materi">
            {blok.map((satu, indeks) => {
              const ciri = ciriKlip(satu.tipe)
              const terpilihKlip = indeks === aktif
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={`klip-${indeks}-${satu.tipe}`}
                  className={`klip${terpilihKlip ? ' klip-aktif' : ''}${indeksSeret === indeks ? ' klip-diseret' : ''}`}
                  aria-pressed={terpilihKlip}
                  aria-label={`Blok ${indeks + 1}: ${ciri.label}${satu.wajib ? '' : ', opsional'}`}
                  draggable
                  onDragStart={() => setIndeksSeret(indeks)}
                  onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                  onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (indeksSeret !== null) pindah(indeksSeret, indeks); setIndeksSeret(null) }}
                  onDragEnd={() => setIndeksSeret(null)}
                  onClick={() => setTerpilih(indeks)}
                >
                  <span className="small fw-bold" aria-hidden="true">{ciri.ikon} Blok {indeks + 1}</span>
                  <span className="d-block small teks-lembut">
                    {ciri.label}{satu.wajib ? '' : ' · opsional'}
                  </span>
                </button>
              )
            })}
            {blok.length === 0 && <span className="small teks-lembut align-self-center px-2">Timeline masih kosong.</span>}
          </div>

          {/* Navigasi playhead */}
          <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-teks btn-sm" disabled={aktif === 0} onClick={() => setTerpilih(aktif - 1)} aria-label="Blok sebelumnya">← Mundur</button>
            <span className="small teks-lembut" aria-live="polite">Blok {blok.length === 0 ? 0 : aktif + 1} dari {blok.length}</span>
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-teks btn-sm" disabled={aktif >= blok.length - 1} onClick={() => setTerpilih(aktif + 1)} aria-label="Blok berikutnya">Lanjut →</button>
            <span className="small teks-lembut ms-auto">Tarik klip untuk mengurutkan</span>
          </div>

          {/* Form blok terpilih */}
          {blokAktif && (
            <div className="border rounded-3 p-3">
              ... existing form with indeks=aktif ...
            </div>
          )}
          {blok.length === 0 && (
            <p className="teks-lembut mb-0">Belum ada blok. Tambahkan blok teks untuk mulai.</p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Monitor pratinjau */}
        <aside className="monitor-materi p-3" aria-label="Pratinjau tampilan murid">
          <div className="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <h3 className="h6 fw-bold mb-0">Pratinjau murid</h3>
            <span className="badge-status lembut">langsung</span>
          </div>
          {blokAktif ? <PratinjauBlok satu={blokAktif} cariUnggahan={cariUnggahan} daftarKuis={daftarKuis} /> : <p className="teks-lembut mb-0">Pratinjau blok muncul di sini.</p>}
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div className="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2"> ... simpan/terbitkan unchanged ... </div>
      ...berkas + laporan unchanged...

Confirmed Q-01 fully:
- `detik = sisaDetikAttempt(attempt, sekarang)` where `sekarang` = live `Date.now()` → cancels out → constant = deadline − server_now. So the countdown never decreases; auto-submit at `detik > 0` never fires (it fires immediately if deadline−server_now ≤ 0, i.e. already expired).

 * tetap — jangan dihitung ulang memakai jam klien yang berjalan, sebab
 * `sekarangMs` akan saling meniadakan dan timer membeku.

 */
export function sisaDetik({ deadlineIso, offsetMs, sekarangMs }) {
  const deadline = Date.parse(deadlineIso)
  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline)) return 0
  const sisaMs = deadline - (sekarangMs + offsetMs)
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(sisaMs / 1000))
}

Exact current text (from earlier cat):

```js
/**
 * Selisih jam server terhadap jam klien (milidetik; positif = klien tertinggal).
 * @param {string} serverNowIso
 * @param {number} sekarangMs
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function geserJamMs(serverNowIso, sekarangMs) {
  const jamServer = Date.parse(serverNowIso)

  return Number.isFinite(jamServer) ? jamServer - sekarangMs : 0
}

/**
 * Sisa detik menurut jam server (tidak pernah negatif).
 * @param {{ deadlineIso: string, serverNowIso: string, sekarangMs: number }} arg
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function sisaDetik({ deadlineIso, serverNowIso, sekarangMs }) {
  const deadline = Date.parse(deadlineIso)

  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline)) return 0

  const sisaMs = deadline - (sekarangMs + geserJamMs(serverNowIso, sekarangMs))

  return Math.max(0, Math.round(sisaMs / 1000))
}

/**
 * Sisa detik dari payload attempt.
 * @param {{ deadline_at: string, server_now: string }} attempt
 * @param {number} sekarangMs
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function sisaDetikAttempt(attempt, sekarangMs) {
  return sisaDetik({
    deadlineIso: attempt.deadline_at,
    serverNowIso: attempt.server_now,
    sekarangMs,
  })
}
```

Q-04: auto-submit loop. Current code:
```js
  // Waktu habis → kumpulkan otomatis (server tetap penentu akhir).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (attempt === undefined || attempt.status !== 'berjalan') return
    if (detik > 0 || sudahKumpul || sedangKirim) return

    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void kumpulkan(true)
    }, 0)

    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [attempt, detik, sudahKumpul, sedangKirim, kumpulkan])
```
And `kumpulkan` sets sedangKirim true→false in finally; on error it shows toast and navigates? No — on error it catches, toasts, and finally sets sedangKirim false; the effect then re-runs (deps changed) and immediately schedules another attempt → infinite loop.

Fix: add attempt counter + backoff, stop on permanent 4xx:
- `const percobaanKumpul = useRef(0)`
- In the auto effect: if `percobaanKumpul.current >= BATAS_PERCOBAAN_KUMPUL` → set state `gagalKumpul` true (show "hubungi guru" screen) and stop.
- Backoff: `JEDA_AUTO_KUMPUL * 2^(percobaan-1)` capped.
- `kumpulkan` returns success/failure info so effect can decide: make `kumpulkan` return `{ok:boolean, permanen:boolean}` or set a ref.

Design (small, reviewable):
- Add constants: `BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO = 4`, `JEDA_AUTO_MIN = 2000`, `JEDA_AUTO_MAKS = 30000`.
- `kumpulkan(otomatis)` currently returns void; change to return `{ berhasil, permanen }`:
  - On success → berhasil true.
  - In catch: determine `status` from error; `permanen = status is 4xx (400-499)`; show toast.
- In auto effect: use a ref for attempts; on failure with permanen → set `autoGagal` state (permanent screen). On failure retriable → schedule next with backoff.

Because state updates trigger effect re-run, guard with refs to avoid loops:
```js
const percobaanAuto = useRef(0)
const [autoMandek, setAutoMandek] = useState(false)
```
Effect:
```js
useEffect(() => {
  if (attempt === undefined || attempt.status !== 'berjalan') return
  if (autoMandek || detik > 0 || sudahKumpul || sedangKirim) return
  if (percobaanAuto.current >= BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO) {
    setAutoMandek(true)   // dangerous: setState in effect body → but it's guarded by ref check; React allows setState in effect
    return
  }
  const jeda = Math.min(JEDA_AUTO_MAKS, JEDA_AUTO_MIN * 2 ** percobaanAuto.current)
  const id = window.setTimeout(async () => {
    percobaanAuto.current += 1
    const hasil = await kumpulkan(true)
    if (hasil?.permanen) {
      percobaanAuto.current = BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO  // stop further attempts
      setAutoMandek(true)
    }
  }, jeda)
  return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
}, [attempt, detik, sudahKumpul, sedangKirim, kumpulkan, autoMandek])
```
Hmm, `setAutoMandek(true)` inside the setTimeout callback is fine. But careful about the "setState in effect body" lint rule (React Compiler lint may complain about setState during render, not in effects... `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`?). Newer eslint react-hooks rules flag setState directly in effect body. To be safe, avoid the body-setState: instead handle limit purely in the timeout callback:

```js
  const id = window.setTimeout(async () => {
    if (percobaanAuto.current >= BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO) return   // berhenti
    percobaanAuto.current += 1
    const hasil = await kumpulkan(true)
    if (hasil.permanen) setAutoMandek(true)

```js
/**
 * Kebijakan percobaan kumpul otomatis saat waktu habis (Q-04).
 * Dipisah dari komponen supaya bisa diuji tanpa DOM.
 */
/** Batas percobaan... */
export const BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO = 4
export const JEDA_AUTO_MIN = 2000
export const JEDA_AUTO_MAKS = 30_000

/**
 * Jeda sebelum percobaan ke-`percobaan` (0 = percobaan pertama).
 */
export function jedaAutoMs(percobaan) {
  const aman = Math.max(0, Math.floor(percobaan))
  return Math.min(JEDA_AUTO_MAKS, JEDA_AUTO_MIN * 2 ** aman)
}

/**
 * Haruskah loop kumpul otomatis berhenti dan meminta bantuan guru?
 * @param {{ percobaan: number, permanen?: boolean, berhasil?: boolean }} arg
 */
export function harusMandek({ percobaan, permanen = false, berhasil = false }) {
  if (berhasil) return false
  return permanen || percobaan >= BATAS_PERCOBAAN_AUTO
}
```

RateLimiter::for('auth', function (Request $request) {
    $perAlamat = (string) $request->ip();
    $perAkun = $perAlamat.'|'.mb_strtolower((string) $request->input('email'));

    return [
        // Menebak sandi satu akun dari satu alamat (anti brute-force).
        Limit::perMinute(5)->by($perAkun),
        // Satu kelas sering berbagi satu IP lewat NAT sekolah: batas per IP harus
        // longgar (30 murid masuk serentak tetap aman), tetapi tetap membatasi
        // percobaan yang mengganti-ganti email dari satu alamat.
        Limit::perMinute(120)->by($perAlamat),
    ];
});
```

```php
public function simpanJawaban(Attempt $attempt, Soal $soal, mixed $jawaban, ?int $penjawabId = null): Jawaban
{
    if (! $this->soalMilikKuis($attempt, $soal)) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['question_id' => 'Soal itu bukan bagian dari kuis ini.']);
    }

    return DB::transaction(function () use ($attempt, $soal, $jawaban, $penjawabId): Jawaban {
        // Status & waktu dibaca ULANG di dalam kunci baris: antara binding rute dan
        // penulisan jawaban, request lain bisa saja sudah menutup attempt ini
        // (`kumpulkan`/`tutupBasi`) atau melewati deadline. Tanpa baca ulang,
        // jawaban yang tiba belakangan tetap tersimpan pada attempt yang sudah
        // ditutup — dan baris itu tak pernah dinilai karena penilaian sudah jalan.
        $terkunci = Attempt::query()->whereKey($attempt->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

        if (! $terkunci->berjalan()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attempt' => 'Ulangan ini sudah dikumpulkan.']);
        }

        if (Carbon::now()->greaterThan($terkunci->deadline_at)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['attempt' => 'Waktu ulangan sudah habis; jawaban tidak bisa disimpan.']);
        }

        $baris = Jawaban::query()
            ->where('attempt_id', $terkunci->getKey())
            ->where('question_id', $soal->getKey())
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->first();

        ... (rest uses $terkunci->getKey() and $terkunci->team_id)
    });
}
```

Now I understand Q-02's mechanics:

`kirimAntrean(attemptId, antrean, tandaiTerkirim)`:
1. snapshot `entri = [...antrean.entries()]`
2. `antrean.clear()` — drops any newer entries added in the meantime? No: `clear()` removes everything, including entries added between snapshot and... actually synchronous, so nothing between. But during the `await kirimJawaban(...)`, `ubahJawaban` may `antrean.current.set(Q, nilaiBaru)`. On failure, `antrean.set(questionId, nilai)` re-queues the OLD `nilai`, overwriting the newer `nilaiBaru`. → latest answer lost, old answer sent later → wrong grading.

Also the same `antrean.current` Map is used concurrently by `jalankanAntrean` (autosave timer) and `kumpulkan` — two concurrent `kirimAntrean` calls interleave: both snapshot and clear, one may clear the other's re-queued entries. Last-write-wins at the server.

Fix per finding: 
- `seq` counter per soal (increases on `ubahJawaban`), re-queue only if no newer entry.
- single sender (mutex) for autosave and kumpulkan.
- (server rejects lower seq — needs API change + migration; heavier.)

The cleanest minimal fix that's testable: extract a pure module `antreanJawaban.js` with:
- `buatAntrean()` → object { entri: Map<questionId,{nilai,seq}>, seq berikutnya }
- `catat(antrean, soalId, nilai)` → seq++
- `ambilKirim(antrean)` → snapshot list of [id, {nilai, seq}] + clear
- `kembalikan(antrean, id, {nilai, seq})` → only re-queue if the current entry's seq <= seq (i.e., no newer local edit)

Better: keep it simple — a pure module with a mutable queue object is fully testable in Vitest without jsdom.

Design:

```js
// frontend/src/sections/attempt/antreanJawaban.js
export function buatAntrean() {
  return { entri: new Map(), urut: 0 }
}

export function catat(antrean, soalId, nilai) {
  const kunci = String(soalId)
  antrean.urut += 1
  antrean.entri.set(kunci, { nilai, seq: antrean.urut })
  return antrean.urut
}

Now I see the I-01 issue clearly.

`LapisanL2::simpan` uses `Cache::forever(...)` — no TTL. The data is invalidated only by explicit `lupakan()`. The version key lives in `lapisan[0]` = L2 as well.

Key problem in `CacheBerlapis::dariLapisanTahanLama()`: it reads L2 and **ignores the stored version**:

```php
$isi = $tahanLama->ambil($kunci);
if ($isi !== null) { return $isi['muatan']; }
```

So the "validation check" (versi) is only applied to L1. For L2 the version is stored but never verified. Now, when could L2 hold a stale version?

`lupakan()` → `naikkanVersi()` writes a new version to L2, then `$satu->lupakan($kunci)` for each layer (L2 forgets the data key). So normally L2's data is deleted on invalidation → no staleness.

BUT: if `lupakan()` is called and then a *concurrent* reader re-populates L2 with a value read from the DB *before* the write... that's a classic race: read old value from DB at T1, invalidation at T2, write to L2 at T3 (with `versi()` read at T3 = new version!). Because `dariLapisanTahanLama` stores `$this->versi($kunci)` at save time (not the version read at the start of `ingat`). So a stale payload gets stamped with the NEW version → and because L2 never checks version, that stale payload is served forever (Cache::forever). That's exactly "menyimpan data basi selamanya" — e.g., anti-cheat settings wrong: teacher turns on anti-cheat, but a concurrent read caches `false` forever → anti-cheat never active for that quiz.

The fix per the finding: "pastikan TTL & invalidasi". Two parts:
1. `L2` should not store forever without TTL: give it a TTL (config), so stale entries expire.
2. `dariLapisanTahanLama` should verify the stored version against the current version and refuse a mismatched copy (validation check for L2 too).
3. In `dariLapisanTahanLama`, store the payload with the version captured BEFORE calling `$sumber()`... Actually the correct fix for the race: capture `$versi = $this->versi($kunci)` BEFORE calling `$sumber()`, and only store if the version hasn't changed since (i.e., re-read version after `$sumber()` and compare; if changed, don't store). That closes the "stale payload stamped with new version" hole.

Let me define the semantics:
```php
private function dariLapisanTahanLama(string $kunci, callable $sumber): mixed
{
    $tahanLama = $this->lapisan[0];
    $versi = $this->versi($kunci);
    $isi = $tahanLama->ambil($kunci);

    if ($isi !== null && (int) $isi['versi'] === $versi) {
        return $isi['muatan'];
    }

    if ($isi !== null) {
        // Salinan dari versi lama: dibuang, jangan dipercaya.
        $tahanLama->lupakan($kunci);
    }

    $muatan = $sumber();

    // Bila versi berubah selagi `$sumber()` berjalan (guru menyimpan pengaturan
    // baru tepat saat murid membaca), salinan ini sudah basi — jangan disimpan,
    // apalagi dengan nomor versi yang lebih baru.
    if ($this->versi($kunci) === $versi) {
        $tahanLama->simpan($kunci, $muatan, $versi);
    }

    return $muatan;
}
```

Note: this returns `$muatan` even if stale — the source was read from DB at that moment, that's the best available; the important thing is not to persist the stale payload.

```php
    /**
     * Lebar & tinggi dari HEADER saja (tanpa mendekode raster).
     *
     * @return array{0: int, 1: int}|null
     */
    private function dimensi(string $isi): ?array
    {
        try {
            $ukuran = @getimagesizefromstring($isi);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }

        if (! is_array($ukuran) || (int) $ukuran[0] < 1 || (int) $ukuran[1] < 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return [(int) $ukuran[0], (int) $ukuran[1]];
    }
```

/**

```php
    public function soalTerurut(Attempt $attempt): array
    {
        $snapshot = $attempt->snapshot_soal;

        if (is_array($snapshot) && $snapshot !== []) {
            $soal = array_map(fn (array $satu): Soal => $this->soalDariSnapshot($satu), array_values($snapshot));
        } else {
            // Attempt lama (dibuat sebelum kolom snapshot ada): pakai soal hidup.
            $kuis = $attempt->kuis;
            if (! $kuis->relationLoaded('soal')) { $kuis->load('soal'); }
            $soal = $kuis->soal->all();
        }

        if (! ($attempt->kuis->acak_soal ?? false)) {
            return array_values($soal);
        }
        return Pengacakan::urutSoal($soal, (int) $attempt->seed, (int) $attempt->getKey());
    }
```

{"acak_soal": false, "soal": [ {...}, ... ]}

    {
        $soal = new Soal;

            'tipe' => TipeSoal::tryFrom((string) ($data['tipe'] ?? '')),
            'konten' => $data['konten'] ?? [],
            'kunci' => $data['kunci'] ?? [],

        ]);
        $soal->exists = false;   // instance sementara, jangan pernah ikut disimpan

```

     * `answers.question_id` memakai cascadeOnDelete, jadi menghapus soal ikut
     * menghapus jawaban murid — nilainya hilang permanen dan tidak bisa
     * dipertanggungjawabkan ke orang tua. Matikan soalnya (`aktif = false`)
     * sebagai gantinya.
     */
    public function pastikanBelumDijawab(Soal $soal): void
    {
        if (! Jawaban::query()->where('question_id', $soal->getKey())->exists()) {
            return;
        }

        throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'soal' => 'Soal ini sudah dijawab murid, jadi tidak bisa dihapus. Nonaktifkan saja agar riwayat nilainya tetap utuh.',
        ]);
    }
```

    public function soalTerurut(Attempt $attempt): array
    {
        $snapshot = $attempt->snapshot_soal;
        $soal = [];
        $acak = false;

        if (is_array($snapshot) && isset($snapshot['soal']) && is_array($snapshot['soal']) && $snapshot['soal'] !== []) {
            // Soal beku saat attempt dimulai: guru boleh mengubah/menghapus soal
            // sesudahnya tanpa mengubah apa yang dibaca dan dinilai attempt ini.
            foreach (array_values($snapshot['soal']) as $satu) {
                if (is_array($satu)) {
                    $soal[] = $this->soalDariSnapshot($satu);
                }
            }
            $acak = (bool) ($snapshot['acak_soal'] ?? false);
        } else {
            // Attempt lama (dibuat sebelum kolom snapshot ada) tetap dilayani
            // dari soal hidup supaya ulangan yang sedang jalan tidak rusak.
            $kuis = $attempt->kuis;

            if (! $kuis->relationLoaded('soal')) {
                $kuis->load('soal');
            }

            $soal = array_values($kuis->soal->all());
            $acak = (bool) $kuis->acak_soal;
        }

        if (! $acak) {
            return $soal;
        }

        return Pengacakan::urutSoal($soal, (int) $attempt->seed, (int) $attempt->getKey());
    }
```

it('membekukan soal saat attempt dimulai sehingga ubah kunci dan skor tidak mengubah nilainya', function (): void {
    $kuis = siapkanKuis($this);
    $hasil = mulaiUlangan($this, $kuis);
    $pilihan = collect($hasil['soal'])->firstWhere('tipe', 'pilihan_ganda');

    $this->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$hasil['attempt']}/jawab", [
        'question_id' => $pilihan['id'],
        'jawaban' => 'B',
    ])->assertOk();

    $attempt = Attempt::query()->findOrFail($hasil['attempt']);

    expect($attempt->snapshot_soal['soal'])->toHaveCount(2)
        ->and(collect($attempt->snapshot_soal['soal'])->firstWhere('id', (int) $pilihan['id'])['kunci'])->toBe(['jawaban' => 'B']);

    // Guru menyunting bank soal di tengah ulangan — langsung ke DB, meniru
    // suntingan yang lolos dari penjagaan jendela jadwal (mis. attempt yang
    // berjalan melewati selesai_at + durasi).
    Soal::query()->whereKey((int) $pilihan['id'])->update([
        'kunci' => json_encode(['jawaban' => 'A'], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
        'skor' => 100,
    ]);

    $respons = $this->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$hasil['attempt']}/kumpulkan", [
        'idempotency_key' => 'kunci-snapshot-1',
    ])->assertOk();

    // Jawaban 'B' tetap dinilai benar dengan skor 5 seperti saat attempt dimulai;
    // soal kedua tetap bernilai 5, jadi maksimal 10 (bukan 105).
    expect($respons->json('skor'))->toEqual(5.0)
        ->and($respons->json('skor_maksimal'))->toEqual(10.0)
        ->and($respons->json('jumlah_benar'))->toBe(1);

    $perSoal = collect($respons->json('per_soal'))->firstWhere('question_id', (int) $pilihan['id']);

    expect($perSoal['skor'])->toEqual(5.0)
        ->and($perSoal['benar'])->toBeTrue()
        ->and($perSoal['skor_maksimal'])->toEqual(5.0);
});
```
Careful: `Skor soal` in the response is `(float) $soal->skor` from the snapshot → 5.0. Before the fix (live), skor_maksimal for that soal would be 100.0 and benar false, total 0 → red. 

Hmm: does `soal->skor` get cast? Snapshot hydration sets `'skor' => (int) 5`. Good.

Also `$attempt->snapshot_soal['soal']` — accessing the cast array.

Careful on the `kunci` value comparison: `$satu->kunciSebagaiArray()` for the factory PG soal → `['jawaban' => 'B']`. Good.

Test 2 (delete guard):
```php
it('soal yang sudah dijawab murid tidak bisa dihapus agar jawabannya tidak ikut terhapus', function (): void {
    $kuis = siapkanKuis($this);
    $hasil = mulaiUlangan($this, $kuis);
    $pilihan = collect($hasil['soal'])->firstWhere('tipe', 'pilihan_ganda');

    $this->postJson("/api/v1/attempt/{$hasil['attempt']}/jawab", [
        'question_id' => $pilihan['id'],
        'jawaban' => 'B',
    ])->assertOk();

    // Jendela jadwal kuis sudah lewat, jadi penjagaan "soal terkunci saat kuis
    // berjalan" tidak lagi berlaku — yang menahan hapus hanya riwayat jawaban.
    Attempt::query()->whereKey($hasil['attempt'])->update(['deadline_at' => Carbon::now()->subMinutes(10)]);
    $kuis->forceFill(['selesai_at' => Carbon::now()->subMinutes(20)])->save();

    auth()->forgetGuards();
    Sanctum::actingAs($this->guru);

    $this->deleteJson("/api/v1/soal/{$pilihan['id']}")
        ->assertStatus(422)
        ->assertJsonValidationErrors(['soal']);

    expect(Soal::query()->whereKey((int) $pilihan['id'])->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Jawaban::query()->where('question_id', (int) $pilihan['id'])->count())->toBe(1);
});
```
Careful: `Jawaban::where('question_id', ...)` — the murid answered one question → 1 row. Yes.

Careful: is `Soal::terkunci()` false in this setup? `terkunci()` checks quizzes joined via `$this->kuis()` where status=publikasi, mulai_at <= now, and (selesai_at null or >= now). We set selesai_at = 20 min ago → false. Good.

Careful: the `$this->guru` (factory) vs soal's `dibuat_oleh` = null → ownership allows. Good.

Let me write the implementation:

```php
    /**
     * Imbuhan yang membalik arti kata: "organik" → "anorganik",
     * "simetris" → "asimetris", "legal" → "ilegal", "vertebrata" → "invertebrata".
     * Diduplikasi dari daftar negasi karena bentuknya menempel pada kata, bukan
     * berdiri sendiri sebagai kata terpisah.
     */
    public const AWALAN_PEMBALIK = ['a', 'an', 'anti', 'il', 'im', 'in', 'non', 'tak', 'tidak', 'tanpa'];

    /** Panjang minimum kata dasar agar aturan imbuhan pembalik tidak salah tuduh. */
    public const MIN_KATA_DASAR = 4;

    public static function melawanAntonim(string $a, string $b): bool
    {
        $a = self::normalisasi($a);
        $b = self::normalisasi($b);

        if ($a === '' || $b === '' || $a === $b) {
            return false;
        }

        [$pendek, $panjang] = mb_strlen($a) <= mb_strlen($b) ? [$a, $b] : [$b, $a];

        if (mb_strlen($pendek) < self::MIN_KATA_DASAR) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (self::AWALAN_PEMBALIK as $awalan) {
            if (! str_starts_with($panjang, $awalan)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (mb_substr($panjang, mb_strlen($awalan)) === $pendek) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
```

```php
    public function tutupSemuaBasi(): int
    {
        $batas = Carbon::now()->subSeconds(self::TENGGAT_TERLAMBAT);
        $mulai = Carbon::now();
        $jumlah = 0;

        Attempt::query()
            ->where('aktif', true)
            ->where('status', StatusAttempt::Berjalan->value)
            ->where('deadline_at', '<', $batas)
            ->chunkById(200, function ($daftar) use (&$jumlah, $mulai): void {
                foreach ($daftar as $satu) {
                    try {
                        $hasil = $this->tutupBasi($satu);

                        // Hanya hitung attempt yang benar-benar ditutup di sapuan
                        // ini: yang sudah ditutup proses lain (murid menekan
                        // Kumpulkan, atau sapuan sebelumnya) punya cap waktu lama.
                        if ($hasil->dikumpulkan_at !== null && $hasil->dikumpulkan_at->greaterThanOrEqualTo($mulai)) {
                            $jumlah++;
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable $galat) {
                        // Satu attempt yang gagal (deadlock, layanan AI, DB) tidak
                        // boleh menghentikan sapuan: attempt basi lain tetap harus
                        // ditutup, kalau tidak layar guru menampilkan murid
                        // "sedang mengerjakan" berjam-jam.
                        report($galat);
                    }
                }
            });

        return $jumlah;
    }
```

```js
tandaiTerkirim(attemptId, questionId, nilaiTerkirim) {
  set((state) => {
    const entri = state.perAttempt[String(attemptId)]
    if (entri === undefined) return state
    const kunci = String(questionId)
    // Hanya buang entri bila isinya masih persis yang tadi dikirim; bila murid
    // sudah mengetik nilai baru selagi permintaan berjalan, nilai itu tetap
    // menunggu di antrean (Q-03).
    if (!(kunci in entri.belumTerkirim) || !samaNilai(entri.belumTerkirim[kunci], nilaiTerkirim)) {
      return state
    }
    const belumTerkirim = { ...entri.belumTerkirim }
    delete belumTerkirim[kunci]
    return { perAttempt: { ...state.perAttempt, [String(attemptId)]: { ...entri, belumTerkirim, disimpanAt: Date.now() } } }
  })
}
```

private function acakOpsi(Attempt $attempt): bool

}
